articles.title: Paso a paso para instalar Starlink Mini en un viaje: así puedes acceder al internet satelital de Elon Musk
articles.text:
Starlink Mini permite establecer una conexión a internet satelital de Elon Musk en lugares sin cobertura fija o móvil estable, siempre que la antena tenga alimentación eléctrica y una vista amplia del cielo. El kit puede utilizarse en viajes por carretera, campamentos, viviendas temporales o zonas rurales.
El sistema se conecta a los satélites de SpaceX que pasan sobre la ubicación del usuario. Por esa razón, la instalación no depende solo de enchufar el dispositivo: exige revisar el ambiente, evitar obstáculos y completar la configuración desde la aplicación de Starlink.
La guía del fabricante detalla que el kit incluye el dispositivo con WiFi integrado, un pie, adaptadores de montaje, un cable de alimentación de corriente continua de 15 metros y una fuente de alimentación.
Qué preparar antes de salir de viaje por varios días
El primer paso es descargar la aplicación de Starlink en el teléfono antes de llegar al destino. La herramienta permite iniciar el proceso de instalación, revisar el estado de la conexión y recibir alertas si la antena requiere un ajuste de posición. Tenerla instalada con antelación evita depender de una conexión previa cuando se llegue a una zona aislada.
Además, conviene comprobar que estén todos los componentes: la antena, el pie, el cable de alimentación y la fuente. Para un uso temporal durante un viaje, el pie incluido permite apoyar el aparato en una superficie firme.
Dónde se debe ubicar la antena Starlink Mini
La ubicación define la continuidad del servicio. La antena necesita una vista despejada del cielo para mantener el enlace con los satélites. Ramas, techos, postes y otras estructuras que se interpongan entre la antena y el cielo pueden provocar cortes o interrupciones de la conexión.
Antes de apoyar o montar la unidad, es clave abrir la función de detección de obstrucciones de la aplicación. Esa revisión permite identificar si el lugar elegido tiene obstáculos.
En un campamento, por ejemplo, un punto alejado de árboles puede ser más adecuado que instalar el dispositivo junto a una carpa, una camioneta o una construcción.
Cómo conectar Starlink Mini a la energía
Con la antena ya ubicada, se debe levantar el pie y conectar uno de los extremos del cable suministrado al dispositivo. El enchufe debe quedar completamente insertado y al ras de la superficie, según indica la guía. Una conexión incompleta puede impedir que el dispositivo reciba energía o afectar el funcionamiento.
El otro extremo del cable se conecta a la fuente de alimentación y luego a un tomacorriente. Antes de emprender el viaje, es útil definir cuál será la fuente disponible en cada parada: una toma convencional, un inversor compatible en el vehículo o una instalación eléctrica del alojamiento.
De qué manera acceder a la red WiFi de la antena de Starlink
Tras conectar la alimentación, el teléfono, la computadora o la tableta debe buscar la red WiFi llamada STARLINK en el menú de conexiones inalámbricas. El usuario puede seleccionarla desde el dispositivo para acceder a la red creada por la antena.
Asimismo, la aplicación permite después personalizar ajustes y verificar el estado del servicio. Es conveniente hacer una prueba antes de iniciar actividades que dependan de internet, como una videollamada, el envío de archivos, la consulta de mapas o el acceso a plataformas de trabajo.
Qué hacer si la aplicación pide alinear la antena de Starlink
La aplicación puede enviar una alerta si detecta que el equipo requiere un giro para mejorar su orientación. En ese caso, se debe tocar la notificación y seguir la herramienta de alineación. El proceso sirve para ajustar la posición de la antena según las condiciones del lugar en el que se encuentra.
Si Starlink Mini se instaló sobre un soporte de tubo, la guía sugiere aflojar el tornillo de sujeción, orientar el dispositivo según la indicación de la aplicación y volver a ajustarlo con la llave hexagonal. El dispositivo debe quedar firme para evitar movimientos causados por el viento, vibraciones del vehículo o un apoyo inestable.

articles.title: Critical Atlassian Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Read Known Files Across 8 Products
articles.text:
A critical flaw in 8 Atlassian Data Center products, which customers host themselves, allows an attacker with no login access to read specific files in each product's web application root directory.
The attacker must already know a file's exact name and path and cannot list what the directory holds. Atlassian disclosed the flaw, CVE-2026-21589, on October 5, rated it 9.3 out of 10, and listed a fixed version for each product.
The web application root directory is the folder on the server that holds the web application itself. In some configurations, it may contain sensitive files, which raises the risk, according to Atlassian.
Atlassian's cloud products affected by the flaw have already been patched, and cloud customers do not need to take any action.
Atlassian advises customers who cannot upgrade all at once to take the instance offline if possible. Any instance reachable from the public internet, including one that requires a login, should be restricted from outside network access until it is upgraded or a temporary blocking rule is in place.
Affected Products and Fixed Versions
The flaw affects all versions of the 8 products before the fixed versions listed below. That may include versions that have reached end of life, according to Atlassian, which recommends upgrading to a fixed long-term support (LTS) version or later.
Atlassian listed these fixed versions as of October 6:
| Product | Fixed versions | 
|---|---|
| Bitbucket Data Center | 9.4.26, 10.2.8, 10.5.1 | 
| Confluence Data Center | 9.2.26, 10.2.19 | 
| Jira Software Data Center | 9.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 | 
| Jira Service Management Data Center | 5.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 | 
| Bamboo Data Center | 10.2.24, 12.1.12 | 
| Crowd Data Center | 6.3.7, 7.0.3, 7.1.7, 7.2.4 | 
| Crucible | 4.9.15 | 
| Fisheye | 4.9.15 | 
For Crowd's 7.1 branch, the ticket's fix version field said 7.1.7. A table in the same ticket showed 7.1.6, which the ticket also listed as an affected version.
The CVE record Atlassian filed gave different numbers for 2 products. For Crowd, it listed 7.1.1, which the Crowd 7.1 release notes date to November 27, 2025, more than 10 months before the flaw was disclosed. For Bamboo, one field said 10.2.4, while the record's own description said 10.2.24.
The CVE record also listed the Server editions of these products, Atlassian's older self-hosted line, which the advisory did not mention. It marked every version of Bamboo Server, Bitbucket Server, Confluence Server, and Crowd Server as affected and listed no fixed versions for them.
For Jira Software Server, the record listed versions from 9.12.40 as unaffected, for Jira Service Management Server from 5.12.40, and for Crucible Server and Fisheye Server from 4.9.15. It did not say whether Server licenses can run those versions.
Crowd has had no Server release since version 5.2 in September 2023, according to Atlassian's Crowd release notes, so none of the fixed Crowd versions are Server releases.
If You Cannot Upgrade Yet
Atlassian labels the flaw a path traversal in the CVE record. In a path traversal, a request uses a specially built file path to reach files it should not.
Atlassian describes 3 temporary blocking rules, which it calls mitigations. All 3 block requests whose URL contains .. directly next to /, \ or ::, including URL-encoded forms.
Which ones apply depends on the product:
- All 8 products: a rule on a web application firewall (WAF) or reverse proxy that blocks matching URLs.
- Confluence, Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Bamboo and Crowd: a Tomcat RewriteValve rule, installed on each node, which must be shut down and restarted.
- Bitbucket: a rule in urlrewrite.xml, applied to every node, mirror and mirror farm node, followed by a restart.
Crucible and Fisheye have only the first option. The advisory gives the rule and the file changes for each one.
The mitigations "are limited and not a replacement for patching your instance," Atlassian says in its product tickets.
Checking for Past Access
Atlassian said its affected cloud products have been patched and that its investigation has not found evidence of exploitation. Bitbucket Cloud is not affected.
The advisory does not say whether attacks on self-hosted instances have been seen. "Atlassian cannot confirm if your instances have been affected by this vulnerability," it says.
It tells customers to have their security teams search access logs. One method is to URL-decode each request line, up to 2 times, and look for .. directly next to /, \ or ::. The other is to run Atlassian's block pattern over the raw log lines.
The advisory does not explain how to distinguish a failed attempt from a request that returned a file, or what else a customer who encounters such requests should do after upgrading.
Attackers have exploited this kind of flaw in an Atlassian product before. CVE-2021-26086 is a path traversal vulnerability in Jira Server and Data Center that allows remote attackers to read specific files. The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added it to its catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities on November 12, 2024.
How Atlassian Scored the Flaw
The 9.3 rating uses version 4.0 of the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) and is Atlassian's own. The company tells customers to judge how it applies to their environment.
The score rates the flaw as reachable over the network without privileges or user action. It rates the effect on the vulnerable system's confidentiality as high, its integrity and availability as none, and on other systems as high.
The advisory does not identify the sensitive files or the configurations that contain them, nor does it explain the high rating for other systems.

articles.title: These are the countries which have officially built the most data centers — and the ones where people are getting concerned about water consumption the most
articles.text:
These are the countries which have officially built the most data centers — and the ones where people are getting concerned about water consumption the most
Data on data centers
- AI data center growth has accelerated over the past 3 years, with the US alone building 127
- As a result of this push, the US has 10 times more data centers than any other country
- While environmental concerns over AI data centers are strong in the US, it is Chile and Belgium that have the highest water stress
The expansion of data centers over the past three years has revealed that while the US is leading the growth, the environmental impact is actually more widely felt, with water stress being felt in smaller nations, too.
Although the US has built an amazing 127 data centers since 2023 – which is 10 times more than any other country – Russia has built 77 (44% growth) and the UK has expanded by 58 (up 12%). But while the US has 5,427 data centers, Russia’s impact is tiny, with 251 representing just under 5% of the same output.
Water stress is largely impacted on areas where water is already in short supply, but a new study has shown that areas including the famously damp Belgium are impacted.
What is water stress?
Much of the opposition to data centers has concerned the environmental impact, particularly on water stress.
Comparitech’s study refers to the World Resources Institute’s definition of water stress, which tells us that a country using more than 80% of its entire available water supply is under water stress. This is scored in Comparitech’s report, with low water stress rated 1.0, and extremely high rated 4-5.
The results show that Chile (4.5) and Belgium (4.4) have the highest stress on the water supply, with the US on 2.6 and UK on 1.3. However, the damper, temperate zone of Belgium seems to be building itself into data center-shaped water stress problem.
The small European country established 12 new facilities since 2023, which suggests it has gone as far as it can while data centers are demanding up to five million gallons of water a day.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Strategic assets
While the research from Comparitech emphasizes the impact of AI data center growth on the water supply, it also highlights another key consequence of their existence. In March 2026, Iran launched Shahed drone strikes on AWS sites in the United Arab Emirates.
Data centers are now strategic targets, and their positioning in relation to each other (as well as residential areas and other industries) could determine how conflicts unfold in future. The report notes:
“This kind of clustering brings clear efficiency advantages for power and connectivity, but it also concentrates risk: strained local resources, single points of failure, and – as facilities become more central to national economies and AI infrastructure – more attractive targets.
The damage to AWS facilities in the UAE and Bahrain during the 2026 US/Iran conflict, as well as the Russian attacks on a data center in Kyiv, demonstrates how data centers are increasingly treated as strategic assets rather than just commercial ones.”
As data centers continue the trend of clustering into denser digital hubs, this is a risk that will continue to grow.

articles.title: Google Drive y el truco gratis para liberar almacenamiento sin pagar suscripciones
articles.text:
Google Drive permite liberar almacenamiento sin pagar suscripciones mediante una revisión de los archivos más pesados, la limpieza de Gmail y la organización de Google Fotos. El método consiste en localizar el contenido que ocupa más espacio, eliminar lo que ya no sea necesario y vaciar las papeleras para que la capacidad vuelva a estar disponible.
Google Drive ordena los archivos según el espacio que ocupan
La forma más directa de identificar qué contenido consume la mayor parte del almacenamiento consiste en acceder a la página de cuota de Drive. La dirección es drive.google.com/drive/quota y muestra los archivos ordenados de mayor a menor tamaño.
Ese listado permite detectar con rapidez videos largos, copias de seguridad, documentos duplicados o archivos que dejaron de tener utilidad. Revisar primero los elementos de mayor tamaño evita perder tiempo con documentos pequeños, que apenas modifican el espacio disponible dentro de la cuenta.
Una vez localizados los archivos prescindibles, el siguiente paso es hacer clic derecho sobre ellos y seleccionar la opción “Mover a la papelera”. Esta acción retira el contenido de la unidad principal, pero todavía no libera espacio de forma definitiva.
Los archivos permanecen en la papelera hasta que el usuario la vacía. Por eso, después de revisar el material eliminado, conviene entrar en esa sección y confirmar el borrado permanente. Si se eliminan muchos elementos a la vez, la actualización del almacenamiento puede tardar unos minutos.
Gmail también ocupa espacio dentro de la cuenta
El almacenamiento de Google no depende solo de los archivos guardados en Drive. Gmail puede concentrar una cantidad importante de espacio por mensajes antiguos, boletines, notificaciones y correos con documentos adjuntos.
Una forma de iniciar la limpieza es buscar mensajes que incluyan archivos grandes. También conviene localizar comunicaciones recibidas hace años que ya no tengan valor, como invitaciones, promociones, avisos automáticos o mensajes de grupos que dejaron de ser relevantes.
La eliminación masiva puede ser útil cuando existen decenas o cientos de correos similares. Antes de borrar, es recomendable comprobar que no contengan facturas, comprobantes, datos laborales o información personal que pueda ser necesaria más adelante.
Al igual que ocurre con Drive, los mensajes eliminados pasan a la papelera de Gmail. Vaciar esa carpeta es indispensable para recuperar la capacidad ocupada por los correos. Dejar los mensajes en la papelera mantiene el problema, aunque la bandeja de entrada parezca más ordenada.
Una revisión periódica evita que el límite llegue de nuevo
La limpieza puntual resuelve una urgencia, pero la organización reduce la necesidad de repetir el proceso con frecuencia. Clasificar archivos por carpetas facilita reconocer qué documentos siguen siendo útiles y cuáles corresponden a proyectos, trabajos o actividades ya terminadas.
También ayuda eliminar versiones antiguas de un mismo archivo. Es habitual guardar varias copias de una presentación, un video o una fotografía con nombres similares. Cuando esas versiones no aportan información diferente, pueden ocupar espacio de manera innecesaria.
Otra práctica consiste en establecer recordatorios para revisar la cuenta cada cierto tiempo. Ese hábito permite detectar acumulaciones antes de que el límite impida recibir correos o guardar nuevos archivos. La gestión regular del almacenamiento puede evitar una suscripción adicional.
Google Fotos ofrece alternativas para imágenes y videos
Las fotografías y los videos suelen representar una parte importante del contenido almacenado. Para quienes guardan una gran cantidad de material visual, Google Fotos puede ayudar a reducir el impacto sobre la capacidad disponible.
Los usuarios que no necesiten mantener las imágenes en calidad original pueden seleccionar la opción “Alta calidad”. Esa alternativa permite almacenar fotos y videos con restricciones de calidad y reducir el espacio que consumen dentro de Google Drive.
Otra opción es descargar imágenes y videos en un disco duro externo o trasladarlos a otro servicio de almacenamiento en la nube. De ese modo, es posible mantener una copia de respaldo sin que todos los archivos permanezcan en la misma cuenta.
El proceso no requiere borrar documentos importantes de forma indiscriminada. La clave está en revisar qué ocupa más espacio, decidir qué contenido conserva utilidad y confirmar el vaciado de las papeleras. Así, Google Drive puede recuperar capacidad sin necesidad de pagar por almacenamiento adicional.

articles.title: FBI Removes Accenture Contractor After Patch Failure Led to ShinyHunters Breach
articles.text:
The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has removed an Accenture contractor for their alleged role in a ShinyHunters-breach that led to the theft of personal details of thousands of bureau employees.
That's according to a report from Reuters, citing two sources familiar with the matter.
"To date, our review has determined that the incident occurred as the result of a security failure of a platform managed by a third-party organization — after a contractor failed to implement a security patch explicitly issued to secure the platform," Brett Leatherman, assistant director of the FBI's cyber division, was quoted as saying to Reuters.
"As such, the FBI has removed the contractor and taken all necessary steps to both mitigate any further risk and protect our workforce."
Although the name of the third-party organization was not disclosed by the FBI, Reuters reported that it's Oracle PeopleSoft, which the ShinyHunters group said it exploited to breach the FBI's job portal last month.
According to a report from Google-owned Mandiant, ShinyHunters is assessed to be exploiting a bypass for CVE-2026-35273 by using a URL-encoding trick to get around a web application firewall (WAF) rule designed to block the vulnerable Environment Management Hub (PSEMHUB) endpoint.
The Hacker News has contacted both the FBI and Oracle for comment, and we will update the story if we hear back. Accenture, in a statement shared with Reuters, said it was "proud to support the mission of the FBI and will continue to do so."
The development is the latest twist in the operational history of ShinyHunters, which has had two of its members arrested as the FBI continues its investigation into the breach. The agency said it's actively working with partners to obtain and execute more leads, and warned more arrests are likely to come.

articles.title: Melhor notebook com touchscreen: 6 modelos com tela sensível ao toque em 2026 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Melhor notebook com touchscreen: 6 modelos com tela sensível ao toque em 2026
Encontre notebooks com tela touch em formato tradicional ou 2 em 1 para maior praticidade em navegação, leitura e assinatura de documentos
A compra de um notebook com touchscreen é recomendada para quem busca maior versatilidade no dia a dia para assinar documentos, editar arquivos e navegar pela interface do computador.
A tela sensível ao toque permite interagir diretamente com o sistema usando os dedos e, em alguns modelos, também com canetas digitais. Em 2026, essa característica aparece tanto em notebooks tradicionais, quanto em modelos 2 em 1 com dobradiça de 360 graus.
Para ajudar você a escolher o notebook touchscreen ideal, o Tecnoblog reuniu os pontos positivos e negativos de seis modelos disponíveis no mercado. Veja a lista a seguir.
O Galaxy Book3 360 é voltado a quem busca um notebook compacto para estudos, trabalho e consumo de conteúdo. A dobradiça de 360 graus permite posicionar a tela em diferentes ângulos e utilizar o computador como tablet, enquanto a tela Full HD de 13,3 polegadas é compatível com a S Pen — vendida separadamente.
O conjunto usa Intel Core i5-1335U de 13ª geração, com 10 núcleos e 12 threads, acompanhado de gráficos integrados Intel Iris Xe. Nesta configuração, são 8 GB de RAM LPDDR4x integrada e SSD NVMe de 256 GB. A memória não pode ser expandida, enquanto o armazenamento conta com um único slot para SSD.
Com 1,16 kg, o aparelho também favorece a mobilidade, enquanto a conectividade inclui Thunderbolt 4, USB-C, USB-A, HDMI e leitor de cartões microSD, além de Wi-Fi 6E. A webcam tem resolução Full HD e o sistema operacional é o Windows 11 Home.
O ASUS Zenbook Duo é para quem trabalha com várias janelas, documentos, aplicativos ou ferramentas de criação ao mesmo tempo, combinando duas telas OLED de 14 polegadas — quando utilizadas juntas, elas ampliam a área de trabalho para até 19,8 polegadas.
O hardware é formado pelo Intel Core Ultra 9 185H, com 16 núcleos e 22 threads, gráficos integrados Intel Arc e NPU Intel AI Boost. São 16 GB de memória LPDDR5X e SSD de 1 TB, combinação que oferece margem para multitarefa e aplicações que utilizam bastante memória, enquanto a NPU é destinada ao uso de IA local.
Cada tela tem resolução de 2.880 x 1.800 pixels, proporção 16:10, taxa de atualização de 120 Hz, brilho de até 500 nits e cobertura de 100% do DCI-P3. O notebook pesa 1,35 kg — e o teclado acrescenta 300 g –, além da presença de duas portas Thunderbolt 4 com suporte a vídeo e carregamento, USB-A, HDMI 2.1 e Wi-Fi 6E.
O Galaxy Book6 Pro combina mobilidade com uma tela touch de alta resolução para trabalho, estudos e criação de conteúdo, usando uma configuração com chip Intel Core Ultra 5 325. Essa versão traz 16 GB de RAM integrada e SSD de 512 GB.
Esse chip inclui uma NPU Intel de até 47 TOPS para recursos de inteligência artificial e os gráficos são integrados. A tela de 14 polegadas é uma Dynamic AMOLED 2X sensível ao toque, com resolução de 2.880 x 1.800 pixels e revestimento antirreflexo.
Essa tecnologia favorece alto contraste, enquanto a resolução WQXGA+ traz mais espaço vertical e definição para textos, imagens e vídeos. A Samsung também informa taxa de atualização de até 120 Hz. A conectividade inclui Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, duas portas Thunderbolt 4, USB-A 3.2, HDMI 2.1 e entrada para fone e microfone.
O Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 traz uma configuração voltada à produtividade, usando display de 15,3 polegadas e o Intel Core i5 de 13ª geração. A tela touch permite interagir diretamente com o sistema em tarefas, enquanto a proporção 16:10 oferece mais espaço que os painéis 16:9.
Ele tem resolução de 1.920 x 1.200 pixels, painel WVA, acabamento antirreflexo, brilho de 300 nits, taxa de atualização de 60 Hz e cobertura de 45% NTSC na exibição de cores, que pode ser um fator limitante para quem trabalha com edição de imagens.
O processador tem oito núcleos e 12 threads e trabalha com gráficos integrados Intel UHD. Neste modelo, são 16 GB de memória DDR5, divididos entre 8 GB soldados e 8 GB em módulo SODIMM, além de SSD de 512 GB. O conjunto atende a tarefas de produtividade, estudos, navegação e multitarefa, mas não para jogos pesados.
Entre as conexões estão USB-C, duas USB-A, HDMI 1.4, leitor de cartões SD e entrada combinada para fones e microfone, além de Wi-Fi 6 e Bluetooth 5.3. A webcam tem resolução HD de 720p, microfones duplos e obturador de privacidade, enquanto a bateria tem capacidade de 50 Wh.
O Acer Aspire Go 15 tem tela touch de 15,6 polegadas com o processador Intel Core i5-13420H em um formato tradicional de notebook. O display Full HD tem resolução de 1.920 x 1.080 pixels, proporção 16:9 e taxa de atualização de 60 Hz.
Seu processador de 13ª geração tem oito núcleos e 12 threads e trabalha com gráficos integrados Intel UHD — então não espere alto desempenho em jogos. A configuração traz 8 GB de RAM DDR5 e SSD NVMe de 512 GB, que atendem a tarefas cotidianas e multitarefa moderada.
O equipamento pesa cerca de 1,8 kg e inclui teclado numérico. A conectividade inclui Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth, USB-C e HDMI 2.1, além de entrada para fones. O sistema operacional é o Windows 11 Home.
O Dell Inspiron 14 2 em 1 tem uma dobradiça de 360 graus para mudar entre os formatos notebook, tablet, tenda e suporte. A tela touch de 14 polegadas acompanha essa proposta, permitindo navegar com os dedos ou utilizar uma caneta da Dell, vendida separadamente.
O processamento fica por conta do Intel Core i5-1334U de 13ª geração, com 10 núcleos e 12 threads, acompanhado de 16 GB de RAM DDR5 em dois módulos de 8 GB e SSD NVMe de 512 GB. Os 16 GB oferecem uma margem maior para manter vários aplicativos abertos simultaneamente, enquanto os gráficos integrados Intel atendem à proposta de produtividade.
A tela WVA tem 1.920 x 1.200 pixels, proporção 16:10, sistema antirreflexo e brilho de 250 nits. Para videochamadas, há webcam Full HD e microfones com recursos de redução de ruído. Nas conexões, tem duas USB-A, duas USB-C com Power Delivery e DisplayPort, HDMI e leitor de cartão SD, além de Wi-Fi 6E.
A escolha de um notebook touchscreen deve considerar os seguintes pontos:
O Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 é um dos notebooks com melhor custo-benefício, combinando tela WUXGA touch de 15,3 polegadas, Intel Core i5 de 13ª geração, 16 GB de RAM e SSD de 512 GB. A configuração atende a tarefas de produtividade, estudos, navegação e multitarefa, sem precisar investir em um modelo mais caro.
O ASUS Zenbook Duo reúne o hardware mais avançado entre os modelos desta seleção, com Intel Core Ultra 9 185H, 16 GB de RAM LPDDR5X e SSD de 1 TB.
O notebook também está disponível com 32 GB de RAM, além de ter duas telas OLED touch e gráficos integrados Intel Arc, em conjunto com uma NPU para tarefas de inteligência artificial.
Notebooks com tela sensível ao toque podem ser úteis para navegação, leitura, apresentações, anotações e interação direta com aplicativos. A tela touch ganha ainda mais utilidade em notebooks 2 em 1, que podem ser usados como tablets.
Para quem utiliza o computador principalmente com teclado e mouse, porém, o recurso pode não fazer tanta diferença no dia a dia.
Um notebook touchscreen tradicional mantém o formato convencional de notebook, mas permite controlar o sistema pelo toque na tela.
Já um modelo 2 em 1 possui uma estrutura que permite alterar sua posição, normalmente por meio de uma dobradiça de 360 graus. Assim, pode ser utilizado nos formatos notebook, tablet, tenda ou suporte, dependendo do modelo.
O touchscreen pode contribuir para o consumo de energia, mas não é o único fator que determina a autonomia do notebook. O tipo de processador, brilho da tela, taxa de atualização, capacidade da bateria e tipo de uso influenciam muito mais no consumo de energia.
Nem todo notebook touchscreen é compatível com caneta digital. É necessário verificar se o fabricante especifica suporte a uma caneta e qual tecnologia ou modelo é compatível.
O Galaxy Book3 360, por exemplo, é compatível com a S Pen, enquanto o Dell Inspiron 14 2 em 1 aceita uma caneta ativa da Dell vendida separadamente.
Sim. No Windows 11, é possível desativar a tela touch pelo Gerenciador de Dispositivos:
A tela deixará de responder ao toque, mas o notebook continuará funcionando normalmente pelo teclado, touchpad ou mouse. Para reativar o recurso, basta seguir o mesmo caminho e escolher “Habilitar dispositivo”.

Its longevity and features make it a great deal, but the Razer Wolverine V3 Pro for only $94.99 is an even better one. Grab yours now while it's still in stock.

articles.title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4: mecánicas, reglas y recompensas del modo DMZ
articles.text:
El modo DMZ llegará a Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 junto con la Campaña y el Multijugador. La novedad será la Base de Operaciones de Avanzada, un centro de comando que evolucionará a medida que los jugadores completen operaciones en Hajin.
Según el blog oficial latinoamericano de PlayStation, DMZ será un modo de extracción en el que los jugadores deberán combatir, reunir botín y cumplir objetivos para mejorar su rendimiento durante cada despliegue. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 se lanzará el 23 de octubre de 2026.
La Base de Operaciones de Avanzada, también conocida como FOB, permitirá gestionar el progreso, preparar el equipo y planificar las siguientes partidas.
A medida que se realicen despliegues exitosos en Hajin, el centro pasará de ser un punto de apoyo a una base operativa con más de una docena de estaciones.
Qué trae el modo DMZ de Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
Los jugadores podrán elegir entre tres opciones de despliegue y avanzar a través de Misiones de Historia, Operaciones Dinámicas y Órdenes. Estas actividades otorgarán equipo y XP dentro de DMZ.
Otra de las mecánicas será la caza de Lugartenientes y Comandantes, enemigos que recorrerán distintas zonas de Hajin. Al derrotarlos, los jugadores recibirán XP, armas y botín de alto valor.
El botín obtenido durante los despliegues podrá utilizarse en la Impresora 3D de la Base de Operaciones de Avanzada para conseguir nuevos artículos y mejorar la puntuación de partida.
El Informe de la Misión evaluará el combate, los objetivos cumplidos y los objetos recogidos; alcanzar un rendimiento de Rango S o superior permitirá acceder a las mejores recompensas.
Los vehículos también serán parte de la experiencia, con opciones para viajar por tierra, agua y aire.
Además, cada zona de Hajin tendrá un nivel de amenaza propio: hacer ruido puede provocar una respuesta enemiga más intensa, por lo que el sigilo será una alternativa durante los despliegues.
Call of Duty: Warzone dejará ocultar los aspectos no militares y skins poco realistas
Call of Duty: Warzone incorporará un filtro para ocultar en pantalla los operadores y aspectos de apariencia no militar o poco realista con el inicio de la Temporada 1 de Modern Warfare 4.
Activision llamó a la herramienta Operator Skin Toggle y precisó que su efecto será individual: modificará solo los personajes que vea quien la active, sin alterar la apariencia que reciben otros usuarios.
Al encender la opción, el sistema sustituirá los operadores y aspectos de juegos anteriores por personajes de Modern Warfare 4. El reemplazo se aplicará a enemigos, integrantes del grupo y compañeros de escuadrón, tanto en la sala de espera como durante las partidas.
Sin embargo, cada jugador conservará en su pantalla el operador que haya equipado, aunque pertenezca a otra entrega. La configuración estará desactivada de forma predeterminada y no eliminará contenidos comprados o desbloqueados.
Las armas procedentes de Modern Warfare II, Modern Warfare III, Black Ops 6 y Black Ops 7 seguirán disponibles en la pestaña Legado.
No obstante, los equipamientos personalizados y la función Armero no serán compatibles con ellas ni con planos antiguos.
Cada arma base tendrá cinco accesorios. Raven Software actualizará el equilibrio de armas cada dos semanas durante las temporadas del videojuego gratuito de Activision.
De qué trata Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 sitúa su campaña en una guerra que estalla en la península coreana tras una invasión a gran escala de Corea del Norte. La historia sigue a un grupo de soldados surcoreanos que combate para sobrevivir en un frente que se desmorona.
En paralelo, el capitán Price opera desde las sombras mientras intenta evadir a quienes lo persiguen.
Ambas líneas narrativas convergen cuando la misión de Price se relaciona con las fuerzas detrás de la invasión. El juego combinará Campaña, Multijugador y el modo de extracción DMZ, que se desarrollará en Hajin desde su lanzamiento.

articles.title: Mictosoft la laisse fuiter : la future Xbox Elite Controller 3 se dévoile avant l'heure
articles.text:
Une nouvelle manette en préparation chez Microsoft ? Avec la future Xbox Elite Controller 3, les évolutions seraient nombreuses par rapport à la version 2. La manette pourrait bien être présentée dans les prochaines semaines.
Sept ans après la manette Xbox Elite Series 2, des informations concernant sa remplaçante se dévoilent. Des détails techniques sur la potentielle "Xbox Elite Controller 3" ont été découverts dans l'interface d'arrière-plan du Xbox Design Lab, l'outil en ligne de Microsoft permettant de personnaliser ses périphériques.
De nouveaux joysticks
La fuite a été identifiée par un utilisateur de la plateforme Reddit, nommé u/esketitethan. En analysant le système du Xbox Design Lab, ce dernier a mis au jour des registres de configuration ainsi que 16 modèles 3D de composants. Selon les éléments trouvés par le leaker, cette nouvelle manette porterait le nom interne de "Edessa".
Au programme, Microsoft travaillerait sur de nouveaux joysticks analogiques cette fois. Si le modèle précédent reposait sur des potentiomètres, qui pouvaient causer des problèmes de dérive, la nouvelle version pourrait corriger cela.
Microsoft opterait en effet pour des joysticks à effet Hall et TMR (magnétorésistance tunnel). Ce choix indique un recours à une technologie de détection magnétique, ainsi que la possibilité de proposer différents niveaux de résistance des joysticks en question. Ces derniers devraient être silencieux et les frottements devraient être réduits.
Un système de vibration repensé et bien d'autres nouveautés
Le système de vibration quant à lui, ferait également l'objet d'une mise à jour. Les moteurs seraient remplacés par des modèles à bobine mobile, ce qui permettrait d'offrir un retour haptique plus avancé, mais également des vibrations au niveau des gâchettes. Des technologies similaires à celles de la manette DualSense de la PlayStation 5.
- Niveau de finition exemplaire
- Grip généralisé sur les poignées
- Gâchettes et palettes plus abouties
D'autres fonctionnalités et options de personnalisation sont répertoriées dans les données extraites (dont le lien n'est plus disponible à l'heure actuelle) :
- Contrôles audio : l'intégration d'une molette dédiée au réglage du volume.
- Croix directionnelles : plusieurs options au choix (standard, en croix, ou à facettes avec surface adhérente).
- Palettes arrière : de nouveaux formats (standard, classique et double largeur), permettant d'obtenir jusqu'à 27 configurations combinées entre les embouts de sticks et les palettes.
- Esthétique : des façades déclinées en métal, avec des motifs thématiques, de nombreuses couleurs et la possibilité d'ajouter une gravure.
Quatre versions au total ?
D'un point de vue purement commercial, l'offre serait composée de quatre déclinaisons. On retrouverait notamment les versions "Elite Complete" et "Elite Base", proposées chacune avec ou sans moteurs de vibration.
Ces informations sont toutefois à prendre avec des pincettes, l'accès aux fichiers sources n'étant comme sus-mentionné, plus disponible. Sur Reddit, certains utilisateurs doutent de la capacité de Microsoft à concevoir ses propres joysticks à effet Hall sans dérives. D'autres déplorent une potentielle absence de gyroscope intégré.
Ces informations techniques se recoupent avec la vente accidentelle d'un modèle physique "apparemment authentique". Elles suggèrent ainsi un lancement imminent de la future manette de Microsoft.

articles.title: Denmark Says Attackers Accessed CPR Data for 8.8 Million People via Company Account
articles.text:
Unauthorized parties have gained access to the names, addresses, and personal identification numbers of about 8.8 million people, living and dead, in Denmark's national population register, the country's digitalization ministry said on October 5.
They used a private Danish company's lawful right to look up records in the Central Person Register (CPR). The ministry has told people never to give passwords or other confidential information to anyone who calls or emails, even someone who seems to know those details.
The register's administration has stopped the company's access and reported the case to Datatilsynet, Denmark's data protection authority. Police are investigating.
A very large number of automated lookups were made in the register to identify valid personal identification numbers, known as CPR numbers, Datatilsynet said in a notice on October 5. Its account comes from the notification it received from the register a day earlier. It has not yet assessed the case and describes the numbers as allegedly retrieved.
The access lasted about 10 days in September and went through a small Danish company, according to Christina Egelund, the minister responsible for digitalization, who spoke to the news agency Ritzau. An employee of the register's administration noticed the unusual activity on Friday, October 2. Over the weekend, the administration learned how many people's records were involved.
The official statements leave three questions open: how the unauthorized parties gained access to the company's systems, whether they have retained or used the data, and who they are.
Who Is Covered
The 8.8 million figure is the ministry's and is not yet final. It counts registered people: living residents, people who have moved abroad, the dead, and others. The register holds about 11 million people in all, which means the access covered about 4 in 5 of them.
Since 1968, the register has recorded everyone who lives or has lived in Denmark. Denmark's population was just under 6 million at the start of 2025, according to Statistics Denmark.
The access stayed within the data that private companies are allowed to receive, and it did not include the names and addresses of people registered with name-and-address protection, the ministry said. That status, in most cases, prevents the register from disclosing a person's name and address to private companies or individuals.
The ministry's statement does not say whether those people's CPR numbers were reached, or whether anyone will be told individually that they are among the 8.8 million.
What People With a CPR Number Can Do
The ministry points people to the advice site sikkerdigital.dk, which lists four steps to guard against fraud:
- Be extra alert to unexpected text messages, calls, and emails in which the sender uses details about you.
- Do not click links in unexpected messages. Go to the official website yourself, or call the sender's main number to check.
- Never share MitID details, one-time codes, passwords, or card details.
- Set up a credit warning on borger.dk.
The Cyberhotline for digital security, a government-run help line on +45 33 37 00 37, can help with these steps. It has longer opening hours, from 8 a.m. to midnight, in the days after the announcement.
A credit warning is a marker in the CPR indicating that the holder wants companies to be warned against extending loans or credit in their name. It works as a signal. Companies that choose to receive it are asked to take extra care when checking identity before lending, according to borger.dk, the site where the marker is set.
A new marker is registered at once but can take some days to reach companies' systems. Anyone aged 15 or over can set one, and it can make the holder's loan applications harder to approve until it is removed.
A CPR number helps identify a person but must not be used as the only proof of identity, according to the register's official guidance.
How Companies Get Access to the Register
Under the 2023 text of Denmark's CPR Act, companies can have register data delivered on people they have already identified one by one. A CPR number alone is enough to identify a person for that purpose.
The data they can receive includes a person's current name and address, unless protected, and details such as a death, a move abroad, or a credit warning. The CPR number itself is not on that list.
A CPR number has 10 digits: 6 for the date of birth and 4 serial digits, the last of which is even for women and odd for men.
By The Hacker News's arithmetic, that format allows at most 10,000 possible numbers for each date of birth. Datatilsynet's notice says the lookups were made to identify valid numbers, but neither it nor the ministry's statement says whether they worked through those possibilities.
The register's guidance says companies may only get data on people they already deal with, such as customers or employees. The official statements do not explain how one company's access under those rules came to cover about 4 in 5 people on the register.
Under the act, the ministry responsible for the register sets the terms for company access, including security measures.
Egelund told Ritzau the safeguards around this kind of access had not been solid enough, and agreed that alarms should have gone off given how long it lasted.
What Happens Next
The ministry has begun measures to prevent a repeat, which its statement does not detail, and the minister has requested a full security review of the register.
Datatilsynet is examining what happened, how it could happen, and who is responsible for handling the personal data.
Egelund told Ritzau it was too early to say whether people will need new CPR numbers. The act already allows a new number in special cases where a person's number has been misused.

articles.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su Says 2027 Will Bring a "Substantial" Supply Increase
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 6th 2026
AMD CEO Lisa Su Says 2027 Will Bring a "Substantial" Supply Increase
AMD will "substantially" increase its chip supply in 2027, CEO Lisa Su told reporters in Taipei on Tuesday, while admitting that demand is still running ahead of what the company can ship. Su is on her third trip to Taiwan this year, meeting partners such as Foxconn, Quanta, Acer, and ASUS, with TSMC also on the schedule. She is reportedly heading to South Korea later this week to sit down with memory suppliers Samsung and SK Hynix. Here's what she said:
"We've been able to increase our supply as we've gone through 2026, and we're going to substantially increase our supply in 2027, but we can definitely use more. There's very, very high demand for the next several years. We can see very high demand, and so we need more advanced wafer capacity"
Su didn't put a number on the increase, so it's hard to say how much relief can be expected. She did say that AMD now plans capacity three to five years ahead, up from one to two years before, and that the company needs more advanced wafer capacity. Interestingly, she singled out CPUs when describing demand, so the shortage is apparently wider than AI accelerators. Supply won't depend on wafers alone, however. Su called CoWoS and advanced packaging "absolutely critical" for AMD's high-performance chips, and the company committed more than $10 billion to its Taiwan supply chain in May, a figure she now says will grow. However, there's no word on whether any of the extra supply will reach consumer Ryzen or Radeon products.

articles.title: La velocidad ideal del internet para ver Las Guerreras K-pop sin cortes y en 4K desde el Smart TV
articles.text:
Para ver Las Guerreras K-pop sin interrupciones y en resolución 4K desde un Smart TV, la conexión a internet debe sostener una velocidad suficiente durante toda la reproducción.
Netflix sugiere al menos 15 Mb/s para los contenidos en ultra alta definición (UHD), aunque la cifra disponible en el hogar puede variar según el uso simultáneo de otros dispositivos.
Qué velocidad de internet se necesita para cada calidad de imagen
Netflix establece distintos valores según la resolución seleccionada o disponible en cada dispositivo. Para la alta definición de 720p, la recomendación es de 3 Mb/s o más. Esa calidad puede ser suficiente en pantallas pequeñas, aunque presenta menos detalle que las opciones superiores.
La reproducción en alta definición completa, identificada como 1080p o FHD, requiere al menos 5 Mb/s. En tanto, el salto a ultra alta definición demanda 15 Mb/s o más.
La diferencia se explica por la cantidad de información que debe llegar al televisor: cuanto mayor es la resolución, más datos necesita descargar la conexión en cada instante.
Por qué la resolución puede bajar de calidad durante la película
La caída de resolución suele responder a un mecanismo automático de adaptación. Si la red pierde velocidad o presenta inestabilidad, Netflix reduce temporalmente la calidad del video para que la película continúe sin cortes. El resultado puede ser una imagen menos definida, con detalles borrosos o menor contraste en escenas con movimiento.
El problema no siempre depende del plan contratado. Una conexión que alcanza los 15 Mb/s en una medición puntual puede rendir menos en determinados horarios, cuando varios usuarios utilizan la misma red o cuando el Smart TV recibe una señal WiFi débil. Influyen la distancia al router, las paredes y la interferencia de otros aparatos inalámbricos.
Cómo saber si el Smart TV recibe suficiente velocidad de internet
Una primera medida consiste en realizar una prueba de velocidad desde el propio televisor, si el modelo tiene esa función, o desde un dispositivo conectado a la misma red WiFi. La medición debe acercarse o superar los 15 Mb/s para sostener la reproducción de la película en UHD.
Es útil hacer la prueba mientras otros aparatos de la casa están en uso. Ese escenario ofrece una referencia más cercana a las condiciones reales de reproducción. Si la velocidad baja por debajo del mínimo o fluctúa de forma frecuente, el contenido podría iniciar en 4K y luego pasar a una resolución menor.
Qué cambios ayudan a mejorar la velocidad del WiFi en el televisor
Acercar el router al Smart TV, siempre que sea posible, reduce la pérdida de señal. El dispositivo debe ubicarse en un lugar abierto, alejado de muebles cerrados, objetos metálicos y obstáculos gruesos. Colocarlo a mayor altura puede favorecer la distribución de la red dentro del hogar.
Otra alternativa es desconectar de manera temporal los dispositivos que no se utilicen mientras se reproduce la película. Pausar descargas, copias de seguridad y transmisiones en otros televisores libera ancho de banda.
Asimismo, si el router cuenta con redes de 2,4 GHz y 5 GHz, la segunda suele ofrecer mayor velocidad a distancias cortas, aunque tiene menor alcance.
Por qué se debe conectar el Smart TV por cable de red
La conexión mediante cable Ethernet suele ofrecer más estabilidad que el WiFi, porque evita parte de las interferencias y pérdidas de señal inalámbrica. Para un televisor que permanece cerca del router, esta opción puede ayudar a mantener los 15 Mb/s mínimos requeridos para 4K sin variaciones frecuentes.
Si instalar un cable no es viable, un repetidor WiFi puede ampliar la cobertura en habitaciones alejadas. La elección depende de la distribución de la vivienda y de la distancia entre el router y el televisor.

Le smartphone Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge 512 Go passe sous les 1000 € chez Amazon Prime soit une baisse d'environ 23% sur le prix habituellement constaté.
Le Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge constitue un ajout inédit à la série Galaxy S25. Situé entre un Galaxy S25+ et un Galaxy S25 Ultra, le smartphone compte sur sa finesse pour séduire ceux à qui le design importe avant toute chose.

Points faibles
- Tendance à la chauffe.

Le design doit servir l'usage. Qu'en est-il du Galaxy S25 Edge de Samsung ? Sa finesse record, mais avant tout son poids plume rendent son utilisation quotidienne pratique. Ce terminal mobile combine la légèreté d'un petit smartphone et la diagonale d'écran confortable de ceux que l'on appelait jadis les “phablettes”. Est-ce vraiment ce que vous recherchez en tant qu'utilisateur ? La réponse vous appartient, mais il vous faudra tout de même être convaincu pour investir dans ce smartphone, certes plus mince qu'un Galaxy S25+, mais moins endurant et polyvalent en termes de capture photo, malgré un tarif de lancement supérieur. Enfin, au-delà du positionnement tarifaire de ce mobile, Samsung parvient à éviter le double écueil des performances en berne et de l'autonomie famélique, ce que nous craignions au vu des caractéristiques matérielles de son S25 Edge. C'est sans doute ce qui mérite d'être retenu et peut ouvrir la voie à d'autres itérations.

Son format compact, son écran réussi et sa puce surpuissante et économe en énergie en font un modèle aussi fluide qu’endurant. L’expérience photo gagne en précision, même si tout n’est pas parfait, notamment du côté du téléobjectif. On peut aussi regretter une puissance de charge encore limitée par rapport à la concurrence. Cependant, l’expérience offerte par One UI 7 et les nombreuses fonctions d’IA apportent un vent de modernité. À moins de posséder le modèle de 2024, cette itération est donc hautement recommandable. Samsung prouve ici que dans la tech comme en amour, il ne faut pas se fier aux apparences, et que l’important, c’est ce qu’il y a à l’intérieur.

articles.title: Borderlands Online MMO Back from Cancellation Thanks to Community Project
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 6th 2026
Borderlands Online MMO Back from Cancellation Thanks to Community Project
It seems as though the Borderlands franchise still has its hardcore fanbase, with recent projects, like Project Moonshot that merged Borderlands 2 and The Pre-Sequel into one mega-game being just one example. Following that announcement, a developer known as EpicNNG on YouTube and X has revealed that his work on reviving the cancelled China-exclusive Borderlands Online has finally concluded in a functional game. 
The project is the culmination of over a year of work by the developer and community members, who used a leaked build of the 2015 game, which was cancelled before it ever launched. Borderlands Online is, as of October 4, 2026, playable for free and available on the dedicated Borderlands Online site. According to the YouTube video announcing the completion of the project, getting Borderlands Online into a playable state required significant efforts, including everything from translation and restoration to UI customization. Borderlands Online features online servers with login and account functionality, and there is an easy-to-follow set of instructions on the project website.The developer noted that Gearbox and 2K Games are aware of the game project, but have yet to take any actual legal action, but this fear of potential legal action is one of the motivations for publishing the game in a free-to-play state. The threat of legal action is also why the development team has been relatively silent after the initial boost from announcing the project's existence. There is also an offline game mode in the event that the game project gets taken down.The original game files used to build Borderlands Online were obtained from a publicly hosted source in China, and the development team has kept as much of the original build of the game in the final version as possible, with changes being made mostly to fix UI spacing, enemy and NPC behaviors, and loading screens, since the whole game was designed for Chinese characters, which meant UI elements and loading screens had to be built from scratch to preserve visual quality.

articles.title: Malgré des projets communautaires, Valve rappelle que Steam sur Linux Arm n'est pas pris en charge
articles.text:
Valve met les points sur les « i » alors que les projets autour de Linux Arm se multiplient dans le sillage de la sortie du Steam Frame.
À toutes fins utiles, Valve rappelle que Steam pour Linux ne prend toujours pas officiellement en charge les plateformes Arm. Une position qui contraste avec le lancement du Steam Frame, un casque conçu autour du Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 avec une architecture Arm64.
Un client Steam Arm64, mais pas de support officiel
Les projets communautaires se multiplient et plusieurs utilisateurs ont annoncé avoir réussi à faire tourner des portages de SteamOS sur diverses machines à base de processeur Arm.
Ainsi, un ambitieux projet récemment mis en avant par le site RetroHandhelds a permis de découvrir le travail de l'équipe Rocknix. Ces derniers ont récemment annoncé que Steam est désormais pris en charge et qu'il permet des jeux Linux natifs ainsi que des jeux Windows via Proton. Une fonctionnalité accessible à des machines à base de Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 comme l'AYN Odin 2 ou la Retroid Pocket 6 par exemple.
Il ne faut toutefois pas prendre cette réussite de l'équipe Rocknix pour un cas général. Ainsi, un utilisateur de console AYN Odin 3 a remonté un bug sur sa console équipée d'une puce Snapdragon 8 Elite et utilisant une version native Arm64 du client Steam. Le bug en question est lié au décodage matériel de vidéos AV1 sur sa console. En effet, les capacités AV1 de la puce Qualcomm ne seraient pas exploitées par Steam.
En réponse au signalement du bug par l'usager sur la plateforme de suivi de la version bêta du client Steam pour Linux Arm64, Valve a été très clair. Tout d'abord, le signalement en question a été fermé. Dans un second temps, Valve a précisé que Steam pour Linux n'est pas actuellement pris en charge sur les appareils Arm. Une fin de non-recevoir en quelque sorte.
Le Steam Frame reste une exception
La situation peut sembler paradoxale pour un profane car Valve dispose pourtant bien d'un client Steam natif pour les plateformes Arm64. Comme toujours, le diable se cache dans les détails.
En effet, si Valve dispose bien d'une telle version, elle est avant tout destinée à ses propres solutions matérielles. Elle n'a donc pas vocation à être utilisée sur tous les appareils – et ils sont nombreux – sur base Arm64. Si Valve a créé une telle variante, c'est avant tout pour la sortie du Steam Frame, son casque de réalité virtuelle dont l'architecture Arm64 repose sur le processeur Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 conçu par Qualcomm.
Le Steam Frame fonctionne bel et bien sur SteamOS, mais nous touchons là aux limites du support logiciel. Valve maîtrise tout sur le Steam Frame et peut donc être plus serein quant à la compatibilité logicielle. En revanche, il n'est pour l'heure pas question de prendre en charge la grande variété de machines plus ou moins proches, comme la console AYN Odin 3. Matériel, configuration, pilotes graphiques, les variations sont nombreuses et annoncer une prise en charge officielle engendrerait bien plus de travail pour les équipes support.
Pour l'utilisateur lambda, cette petite histoire rappelle que la mise à disposition d'un logiciel et son support sont deux choses bien différentes. Valve propose bien une version Arm64 de Steam, mais pour son propre matériel et il n'est pas (encore ?) question de gérer les autres appareils Linux Arm.

articles.title: Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus falls to its lowest price ever at $145 — grab an 18-core midrange CPU with 5.3 GHz boost at an entry-level price [Sold Out]
articles.text:
Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus falls to its lowest price ever at $145 — grab an 18-core midrange CPU with 5.3 GHz boost at an entry-level price [Sold Out]
The Core Ultra 5 250K Plus offers just keep getting better.
This deal has sold out. The best price currently on the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus is $210 at Newegg.
The Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus is down to its lowest price ever, with Amazon slashing 34% off the list price to bring it down to $145. That's even cheaper than the lowest price we've seen on the Core Ultra 5 250KF. Despite being priced like an entry-level CPU, the 250K Plus ranks among our best CPUs for gaming.
The Core Ultra 5 250K Plus originally launched for $200, but it didn't take long for its recommended price to climb to $220. That's likely because it punches far above what its price would suggest, even at full MSRP. It, along with the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus, was framed as a last-ditch effort to bring Arrow Lake to the masses after the failed launch of the original range.
All-time low price
The 18-core Core Ultra 5 250K Plus comes from Intel's Arrow Lake Refresh family. It sports a 5.3 GHz boost clock and six Lion Cove P-cores, alongside 12 Skymont E-cores. 
And the refresh has worked. The Ultra 5 250K Plus is an 18-core CPU with a split between six Lion Cove P-cores and 12 Skymont E-cores. As with all Arrow Lake CPUs, the 250K Plus doesn't have Hyper-Threading, but having 18C/18T isn't too shabby, with its AMD arch rival offering 6C/12T. The chip comes with a maximum boost clock of 5.3 GHz, and a PL1/PL2 power of 125W/250W. As it's an unlocked K-series processor, you can overclock the chip, though you'll need to pair it with a more pricey Z-series chipset.
Although we almost always recommend a Z-series chipset with a K-series SKU, there actually isn't a locked version of the 250K Plus. Further, many of the OC improvements are baked into the chip, including a 900 MHz bump in die-to-die frequency and a 400 MHz increase in memory fabric speed. Overclocking is a big upside, though it's not strictly required, especially when we're looking at a $145 CPU.
Although the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus is priced like an entry-level CPU, it performs much better than its current sales price would suggest, particularly in productivity workloads. You can see the results for the 250K Plus from our CPU benchmark hierarchy in the gallery below.
View Original
View Original
View Original
View Original
The 18 cores and threads help Intel's mid-ranger punch up in multithreaded performance. The chip is 33% faster in our multithreaded productivity geomean compared to AMD's competing Ryzen 7 9700X, despite Team Red's chip costing twice as much right now. Compared to the Ryzen 5 9600X that's in the same price bracket, Intel is a massive 80% ahead. Check out our Intel Core Ultra 250K Plus vs AMD Ryzen 5 9600X faceoff feature for more about that particular battle.
Intel's multithreaded performance here isn't a result of simply throwing a ton of weak cores at the problem. As you can see from our single-threaded rankings, the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus came out ahead of every AMD offering we tested, including the flagship Ryzen 9 9950X. Last-gen's Core i9-14900K is slightly faster, though it also costs nearly three times as much.
Gaming is where Intel has started to take a backseat to AMD, and the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus slips some rankings. On average, the chip is about as fast as the Core i5-14600K. That's marginally faster than the Ryzen 5 9600X and about 3% behind the Ryzen 7 9700X. AMD's Ryzen 5 7600X3D is about 10% faster, though in this current Core Ultra 5 250K Plus sale, Intel's CPU is about $100 cheaper.
At under $150, just getting a competent CPU is tough — just see our list of the best budget CPUs — and the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus is more than competent. Don't miss this deal on Amazon.

articles.title: Anthropic folds Project Glasswing into an expanded three-tier Cyber Verification Program - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Anthropic folds Project Glasswing into an expanded three-tier Cyber Verification Program
Anthropic PBC today expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers of access for vetted security teams, with fewer blocks on cybersecurity work at each step up.
The overhaul is aimed at a restriction Anthropic built into its own products. Because the company treats cybersecurity as dual-use, its generally available models carry conservative classifiers that block most cyber work. When Claude Opus 5.5 launched Sept. 22, most security tasks sent to it were routed to the older Opus 4.8.
Anthropic is folding Project Glasswing into the program at the same time. Since April, Glasswing has given Claude Mythos access to organizations that secure critical software, and Anthropic widened it to 150 more organizations in June. Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are available at every tier of the new structure, and later models will be added as they ship.
Defense Access is the entry tier, meant for defensive jobs such as incident response and malware reverse engineering. Security teams defending systems they own or maintain qualify, whether they work for a company, a university or a government body.
Individual researchers with a record of reported vulnerabilities can apply too, as can critical infrastructure operators as small as a regional hospital. Anthropic expects many organizations doing defensive work to qualify and is aiming to respond to applications within a few days.
Red Team Access opens up authorized penetration testing and red-teaming against systems an organization has permission to test. Even at this level, Anthropic’s classifiers block requests in real time when the work moves toward something like deploying ransomware. Applicants wait a few weeks for a review and sit in the Defense Access tier in the meantime, and individual researchers are shut out of the tier for now.
Specialized Access carries the fewest cyber blocks of the three. Only organizations cleared to test safety systems like power grids and telecom networks qualify, since failures there could put lives at risk or disrupt markets. Anthropic vets each of them in depth with the U.S. government, and existing Glasswing members move straight into the tier without reapproval for current models.
Enrolled organizations must allow data retention so Anthropic can watch for misuse. Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, due later this year, will let eligible customers keep that data in cloud infrastructure they control.
Anthropic tested the tiers on the multistage cyber operations benchmark CyScenarioBench, with Claude Opus 5.5 running each of its 10 challenges five times. Every attempt without program access was blocked on the first prompt. Because the scenarios are offensive, Anthropic had expected heavy blocking in the Defense Access tier, where 46 of the 50 runs were stopped at some point.
At the Red Team level nothing was blocked and the model finished 34 of its 50 runs. Anthropic said that result is effectively the same as the model’s 67.6% success rate with no safeguards applied.
Outside the lab, the argument for widening access comes from the Mythos program the new structure absorbs. Partners in Project Glasswing found at least 129,000 verified vulnerabilities between April and July, and Anthropic’s own scanning of open-source code turned up 5,500 more through October. Of that combined total, more than 33,000 have been rated critical or high severity.
The figures draw on just 33 partner reports, and the company said the true impact is likely at least five times higher. Fewer than half of the partners disclosed patch counts, often because fixes were still underway.
The program is available through the Claude Platform, Google LLC’s Vertex AI and Microsoft Corp.’s Foundry service. On Amazon Web Services Inc.’s Bedrock, it is limited to customers eligible for Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

articles.title: ClickFix Smuggles Payloads Through Browser Cache to Bypass Windows Run Limits
articles.text:
A new type of ClickFix attack is using compromised websites to trick users into executing a malicious payload cached in a web browser's cache.
"Instead of downloading and executing remote payloads like the typical attack pattern, in this attack, the websites pre-fetch a script payload into the browser cache disguised as a PNG file," the Microsoft Threat Intelligence team said in a post on X.
Thus, when the victim is prompted to paste and execute a malicious command – as is the case with ClickFix attacks – it executes the cached website content that's already on the device.
What's notable about this browser cache smuggling approach is that it allows the attackers to conceal the payload script and bypass character limit restrictions imposed on Windows Run (aka the Run dialog). The Windows Run dialog, triggered by Win + R, truncates any input that exceeds approximately 260 characters.
In the attack chain observed by Microsoft, the staged payload is a Visual Basic Script (VBScript), which then invokes "cmd.exe" to recursively enumerate files whose names start with "f_" in the browser's profile folder such as "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles."
"It compares each file's byte length with an expected value," Microsoft explained. "Rather than searching for a marker within the contents like previous attacks, it copies a size-matching cache entry to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\t.vbs, giving the cached payload a VBScript extension, then executes it with wscript.exe. Copy output and errors are suppressed. The expected size varies across variants."
The VBScript is also designed to harvest host information via Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI), fetch a PowerShell script ("v.ps1") from an external server ("cocojambo[.]us[.]com/alfa"), and then launch it. The PowerShell script serves as a conduit for an intermediate PowerShell payload that's responsible for downloading the next stage ("cab.dat").
Once the file is downloaded, its contents are read and executed in a hidden window. The attack eventually paves the way for .NET assemblies that are loaded into memory and inject code into a newly launched legitimate Windows process ("timeout.exe") with an aim to target browser and device credentials.
What's more, the injected process launches PowerShell to obtain a secondary in-memory stage from "capsysnet[.]vg" and initiate outbound connections to "ciliabula[.]cc."
This is not the first time payloads have been staged in the browser cache as part of ClickFix attacks. In October 2025, Expel documented an attack chain that employed cache smuggling to deliver a malware-laced ZIP archive. The activity was subsequently identified as a red team engagement conducted by Intrinsec.
ClickFix has become an exceedingly popular social engineering technique over the past two years. The fact that the attack turns the victim into a delivery channel for executing malware has made it an attractive initial access method for cybercriminals and nation-state actors alike.
In a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit released in August 2025, CloudSEK demonstrated how artificial intelligence (AI) summarization systems embedded in email clients, browser extensions, and productivity platforms can be weaponized to deliver ransomware via ClickFix.
Specifically, the payloads are embedded within HTML content using CSS-based obfuscation methods, such as zero-width characters, white-on-white text, and off-screen positioning, that make them invisible to the human eye, but are parsed by AI systems. This invisible prompt injection is then used to generate summaries containing attacker-controlled ClickFix instructions.
The attack employs a method known as prompt overdose to repeat the payload dozens of times so that it dominates the model's context window and steers output generation.
"When such crafted content is indexed, shared, or emailed, any automated summarization process that ingests it will produce summaries containing attacker-controlled ClickFix instructions," CloudSEK said. "The observed outcome confirms that prompt overdose in conjunction with invisible injection can successfully override legitimate context within summarizers."
The ClickFix ecosystem has evolved considerably since its early days, fueled by the availability of phishing kits like IUAM that can automate the creation of "Fix-type" attacks. The commoditization has further lowered the barrier to entry and accelerated the frequency of these campaigns.
The anatomy of a ClickFix attack is a multi-step chain -
- Lead victims to a fake (or compromised) website that hosts the ClickFix lure either via phishing emails or malvertising.
- Serve the problem trigger (e.g., fake error, CAPTCHA, or browser update)
- Provide the "solution" and instruct the user to copy a command to address it. Select variants use JavaScript to manipulate the system's clipboard and copy the command.
- The user is then asked to paste the copied command into the Windows Run dialog, PowerShell, Windows Terminal, macOS Terminal, or another trusted system utility.
- The command retrieves additional payloads, leading to malware deployment.
According to CrowdStrike, incidents involving fake CAPTCHA lures have witnessed a staggering 563% increase in 2025.
ClickFix is effective because it persuades users to run attacker-supplied commands under the pretext of CAPTCHA verifications, browser updates, or unexpected errors -- situations users routinely encounter. The attack capitalizes on this "troubleshooting" theme to trick them into infecting their own systems, effectively bypassing security controls.
"Employees regularly deal with broken meetings, authentication challenges, CAPTCHA prompts, browser errors, and application issues," CrowdStrike said. "A prompt telling someone to perform a quick troubleshooting step can feel far less suspicious than an unexpected executable or email attachment."
Another reason why ClickFix works is that it relies on standard tools users have come to trust. Rather than asking users to download an unfamiliar program that may raise suspicion, it leverages built-in components of Windows and Mac, such as PowerShell, Windows Run, and Terminal, to activate the attack chain.
"ClickFix attacks combine psychological manipulation with the abuse of legitimate operating-system tools," Bob Erdman, associate vice president of research and development at Fortra, said. "The dangerous part is that you execute the command yourself. Instead of breaking into the computer directly, the attacker convinces you to open the door."
In one campaign analyzed by CTM360, threat actors have been observed leveraging known vulnerabilities in WordPress plugins (e.g., CVE-2026-6854) to seize control of websites and inject ClickFix lures. The injected script then employs the EtherHiding technique to retrieve the active lure hostname.
The blockchain-based mechanism offers additional advantages in that an attacker can make on-chain updates to facilitate infrastructure rotation without modifying the compromised site. More than 3,000 actively compromised websites have been identified as hosting fake pages, per CTM360, with the attack chains leading to Vidar Stealer.
"ClickFix presents fewer malware signals of the sort that traditional defenses are calibrated to detect," ReversingLabs said in a July 2026 report. "Campaigns play out quickly, with shifting infrastructure intended to evade detection based on historic indicators."
CrowdStrike, for its part, said it observed the North Korea-aligned Stardust Chollima (aka BlueNoroff) cluster likely targeting an employee at a financial services entity in July 2026 using a bogus video conferencing site. Upon visiting the site, the employee is said to have encountered a fake technical issue along with a fix that instructed them to copy and paste a command.
The command is designed to trigger a PowerShell- and VBScript-based infection chain that delivers two previously undocumented malware families dubbed GeniexLoader and GeniexRAT.
Another nation-state threat actor linked to the use of ClickFix is Sandworm. The Russian state-sponsored adversary has been observed targeting suspected Ukrainian employees working at organizations in France, the U.S., and Canada with ClickFix attacks to deceive them into running PowerShell commands that download a VBScript payload. It's suspected that the ClickFix lures were delivered via compromised Ukrainian websites.
To counter the threat, Microsoft is recommending cloud-delivered, web, and network protection, application control, and PowerShell script-block logging. It's also urging organizations to go beyond download events and hunt for suspicious browser activity, RunMRU registry key, WScript/PowerShell child processes, and scheduled tasks.
"A CAPTCHA should not ask users to run code," it added. "Users should not paste commands from verification prompts into Run, Terminal, or PowerShell, and should treat such requests as potential initial access attempts."

Baixou: Huawei MatePad SE 11 fica 57% mais barato em promoção na Amazon
Huawei MatePad SE 11 utiliza tela de 11 polegadas, 128 GB de armazenamento e traz modo de proteção infantil; tablet lançado em 2026 chega antes do Dia das Crianças nas capitais
O Huawei MatePad SE 11 (128 GB) está em promoção na Amazon por R$ 854,13 no Pix. O valor está menor em relação a semana passada e representa um desconto de 57% em relação ao preço original de R$ 1.499.
Uma novidade lançada pela marca chinesa em 2026, o tablet conta com funcionalidades para leitura e modo de proteção infantil. Por isso, aproveite a oportunidade de garanti-lo mais barato para o Dia das Crianças 2026.
O modo eBook disponível ajusta o painel para reproduzir somente cores preto e branco. Em tese, o recurso auxilia a evitar a fadiga ocular para ler textos por muitas horas. Além disso, a tela TFT LCD de 11″ com resolução Full HD+ possui certificações TÜV Rheinland que emite menos luz azul e cintilações. Por isso, é um tablet indicado para leitura.
A bateria de 7.700 mAh assegura autonomia para um dia de uso, segundo a Huawei. Portanto, o Huawei MatePad SE 11 sugere aguentar a reprodução contínua de vídeos, desenhos e séries no streaming por longos períodos. Ainda assim, há o suporte a carregamento rápido com fio de 22,5 W.
O dispositivo pode ser uma opção interessante de presente para o Dia das Crianças por contar com a proteção de uso infantil. A função possibilita limitar conteúdos em apps como YouTube e gerenciar o tempo de uso de tela, fatores relevantes na infância e nem sempre existentes em tablets.
Em termos de construção, o tablet apresenta um corpo metálico e quatro alto-falantes embutidos que utilizam a tecnologia Huawei Histen 9.0, que na prática busca proporcionar uma experiência sonora envolvente. Por fim, conta com uma câmera traseira de 8 MP e frontal de 5 MP para tirar fotos básicas.
Para uso básico no dia a dia, o Huawei MatePad SE 11 (128 GB) com o sistema HarmonyOS 2.0 está disponível por $ 854,13 no Pix em oferta na Amazon e chega a tempo, pelo menos nas principais capitais, para o Dia das Crianças.

articles.title: Sony toma medidas contra la música generada con IA y exige eliminar más de 260.000 canciones
articles.text:
Sony Music ha solicitado a las plataformas digitales la retirada de más de 260.000 canciones generadas con inteligencia artificial que, según la compañía, imitan sin autorización a artistas de su catálogo. La cifra, comunicada por la discográfica al Financial Times, muestra cómo el contenido sintético se ha convertido en un nuevo frente para la industria musical.
El número de avisos se ha incrementado rápidamente. A finales de marzo de 2026, Sony había enviado solicitudes relacionadas con más de 135.000 pistas, mientras que un año antes la cifra superaba las 75.000. La compañía aclara que estos números corresponden a solicitudes de retirada y no significan que todas las canciones hayan sido eliminadas de manera definitiva.
Canciones que imitan a artistas reales
El conflicto no está relacionado con cualquier canción creada mediante inteligencia artificial. El principal problema para Sony son las grabaciones diseñadas para sonar como si hubieran sido interpretadas por artistas reales sin su autorización.
Entre los nombres afectados por este tipo de imitaciones aparecen Harry Styles, Adele, Britney Spears, Queen y Michael Jackson. Estas producciones pueden utilizar herramientas de IA para generar una voz o una interpretación que se asemeja a la de un músico conocido, aunque esa persona no haya participado en la grabación.
Este tipo de contenido suele describirse como deepfake musical. El término hace referencia a material sintético creado para atribuir a una persona una imagen, una voz o, en este caso, una interpretación que en realidad no realizó.
Para Sony, el problema tampoco termina cuando una plataforma responde a una denuncia. La discográfica sostiene que algunas de estas canciones vuelven a aparecer después de haber sido retiradas, lo que obliga a iniciar nuevamente el proceso de reclamación.
“Seguiremos haciendo valer los derechos de nuestros artistas y esperamos que las plataformas actúen rápidamente y eviten que el mismo contenido vuelva a aparecer”, señaló la compañía.
Sony no busca prohibir toda la inteligencia artificial
La postura de Sony no consiste en rechazar el uso de inteligencia artificial en la música. La compañía ha establecido una diferencia entre utilizar esta tecnología con autorización y emplearla para reproducir contenidos o identidades artísticas sin permiso.
En 2024, Sony comunicó que no autorizaba el uso de sus contenidos para entrenar, desarrollar o comercializar sistemas de inteligencia artificial, salvo que existiera un permiso específico. Al mismo tiempo, la discográfica ha participado en iniciativas basadas en música licenciada y ha establecido acuerdos relacionados con el desarrollo de tecnología de IA.
En julio de 2026, Sony también se sumó a otros grandes grupos musicales para proponer criterios sobre el uso de inteligencia artificial en las listas oficiales. La propuesta plantea que las grabaciones generadas con estas herramientas puedan participar cuando utilicen servicios autorizados, sean sustancialmente humanas y no presenten problemas de manipulación.
La música generada por IA crece en las plataformas
El volumen de canciones sintéticas ayuda a dimensionar el desafío. Deezer informó que durante junio de 2026 recibió una media diaria cercana a las 90.000 pistas completamente generadas con inteligencia artificial. En algunos días, estas producciones llegaron a representar más de la mitad de las nuevas canciones incorporadas al servicio.
Esto no significa que todas esas pistas sean imitaciones de artistas reales ni que puedan sumarse directamente a las reclamaciones de Sony. Sin embargo, evidencia el crecimiento acelerado de la música creada mediante IA y la dificultad de las plataformas para controlar todo el contenido que reciben.
Una disputa que también llega a la legislación
El debate comienza a trasladarse del sector musical a los legisladores estadounidenses. Sony respalda la NO FAKES Act, una iniciativa que busca establecer una protección federal frente a réplicas digitales no autorizadas de la voz y la apariencia de una persona.
El proyecto avanzó por unanimidad en el Comité Judicial del Senado de Estados Unidos el 18 de junio, aunque todavía no se ha convertido en ley.
Mientras la legislación continúa su recorrido, las plataformas y las discográficas enfrentan un problema cada vez mayor: determinar cuándo una canción creada con inteligencia artificial representa una nueva forma de creatividad y cuándo utiliza la identidad de un artista sin autorización. Para Sony, las más de 260.000 solicitudes de retirada son una muestra de que esa frontera ya está siendo puesta a prueba a gran escala.
