articles.title: Auchan Télécom et Carrefour Mobile : la bataille des prix sur les forfaits mobiles avec la carte de fidélité fait rage !
articles.text:
En l'espace de 24 heures, Carrefour Mobile et Auchan Télécom ont lancé des remises sur leurs forfaits mobiles, grâce aux cartes de fidélité des magasins. À distance, ce sont deux opérateurs qui s'opposent : Orange et Bouygues Telecom.
Entre Auchan Télécom et Carrefour Mobile, c'est une vraie guerre de tranchées qui a lieu. Dix ans après, le dernier cité, porté par le réseau d'Orange, fait son retour dans les rayons. En face, Auchan Télécom est porté par Bouygues Telecom. Les deux accordent des réductions sur les prix des forfaits mobiles qu'ils commercialisent, dans le cas où l'abonné détient une carte de fidélité du magasin. Ce mardi 6 octobre 2026, Auchan Télécom a répondu du tac au tac à Carrefour Mobile, qui avait dégainé la veille, pour exactement s'aligner sur ses tarifs. On fait le point sur qui propose quoi exactement, pour vous aider à y voir plus clair.
Auchan Télécom propose 2 euros de moins chaque mois sur la facture
Pour profiter d'une remise sur un forfait mobile Auchan Télécom, il faut détenir une carte de fidélité Waaoh! en cours de validité, et souscrire pour la première fois chez Auchan Télécom. L'enseigne rappelle que la carte est gratuite et disponible en magasin, même si les données personnes qu'elle nécessite ne la rend pas totalement gratuite. Marc Laurier, le directeur marketing grand public de Bouygues Telecom, parle d'« un avantage direct et immédiat » sur le budget mobile des fidèles de l'enseigne. Dans les faits, le forfait 20 Go passe de 7,99 euros à 5,99 euros, et le 130 Go de 10,99 euros à 8,99 euros. Ce sont deux offres 4G, sans engagement, avec appels et SMS illimités.
Le forfait haut de gamme s'adresse plutôt aux globe-trotteurs. Baptisé « Série spéciale Voyage », le forfait 200 Go en 5G tombe à 11,99 euros au lieu de 13,99 euros. Il embarque, toujours sans engagement, une enveloppe de 35 Go exploitables depuis plus de 160 destinations, avec l'Union européenne et les DOM, mais aussi les États-Unis, le Canada, la Suisse, le Maroc, le Japon ou la Thaïlande. Les deux autres formules plafonnent à 17 et 25 Go en Europe et dans les DOM.
Le ticket d'entrée, lui, est tout à fait symbolique puisque la carte SIM coûte 1 euro, et elle est livrée gratuitement en point relais. La souscription se fait exclusivement en ligne, sur auchantelecom.fr, et la remise figure en toutes lettres sur chaque facture. Attention toutefois aux conditions, car il impossible de la cumuler avec une autre promotion, et elle disparaît en cas de résiliation ou de bascule vers une autre offre de la marque. Le petit forfait 1 Go à 1,99 euro ne peut pas faire l'objet de remise.
9 centimes d'écart entre Auchan Télécom et Carrefour Mobile, mais une vraie différence
Quelques heures avant, le lundi 5 octobre, Carrefour Mobile faisait son grand retour avec trois forfaits sans engagement, opérés directement par Orange. Pour le moment, l'enseigne propose trois offres, sans engagement : 20 Go à 6,90 euros, 130 Go à 10,90 euros et 300 Go à 14,90 euros, sans enveloppe au-delà de l'Europe et des DOM, un gros désavantage par rapport au forfait haut de gamme d'Auchan Télécom. La souscription est ouverte à tous, mais seuls les membres du Club Carrefour qui associent leur carte à leur ligne récupèrent 1, 2 ou 3 euros par mois. Aucune de ces offres n'intègre la 5G, pas même celle à 300 Go.
Sur son site, Carrefour annonce ainsi des forfaits revenant à 5,90, 8,90 et 11,90 euros par mois. Les tarifs Waaoh! d'Auchan Télécom se placent exactement 9 centimes au-dessus, palier par palier. Mais si les prix sont alignés, il y a une différence très importante entre les deux ! Chez Carrefour, l'abonné règle le prix plein, donc 10,90 euros avec le forfait 130 Go, et l'avantage fidélité (2 euros par mois) est directement reversé sur sa cagnotte, à dépenser en magasin, sur le site ou dans l'application de l'enseigne, au lieu d'être appliqué à la facture. Chez Auchan, la remise est directement appliquée sur le forfait mobile.
En soi, c'est surtout une question de positionnement personnel et de point de vue, car une remise reste une remise, mais si l'abonné n'a pas forcément l'habitude de faire ses courses chez Carrefour, il préfèrera peut-être bénéficier d'un forfait avec remise directe.
Carrefour garde tout de même quelques atouts. Son plus gros forfait grimpe à 300 Go, et il repose sur un réseau réputé pour sa fiabilité, celui d'Orange. La carte SIM s'achète dans plus de 2 000 magasins Carrefour, ou se télécharge en eSIM, pour l'activer directement dans son téléphone. Elle coûte toutefois 5 euros, plus 6 euros de livraison pour une carte physique commandée en ligne, là où Auchan Télécom la facture 1 euros, frais de port compris. Auchan réplique aussi avec la 5G, plus rapide, sur son forfait voyage, et avec une enveloppe plus généreuse à l'étranger : 17, 25 et 35 Go selon le forfait, contre 12, 19 et 25 Go chez Carrefour. À vous de choisir désormais.

articles.title: La herramienta gratuita que permite crear mods para Minecraft, GTA y otros juegos sin saber programar
articles.text:
Universal Modder es una herramienta gratuita que permite crear mods para Minecraft, GTA y otros juegos sin conocimientos de programación, mediante instrucciones que una inteligencia artificial convierte en tareas de análisis, modificación y prueba. El proyecto busca acercar la creación de contenido personalizado a usuarios que hasta ahora dependían de conocimientos técnicos avanzados.
La propuesta llega en un momento en que los mods siguen siendo una de las ventajas del PC frente a las consolas. Estas modificaciones pueden añadir misiones, personajes, objetos o mecánicas, corregir fallos e introducir mejoras en juegos ya publicados. El problema es que crear un mod suele exigir aprender lenguajes de programación, entender archivos internos y utilizar herramientas específicas.
Cómo funciona la herramienta gratuita para crear mods
El proyecto fue publicado el 30 de septiembre por el usuario Rehan Remade en GitHub. Universal Modder no crea cambios por sí solo: actúa como un conjunto de instrucciones para herramientas de código basadas en IA, entre ellas Claude Code y Codex de ChatGPT.
Su biblioteca incluye 12 guías para diferentes motores, plataformas y videojuegos. Entre las opciones aparecen Unity, Unreal Engine, Source, Bethesda, Godot, Minecraft, Age of Empires y RPG Maker. Cada guía orienta a la IA para reconocer la estructura de un título y decidir qué procedimientos necesita para aplicar una modificación.
La herramienta analiza los archivos disponibles, revisa la información sobre el juego y comprueba si existen trabajos previos similares. Con esos datos, la IA puede plantear una ruta de trabajo antes de modificar elementos del juego. El objetivo es reducir la barrera técnica, aunque el resultado dependerá del título, de sus archivos y de las limitaciones de cada motor.
El proceso incluye análisis, copias de seguridad y pruebas
Universal Modder sigue una secuencia de pasos antes de generar el mod. Primero consulta información sobre el juego y localiza posibles referencias de modificaciones ya existentes. Después revisa los archivos del título y crea una copia de seguridad de las partidas guardadas para evitar pérdidas si ocurre un error durante el proceso.
El siguiente punto consiste en aplicar técnicas de ingeniería inversa. La IA busca herramientas capaces de leer el código o la estructura del juego para entender cómo funciona. A partir de ahí, comienza a construir la modificación según la solicitud del usuario y las instrucciones incluidas en las guías.
La herramienta ejecuta el videojuego, analiza lo que aparece en pantalla y verifica si los cambios funcionan dentro de una partida. Si detecta fallos, puede corregir partes del código y repetir las pruebas. Cuando termina, organiza los archivos necesarios para compartir el mod, sin incluir contenido original del juego.
También puede trabajar con dos títulos al mismo tiempo si la petición consiste en combinar elementos de ambos. Por ejemplo, si alguien quiere trasladar recursos de un videojuego a una experiencia inspirada en otro título, la IA revisará las estructuras de los dos proyectos antes de construir una propuesta compatible.
Los mods se limitan a juegos para un solo jugador
Una de las condiciones del proyecto es que las modificaciones se concentren en videojuegos para un jugador. Esa decisión evita interferencias con sistemas antitrampas y reduce problemas relacionados con partidas online, donde alterar archivos puede afectar a otros usuarios o vulnerar las normas de cada plataforma.
El código que se comparte no incorpora archivos extraídos de los videojuegos. Universal Modder reúne los pasos y las instrucciones para crear el cambio, mientras que los archivos modificados permanecen en el ordenador de quien utiliza la herramienta. El proyecto busca evitar la distribución directa de contenido protegido por derechos de autor.
La herramienta solicita permisos antes de acceder a determinadas funciones del equipo. Parte de su trabajo se realiza de forma local, una característica que pretende reducir conflictos con licencias y limitar el acceso a datos ajenos al proceso de modificación.
Universal Modder se puede descargar sin pagar desde GitHub. Sin embargo, su funcionamiento depende de servicios de IA que consumen créditos o tokens. Los planes gratuitos pueden resultar insuficientes para tareas amplias, sobre todo si el usuario quiere modificar archivos grandes, realizar varias pruebas o crear sistemas complejos.
El texto original señala que un plan básico de unos 20 euros mensuales permite realizar modificaciones pequeñas. El costo final dependerá de la plataforma de IA elegida y de la cantidad de instrucciones necesarias para completar cada proyecto.
Su evolución dependerá de la compatibilidad con nuevos títulos, del costo de los servicios de IA y de las reglas que establezcan los propietarios de cada videojuego.

articles.title: SpaceX va abandonner Falcon 9 : pourquoi l’Europe fait face à un énorme problème
articles.text:
L’entreprise aérospatiale SpaceX a annoncé son intention de mettre un terme à la commercialisation des vols à bord de ses fusées Falcon 9 et Falcon Heavy à partir de 2028. Au-delà de cette date, SpaceX continuera d’effectuer quelques missions d’équipage et de ravitaillement pour la NASA vers la Station spatiale internationale (ISS) au moins jusqu’en 2030. Lancée pour la première fois en 2010, la fusée Falcon 9 a effectué près de 700 vols. Rien qu’en 2025, elle a décollé 165 fois, soit quasiment un tir tous les deux jours. Cependant, Falcon 9 va progressivement laisser sa place à une autre fusée, bien plus imposante et performante.
Pourquoi SpaceX prévoit de mettre hors service Falcon 9 ?
SpaceX compte mettre au placard Falcon 9 pour pouvoir concentrer ses efforts et ses investissements sur la gigantesque fusée Starship. Elon Musk l’a expliqué lui-même sur X : « Une fois que Starship volera de manière fiable plusieurs fois par semaine, il sera logique de réorienter les ressources de production vers Starship afin d’atteindre une cadence de lancement de plusieurs fois par jour ».
La fusée Starship permettra à SpaceX de remplir des missions d’un tout autre niveau. D’une part, la gigantesque fusée permettra de mettre en orbite la nouvelle génération de satellites Starlink que la fusée Falcon 9 n’est pas en mesure de transporter. D’autre part, elle permettra de servir de véhicule d’alunissage pour les futures missions Artemis.
Un coup dur pour l’Europe
La fin annoncée de Falcon 9 est un coup dur pour l’Europe. Si cette dernière dispose déjà de plusieurs lanceurs capables d’atteindre l’orbite, notamment Ariane 6, Vega-C et désormais Spectrum, la fusée Falcon 9 est largement utilisée pour placer des satellites en orbite. Dans le secteur des lanceurs, SpaceX joue clairement dans une autre catégorie que les entreprises aérospatiales privées européennes. Pour cause, la Falcon 9 peut être lancée fréquemment, à un prix particulièrement attractif.
L’Europe va donc devoir trouver une solution, ou se tourner vers la fusée Starship. Il reste maintenant à définir la date exacte du retrait de Falcon 9, qui dépend directement du succès de Starship. Quoi qu’il en soit, l’Europe est face à un sérieux problème. En 2025, 134 des 396 satellites lancés lors de vols partagés de Falcon 9 étaient européens, soit plus d’un tiers du total. La fusée Ariane 6 devrait quant à elle effectuer 9 à 10 lancements en 2027, bien loin des 165 décollages de Falcon 9 en 2025. Si aucune solution n’est trouvée, l’Europe pourrait prendre un sérieux retard dans la course effrénée au déploiement de satellites qui s’annonce.

Como colocar os cheats no Pokémon Fire Red e Leaf Greenen
O guia abaixo foi feito no emulador VisualBoy Advance para computador. Entretanto, o passo a passo é semelhante em outros emuladores de Game Boy Advance no PC ou celular.
1. Carregue o jogo do Pokémon no emulador de Game Boy Advance
Abra o emulador de Game Boy Advance e clique em “File”. Então, selecione o jogo Pokémon Fire Red ou Leaf Green.
2. Acesse a opção de cheats do emulador
Clique na opção “Tool”, na barra na parte superior da tela. Selecione a opção “Cheats” ou “Pass” do emulador e, depois, abra “List Cheats”.
3. Insira o Master Code da sua versão do Pokémon
Clique em “Add New Cheat” e, na nova janela, insira o Master Code da versão do Pokémon que você está jogando. Então, clique em “OK” para concluir.
4. Adicione outros cheats do Pokémon Fire Red e Leaf Green
Clique novamente em “Add New Cheat” sempre que quiser adicionar um novo código ao jogo e selecione “OK” para cadastrar uma trapaça. Por fim, toque outra vez em “OK” para fechar a tela de cheats.
Importante: sempre salve o jogo antes de usar os cheats e evite usar vários códigos ao mesmo tempo para evitar crashar o jogo no emulador.
5. Desligue o cheats do Pokémon Fire Red e Leaf Green
Para desligar os códigos, clique na opção “Tool” e desabilite a opção “Enable cheats”.

articles.title: Prime Day gaming monitor deals live 2026 — hot sales on the best monitors including OLED, 4K, gaming, and more
articles.text:
Live
Prime Day gaming monitor deals live 2026 — hot sales on the best monitors including OLED, 4K, gaming, and more
Grab a bargain monitor during Prime Big Deal Days 2026.
It's Amazon Prime Big Deal Days 2026 time, and the gaming monitor deals are coming in fast and furious. Whether you're looking for a gaming monitor with fast response times and high refresh rates, or an expansive productivity offering with a webcam, there's something for everyone. Smaller sales and events are now popping up all over the place, and we're tracking all of the sales for you here.
We constantly comb through the best deals across multiple retailers, selecting the best based on in-depth knowledge gained from our thorough reviews, extensive benchmarks, and comprehensive historical price analysis, and keep an updated list below. If you want even more options, we also have our list of Best Gaming Monitors and our Prime Day Gaming Monitor Deals hub if you're looking for curated lists, but we're putting the hottest deals in this blog.
Prime Day is more pertinent than ever for PC builders, as an AI-driven memory shortage apocalypse sends prices skyrocketing. Indeed, we're seeing price increases of over 500% on the most popular RAM products, so the best option could be to upgrade your monitor to a higher resolution to squeeze more gaming quality out of your existing system. On that front, we've found plenty of deals to satisfy even the most demanding monitor aficionados, as you can see below.
Quick Links: Prime Day Monitor Deals
Hottest Amazon Prime Day Monitor Deals
The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a 14.5-inch display designed to serve as an extension for your desktop and give you a small screen to host your most important apps. Its versatility means you can mount it practically anywhere — horizontally under your main monitor, vertically beside your primary display, or as a digital status panel inside your PC case.
Read moreRead less▼
This Alienware gaming monitor got a five-star score in our review. It features a 26.7-inch Quantum-Dot panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, and a 360Hz refresh rate.
Read moreRead less▼
This 27-inch Samsung gaming screen isn't much more expensive than an office monitor. But it sports a 180 Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, and FreeSync variable refresh. It's a VA panel, which generally means better contrast and deeper blacks than TN or IPS, but viewing angles likely aren't the best.
Read moreRead less▼
The Gigabyte M27Q2 is a 27-inch 1440p monitor with a 200Hz refresh rate. It comes with an adjustable stand a built-in KVM switch.
Read moreRead less▼
Returning to its lowest-ever price, get a 32-inch curved QHD (2560 x 1440) gaming monitor with a 165Hz refresh rate for just $189, a massive $140 saving.
Read moreRead less▼
This 34-inch, 3440 x 1440 panel can hit 280 Hz, and is brighter than its predecessor, thanks to tis five-layer tandem tech. Our reviewer praised it for its colorful image and low input lag with "perfect motion resolution."
Read moreRead less▼
This 34-inch, 3440 x 1440 panel can hit 280 Hz, and is brighter than its predecessor, thanks to tis five-layer tandem tech. Our reviewer praised it for its colorful image and low input lag with "perfect motion resolution."
Read moreRead less▼
This mid-sized gaming monitor sports a QD-OLED panel rated at a decent 400 nits of brightness, with a 240 Hz refresh and a resolution of 2560 x 1440. If you're after a gaming screen on a budget and want inky blacks and saturated colors, this is a tough deal to beat.
Read moreRead less▼
LIVE: Latest Updates
MSI's new MPG271QR X50 500Hz QD-OLED monitor is on sale for an all-time low price of $599.99
MSI's new MPG271QR X50 monitor hasn't seen a sale yet, but Newegg has the display available at a $50 discount during its FantasTech sale, brining the price to $599.99. Although we've seen 27-inch OLED displays as cheap as $280, the MSI X50 comes with a blistering 500Hz refresh rate, as well as a newer third-gen QD-OLED panel.
The MSI MPG271QR X50 is a 27-inch 1440p QD-OLED monitor with a 500Hz refresh rate. It uses a third-gen QD-OLED panel.
Read moreRead less▼
Even at its launch price of $699.99, we gave the MPG271QR X50 a near perfect score in our review. As you can see from the color testing we did as part of that review below, the MPG271QR offers excellent color accuracy out of the box, matching similar panels from Asus and Aorus.
In SDR, we measured typical brightness at 303 nits, which is on the lower-end for 1440p QD-OLED panels, though still within a normal range. In HDR, we measured peak brightness at 505 nits, aligning with other 500Hz QD-OLED panels from Asus and Aorus. Note that peak highlights can reach 1,000 nits, though only for small portions of the screen. — Jake Roach
LG’s massive 45-inch 45GX950A-B dual-mode OLED gaming monitor gets a $700 discount
Ultra-wide monitors are a great productivity enhancer, giving you more horizontal workspace. That’s especially true of the LG Ultragear 45GX950A-B, a 45-inch gaming monitor currently priced at $1,299.99, down from a high of $1,999.99.
The LG Ultragear 45GX950A-B is a 45-inch OLED monitor with a 5120 x 2160 resolution, which operates at 165 Hz natively, or 330 Hz at WFHD.
Read moreRead less▼
The 45GX950A-B features a 21:9 aspect ratio, 5,120 x 2,160 resolution, and, most importantly, a WOLED panel. Not only do you get the brilliant colors inherent to OLEDs, but the underlying WOLED panel technology also skews toward higher brightness (1,300-nit peak in this case).
Regarding performance, the 45GX950A-B can operate at up to 165 Hz at its native resolution, but jumps to 330 Hz at WFHD (2560 x 1080). It offers a 1,500,000:1 contrast ratio and 98.5 percent DCI-P3 coverage, while being DisplayHDR True Black 400-certified. On the connectivity front, the monitor offers two HDMI 2.1 ports, one DisplayPort 2.1 port, and a USB-C port with DisplayPort Alt Mode support. — Brandon Hill
Get a QD-OLED monitor for just $280 with this 27-inch, 1440p display with a 144Hz refresh rate
QD-OLED monitors are dropping in price, and Amazon has a particularly good deal going right now on AOC's 27-inch 1440p QD-OLED display. Unlike most 27-inch, 1440p OLED displays, this monitor tops out at a 144Hz refresh rate. The typical 240Hz refresh rate you see on this panel is available, as well, though at a higher $332.49 price. We saw this monitor on sale earlier in the week at $300, and it was a good deal then. An extra $20 off is even better.
This AOC monitor is a 27-inch QD-OLED display with a resolution of 2560 x 1440 and a refresh rate of 144Hz. AOC rates the response time at 0.03ms, and the monitor comes with G-Sync Compatible certification.
Read moreRead less▼
There are other displays rocking this same panel that are on sale, but they're all more expensive than this AOC monitor. The MSI Pro Max 271QPX14G is $300 on sale, for instance. As with any QD-OLED panel, this monitor has perfect black levels, leading to a theoretically infinite contrast ratio. OLED panels also have extremely fast pixel transition times, leading to those sub-millisecond response time claims.
AOC claims 147.6% coverage of the sRGB and 110.2% coverage of the DCI-P3 color gamuts (OLED panels are wide-gamut). For connectivity, AOC includes a single HDMI 2.1 and single DisplayPort 1.4 connection, allow with a 3.5mm audio out. — Jake Roach
Save over $156 on the ASRock Phantom Gaming 27-inch OLED 2K 240Hz gaming monitor – just $319 lets you jump into high-refresh-rate OLED gaming
OLED gaming displays have been the thing to buy over the last year or two. Since they became available a few years ago, prices have come down considerably. To that point, ASRock’s Phantom Gaming (PG027QSA-W) 27-inch QHD/2K monitor is now $319, a solid $156 (32%) off the retail price at Newegg.
ASRock's 27-inch 240Hz OLED panel is at the cheapest price we've seen. Upgrade to OLED goodness and see true black and awesome colors for less.
Read moreRead less▼
This white-clad display arrives at your door factory-calibrated, so you get a great picture out of the box. The monitor supports AMD FreeSync Premium for smooth, high-refresh-rate gaming on the 240Hz 0.03ms (GTG) panel. It boasts great color with a wide 99% DCI-P3 color space and Delta E<2 color accuracy. It also has four inputs (2x DisplayPort, 2x HDMI) for plenty of flexibility. It also comes with a built in stand with tilt, swivel, height, and pivot adjustments.
At just over $319, it is one of the least expensive in its size and type and a great upgrade for anyone not already using a high refresh-rate OLED. The best news is that your current video card will likely still handle it, unlike 4K OLEDs. - Joe Shields
AOC 27-inch 280Hz QHD gaming monitor now just $135 — value-priced Q27G41ZE still comes with a 3-year warranty
There are some excellent deals to be had on gaming monitors, and Amazon is currently running a sweet deal on the AOC Q27G41ZE. This is a 27-inch gaming monitor that offers some serious bang for the buck. The monitor typically retails for $159.99, but is currently on sale for $135.99.
The AOC Q27G41ZE is a value-packed 27-inch gaming monitor with a QHD IPS panel and a 240Hz native refresh rate. The monitor can also be overclocked to 260Hz and comes with a 3-year warranty.
Read moreRead less▼
For that price, you get a QHD (2560 x 1440) IPS display with a native refresh rate of 240 Hz. However, with overclocking, you can boost the maximum refresh rate to 260 Hz to eke out a bit more performance. However, just take note that the 240 Hz/260 Hz refresh rates are only accessible via the DisplayPort connection. Speaking of ports, you get one DisplayPort 1.4 and two HDMI 2.0 on the Q27G41ZE.
Other features of note include a 0.03ms response time, 1,000:1 contrast ratio, 300 nits typical brightness, and -3 to +21-degree tilt range. And despite the value pricing, the Q27G41ZE comes backed by a three-year "Zero Bright Dot" warranty. — Brandon Hill
Get into 4K OLED gaming for less with MSI's Pro Max 271UPX12G 120Hz monitor
If you want to get into the crisp motion, deep blacks, and rich color of 4K OLED gaming for less, your options are limited. Most 4K OLED gaming monitors are $750 or more, and we're not seeing a lot of deep discounts on panels with those specs right now. But if you're willing to tolerate a 120Hz refresh rate, MSI's Pro Max 271UPX12G could be a good entry point into this rarefied world. This pro monitor offers a 27" QD-OLED panel with G-Sync Compatible certification. Break the rules and game on it for $579.99.
MSI's Pro Max 271UPX12G 4K OLED monitor isn't marketed as a gaming panel, but it can be one for less if you're willing to break the rules. A 120Hz refresh rate and G-Sync Compatible certification offer smooth gaming along with rich color and deep blacks.
Read moreRead less▼
While a 120Hz refresh rate is a bit low for a hardcore gaming display, it'll still be an upgrade if you're coming from a 60Hz panel. And especially if you plan to drive this display at or near its native resolution with upscaling and aren't a fan of frame generation, the 120Hz refresh rate won't be much of a damper on your gaming experience. Even today's best graphics cards would be hard-pressed to deliver native 4K output at a 120 FPS average in the latest games without frame generation.
The Pro Max 271UPX12G comes factory-calibrated to a Delta E of less than two, and it offers an exceptional 99% coverage of the vivid DCI-P3 color gamut to go with its sharp 4K resolution. It's got two HDMI 2.1 ports and a DisplayPort 1.4a connector, as well as a stand with height, pivot, and swivel adjustments.
If you can compromise slightly on refresh rate, this panel could be a relatively affordable ticket to a 4K OLED at hundreds of dollars less than only slightly faster options. -- Jeff Kampman
Get a great deal on the TUF Gaming monitor (VG27AQM5A) for only $199.99 on Prime Day - save $100 and upgrade your monitor to a QHD, 300Hz Fast IPS panel and take your gaming to the next level
If you’re in the market for a monitor upgrade, Prime Big Deal Days 2026 has you covered. Jump up to the 27-inch Asus TUF QHD (2560x1440) 300Hz fast IPS monitor for only $199.00 (33% / $100 off). The VG27AQM5A sports a fast IPS panel, speakers, a swivel-and-tilt stand, and several features like Asus ELMB (Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync), which works with other variable refresh rate technologies it supports, like AMD FreeSync Premium and Nvidia G-Sync, to eliminate ghosting and screen tearing for sharp visuals in gaming.
Save 33% on the Asus TUF Gaming VG27AQM5A and upgrade your gaming experience for only $199.00. 27-inch, 300 Hz Fast IPS panel eliminates ghosting and screen tearing, and a 95% DCI-P3 color gamut displays vibrant colors, and all for under $200.
Read moreRead less▼
Additional features include Gaming AI with a dynamic crosshair, dynamic shadow boost (enhances dark areas onscreen), as well as AI Visual that dynamically adjusts settings to provide the best default or use preset monitor settings. Connectivity consists of a single DisplayPort, two HDMI ports, and a USB-C port, ensuring wide compatibility with a variety of input sources. While there are a lot of deals out there for Prime Day, this is the only 300Hz, QHD, Fast IPS panel under $200 we could find. Get it before it’s too late. — Matt Safford
Save $350 on a 49-inch Samsung Odyssey G9 (G91F) curved gaming monitor
Today we have an excellent deal on a massive Samsung 49-inch curved (1800R) VA display, now only $649 (from $999). The G91F features a DQHD resolution (5120 x 1440) 32:9 panel, a fast 144 Hz refresh rate (1ms GTG response time), and AMD FreeSync Premium for a smooth image during fast action. You can even play games and watch videos simultaneously with Samsung’s Picture-by-Picture mode.
Step up your monitor game and get a great deal on the Odyssey G9 during Prime Day sales. This massive 49-inch, 144 Hz, curved (1800R) display from Samsung is now on sale for $699.99 matching its all-time lowest price.
Read moreRead less▼
Hardware-wise, the panel supports HDR 600 (250-nit typical brightness), uses DisplayPort and two HDMI ports for video connectivity, two USB Type-A ports for service and data, and also has a 3.5 mm audio jack. — Brandon Hill
Get an Arzopa 16.1-inch 180Hz 1440p portable monitor for just $132
If you skew more towards the gaming side of things in your requirements for a portable monitor and require more than the standard 60Hz refresh rate, the Arzopa Z3FC is available with a solid 22 percent discount, bringing its price to $132.98.
The Arzopa Z3FC is a 16.1-inch class portable monitor with a 1440p resolution and a speedy 180 Hz refresh rate
Read moreRead less▼
Arzopa is well known for producing quality monitors at affordable prices, and the Z3FC is no exception. I tested the monitor earlier this year and was impressed with its build quality, color performance, and speed. It also helps that it comes with a handy fabric storage sleeve to protect the screen when traveling.
The Z3FC features a relatively large 16.1-inch IPS panel, which is just outside the 15.4-inch baseline for portable monitors. That size affords a 2560 x 1440 resolution instead of the standard 1080p. Add in the 180 Hz refresh rate, up from the standard 60 Hz on most portable monitors, and you have a great monitor you can pair with your Nintendo Switch on the go, or even an Xbox or PlayStation in a pinch. — Brandon Hill
Save an incredible $150 on this Acer 27-inch Nitro 1440p 270Hz IPS gaming monitor
If you aren’t upgrading your RAM, storage, or graphics card because of AI armageddon, there are some excellent monitor deals to keep you occupied in the meantime.
For example, the Acer Nitro (XV270U Z1bmiiprx) is available from Newegg right now for $179.99. It features a 27-inch 2560x1440 (WQHD) IPS panel supporting up to a 270 Hz refresh rate over DisplayPort (144Hz over HDMI). While its brightness isn’t the highest we’ve seen at 250 nits, it does support AMD FreeSync Premium technology to eliminate screen tearing, and it has a fast 0.55ms GTG response time that reduces ghosting. The IPS panel support 99% sRGB color gamut for accurate color reproduction and Acer VisionCare technologies (think blue light shield, flicker-free tech, etc).
Save $150 and get this 27-inch Acer Nitro monitor at its lowest price we've seen in months. The IPS panel supports AMD Freesync Premium 0.5ms GTG response time, 250 nit brightness, , and supports 99% of sRGB color gamut. For only $180, you won't find anything faster for less.
Read moreRead less▼
The Nitro features thin bezel "Zero Frame" technology and is supported by the ‘Ergostand’ with Tilt, swivel, pivot, and height adjustment capabilities. If you happen to require sound, it also has two integrated speakers (2W each). In all, this is a great deal on a solid monitor. If you’re at 1080p or already using a lower-refresh-rate 1440p monitor, the Acer Nitro XV270U is a worthwhile upgrade. — Brandon Hill
Five-star Alienware AW2725DF 360 Hz OLED monitor drops to its lowest-ever price of $469 — get 25% off this ‘near-perfect display for gaming or productivity’
Perhaps it’s the high prices of… pretty much everything else, but we are seeing lots of deals on modestly sized 27-inch monitors this Prime Big Deal Days, and at its lowest-ever price of $469 at Amazon, this one stands out. When we reviewed the AW2725DF, we called it “a near-perfect display for gaming or productivity when space is limited,” and praised the screen for its stunningly fast 360 Hz refresh rate and smoothness, while delivering a wider color gamut than even other OLED monitors.
This 27-inch QD-OLED monitor brings a typical-for-its-size 1440p resolution, but a fast 360 Hz refresh rate, alongside a 1000-nit brightness rating, and a 3-year warranty. In our testing, it also delivered better color than other OLEDs.
Read moreRead less▼
When we reviewed this screen in 2024, it beat the next most colorful 27-inch OLED we had tested by 10%, which is enough to notice. And we found the color to be accurate in both DCI-P3 and sRGB, with no need for calibration. Hands down, this is one of the best-looking compact OLED monitors out of the box, and considering it was priced at $900 when we looked at it in 2024, its current sale price is hard to ignore. — Joe Shields
This 1440p, 27-inch LG gaming monitor is a steal for under $140
While the Big Deal Days haven't technically started, Amazon's deals right now include this LG curved gaming monitor for just $142. The 27-inch LG 27GS60QC-B Ultragear is a good option on a budget and, for less than $150, easily rivals the competition at this price point.
The UltraGear 27GS60QC-B is a 27-inch monitor with a 1440p resolution, 180Hz refresh rate, and 1ms GtG response time. It uses a VA panel and comes with FreeSync support.
Read moreRead less▼
You're getting a 27-inch display there with a 1440p resolution, so this is a good upgrade to consider if you're still rocking a 1080p display. It has a 180Hz refresh rate, along with a 1ms GtG response time. It's a VA panel, so you can expect higher contrast and deeper blacks than IPS rivals, and it comes with AMD FreeSync support to eliminate screen tearing completely. - Ben Stockton
240 Hz OLED gaming monitor now just $269 — 2560 Acer Nitro with QD panel is $81 off
So many things in the PC space (and pretty much everywhere else) are more expensive these days. But the price of OLED monitors continues to decline, as evidenced by this 27-inch, 240 Hz model (VG277U Xbiip) from Acer's Nitro line. It sports a 240 Hz QD-OLED panel rated at 400 Nits of brightness and a 0.03 ms response time. That's a lot of monitor for the current Walmart asking price of $269.
This mid-sized gaming monitor sports a QD-OLED panel rated at a decent 400 nits of brightness, with a 240 Hz refresh and a resolution of 2560 x 1440. If you're after a gaming screen on a budget and want inky blacks and saturated colors, this is a tough deal to beat.
Read moreRead less▼
We haven't tested this monitor, so we can't vouch for its performance. But Acer typically makes solid gaming panels, and the QD-OLED panel ensures that the blacks will be truly black and the colors should be vivid. The 400-nit brightness rating isn't the best for an OLED, but it should be more than sufficient, unless you like to game in a bright, sunlit room. 
The VG277U Xbiip has one DisplayPort (1.4) and two HDMI (2.1) ports. The bezels are also barely there, save for a small lip at the bottom. And of course, AMD FreeSync Premium is supported, and you should see smooth performance in gaming with an Nvidia card as well. - Matthew Safford
Two of Alienware's best award-winning QD-OLED gaming monitors plummet to record-low prices
Dell/Alienware has long made excellent monitors, and the company's OLED screens in particular have stuck out in recent years for a combination of price and performance. Today you can snag a swift 27-inch, 360 Hz option or a 280 Hz 34-inch ultrawide for the lowest prices ever.
This 2560 x 1440 screen can hit 360 Hz refresh and sports a 0.03 ms response time. Its color gamut is wider than other OLEDs, and our reviewer called out its plethora of convenience features, noting it "is a near-perfect display for gaming or productivity when space is limited."
Read moreRead less▼
This 34-inch, 3440 x 1440 panel can hit 280 Hz, and is brighter than its predecessor, thanks to tis five-layer tandem tech. Our reviewer praised it for its colorful image and low input lag with "perfect motion resolution."
Read moreRead less▼
You can't go wrong with either of these screens, as we've tested both and both got our Editors' Choice for their performance. The AW2725DF is an older model from 2024, while the AW3426DW launched in the middle of this year and therefore has a newer panel. But both are made by Samsung and feature vivid colors and inky blacks. 
On the AW3426DW in particular, our color testing showed that the screen was accurate out of the box, and like most QD-OLED screens, the panel was colorful and well-balanced. If you do, though, want to make a couple of minor adjustments, you can achieve 105% coverage of the DCI-P3 space.
We saw similar results in our testing of the smaller AW2725DF, which again proves that either option is excellent. If you're looking to upgrade your screen for gaming or gaming and productivity, these are two of the best options available -- especially at these record-low price points. — Matt Safford
Corsair's tiny PC touchscreen discounted in all five colors
The viral Corsair Xeneon Edge LCD touchscreen is back in stock and discounted at Corsair, with $50 off all five colors.
The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a 14.5-inch display designed to serve as an extension for your desktop and give you a small screen to host your most important apps. Its versatility means you can mount it practically anywhere — horizontally under your main monitor, vertically beside your primary display, or as a digital status panel inside your PC case.
Read moreRead less▼
This touchscreen can be used standalone, mounted with magnets, or even integrated into select Corsair PC cases. It can serve as a control system for your music or voice chats, a comment or chat window for your live streams, or as a nerve center monitoring your PCs vital signs. It can be mounted horizontally or vertically, offering a 2560 x 720 resolution display with a 60Hz refresh rate. This was one of the most popular deals during the last Prime Day earlier in the summer, so it won't be around for long. - Stephen Warwick.
It's early in the morning, but the gaming monitor deals are flying in. We'll keep this list hot as the event progresses; buckle up!

Si estás pensando renovar los tuyos o, simplemente, comprarte unos, hemos estado rastreando en la Fiesta de Ofertas Prime de Amazon y estos son los mejores chollos que hemos encontrado. Eso sí, estos descuentos solo están disponibles para miembros Prime; si aún no lo eres puedes aprovechar la prueba gratuita de 30 días para acceder a estas ofertas.

- Baseus Bass BC2 por 34,99 euros: de clip y con IA.
- CMF Headphone Pro por 49,99 euros: de diadema y con cancelación de ruido activa.
- Sony WF-C710N por 69 euros: muy ligeros y con conexión multipunto.
- Beats Studio Pro por 189,05 euros: con Audio Espacial y compatibles con iPhone y Android.
CMF Headphone Pro - Auriculares Bluetooth de Diadema Over-Ear
SoundcoreP20i by Anker

Los P20i de Anker permiten elegir entre 22 ecualizaciones diferentes a través de la app. Su batería ofrece hasta 30 horas de autonomía con el estuche de carga y también presentan certificación IPX5, que los hace resistentes al agua y al polvo.
Soundcore P20i by Anker Auriculares inalámbricos Bluetooth, Big Bass

Su precio habitual es de unos 50 euros, pero ahora tienen aplicado un descuento del 30%, que hace que se queden disponibles por 34,99 euros.
Se trata de unos auriculares muy cómodos de llevar gracias al puente en C flexible de acero con memoria. Con ellos podrás disfrutar de llamadas más claras gracias a sus cuatro micrófonos e IA incorporada. Además, cuentan con certificación IP55.
Baseus Bass BC2 Auriculares Abiertos, Auriculares de Clip
CMF Headphone Pro
Si lo que estás buscando son unos auriculares de diadema, estos CMF Headphone Pro tienen ahora un descuento del 50%. En la Fiesta de Ofertas Prime de Amazon han pasado de costar 99 a 49,99 euros.
Uno de sus puntos fuertes es su batería, la cual ofrece hasta 100 horas de reproducción o de 50 horas con la cancelación de ruido activa. Incorporan controles físicos y táctiles y son compatibles con LDAC y pueden funcionar tanto por cable como de forma inalámbrica.
CMF Headphone Pro - Auriculares Bluetooth de Diadema Over-Ear
Sony WF-C710N
Sony es una de esas marcas que tienen éxito entre quienes buscan auriculares. Ahora, en Amazon, te puedes llevar estos con cancelación de ruido por 69 euros, frente a los 89 euros que suelen costar.
Están disponibles en cuatro colores diferentes y ofrecen audio de alta calidad. Su diseño es muy cómodo, ya que son muy ligeros y se ajustan de forma natural al oído. Ofrecen hasta 40 horas de autonomía (y hasta 30 con la cancelación de ruido activa). Además, cuentan con conexión multipunto.
Sony WF-C710N Auriculares Inalámbricos con Cancelación de Ruido

Otra de las marcas de referencia en el sector audio es Beats. Ahora, en la Fiesta de Ofertas Prime de Amazon puedes llevarte estos Beats Studio Pro con más de 100 euros de descuento. Su PVP recomendado es de 299,95 euros, pero ahora puedes conseguirlos por 189,05 euros.

articles.title: OpenAI teste un nouveau format de pub ChatGPT avec des outils de mesure avancés
articles.text:
Souhaitant faire « profiter davantage de personnes des avantages de l’IA », OpenAI va bientôt tester de nouvelles publicités illustrées au sein de ChatGPT.
Après avoir juré que la pub serait un « dernier recours », OpenAI a lancé des publicités dans les plans gratuits mais aussi payants de ChatGPT en février dernier. Ce « petit test » a rapidement permis à la firme d’engranger plus de 100 millions de dollars de revenus annualisés en 6 semaines.
Il n’en fallait pas plus pour qu’OpenAI s’emballe : l’entreprise a recruté en Europe pour construire sa propre régie publicitaire avant de lancer en août dernier ChatGPT Ads dans 31 marchés européens, France comprise. Et apparemment, ce n’est que le début.
Un nouveau format de publicité visuelle arrive dans ChatGPT
Les annonces publicitaires ont pointé le bout de leur nez dans ChatGPT cette année, au grand dam de certains utilisateurs. Qu’à cela ne tienne, OpenAI vient de lancer un tout nouveau format visuel, qui sera, cette fois-ci, visible pendant le traitement des requêtes. Il sera, dans un premier temps, testé lors de la génération d’images.
- Chat dans différentes langues, dont le français
- Générer, traduire et obtenir un résumé de texte
- Générer, optimiser et corriger du code
Le test va démarrer dans le courant du mois d’octobre et sera limité aux États-Unis avec un petit groupe d’annonceurs triés sur le volet. Impossible, pour le moment, de savoir si un déploiement plus large est prévu pour plus tard. Dans le même temps, la régie d’OpenAI s’est dotée de nouveaux outils de mesure pour aider les professionnels à suivre les conversions, identifier ce qui déclenche une action de la part de l’utilisateur et mesurer l’impact réel des campagnes.
Les premiers résultats sont prometteurs et ne manqueront pas d’attirer l’attention des annonceurs : « WorkMagic a constaté une hausse statistiquement significative pour la marque de bien-être Dose, avec 67 % des achats incrémentaux provenant de tout nouveaux clients. Et selon Triple Whale, 93 % des visiteurs de Portland Leather provenant de ChatGPT Ads étaient de nouveaux visiteurs. »
OpenAI joue la carte de la prudence et de l’optimisme
Si OpenAI a de quoi séduire de nouveaux annonceurs, elle devra, en revanche, mettre les bouchées doubles pour ses utilisateurs. Dans son billet de blog, la firme se veut donc rassurante : elle précise que les publicités seront clairement signalées et qu’elles n’auront aucun impact sur les réponses de ChatGPT. Aucune annonce ne sera, de plus, diffusée auprès de profils émotionnellement vulnérables ou au sein de conversations jugées sensibles.
Des programmes pilotes menés en collaboration avec DoubleVerify et Integral Ad Science permettront également de vérifier le bon fonctionnement de ces garde-fous dans un environnement de test, sans accès aux échanges privés des utilisateurs.
Pour faire passer la pilule, OpenAI en a aussi dit un peu plus sur l’utilité de ces nouvelles pubs : « Notre nouveau format publicitaire visuel aide les utilisateurs à découvrir des produits et services et à imaginer leur place dans leur quotidien, tout en offrant aux annonceurs de nouvelles façons de raconter leur histoire en images. » Cette argument sera-t-il suffisamment convaincant ? Rien n’est moins sûr…

articles.text:
Yellowjackets (Paramount+) : un teaser et une date de sortie pour la saison 4 de la série culte
Les footballeuses perdues dans la nature de Yellowjackets seront de retour en novembre sur la plateforme de streaming Paramount+.
En voilà une bonne nouvelle pour les fans de la série Yellowjackets ! On sait enfin quand la quatrième et dernière saison arrivera en streaming en France. Jusqu'ici d'abord diffusée sur Canal+, la série change pour l'occasion de plateforme et sera proposée sur Paramount+ dès le 20 novembre prochain.
De Canal+ à Paramount+
Le service de SVOD Paramount+ est la nouvelle maison des Yellowjackets en France, et non plus Canal+. Dès le 20 novembre prochain, les abonnés à la chaîne cryptée auront donc besoin du pack Ciné Séries ou Canal+ La Totale s'ils souhaitent continuer à regarder ce thriller psychologique aux accents horrifiques.
Dans la saison 4 de cette série créée par Ashley Lyle et Bart Nickerson, les survivantes de Yellowjackets vont enfin rentrer chez elle. En effet, ces nouveaux épisodes vont montrer comment elles ont été secourues des forêts du Grand Nord et comment se sont déroulées leurs retrouvailles avec la civilisation.
Cette saison 4, qui est également la dernière du show, continuera aussi de suivre ces femmes 25 ans plus tard, alors qu'elles tentent toujours de recoller les morceaux de leur vie.

articles.title: AI networking and simulation help BattleBots builders win early - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
BattleBots builders turn to AI simulation to win fights before entering the box
AI infrastructure built on dense graphics processing unit clusters and high-speed AI networking is no longer reserved for frontier model labs. The same compute behind the industry’s push into physical AI is now reaching engineers designing machines for competitive combat.
That shift is visible in robot combat, where CoreWeave Inc. was named the official AI cloud partner of BattleBots Inc.. Builders are using simulation to settle design questions long before a robot reaches the arena, according to Rob Bahr (pictured), senior engineer at BattleBots.
“What a lot of guys have started to do is run simulations on their computers of what type of weapon they want to use. Do they want to use a bar? Do they want to use a circle? Do they want a single tooth?” Bahr said. “They start using and running those simulations in each one of these scenarios to figure out what’s their best defense, what’s their best offense.”
Bahr spoke with theCUBE Research’s Dave Vellante and John Furrier at the Fully Connected event, during an exclusive broadcast on theCUBE, SiliconANGLE Media’s livestreaming studio. They discussed AI simulation for robot combat design, CoreWeave’s partnership with BattleBots and the potential for AI-driven robot autonomy. (* Disclosure below.)
Robot simulation and safety in the age of AI networking
Simulation matters more now because the materials are changing. Builders who once relied on rivets, wood and stainless-steel sheet metal are now experimenting with 3D printing, plastics and rubbers, each of which needs testing, Bahr noted.
“There’s actually been a couple [of] teams that have started to try to do new designs. Especially with 3D printing and material changing so fast, people are starting to run simulations on different types of plastics, different types of rubbers,” he said.
Robot combat puts engineering designs to the test in competition. Bahr, known among builders as “Safety Rob,” described BattleBots engineers as the cream of the crop.
“If you know something fails in BattleBots, you know that it failed. It’s broken. It’s in pieces or it’s on fire or something like that,” Bahr said.
Safety still sets the boundaries, especially around lithium battery fires. BattleBots has handled so many of them that it gave the National Fire Protection Association pointers on its NFPA 800 standard, Bahr noted.
“I really think AI is going to play a key role in computing and simulation and possibly in the autonomy, which is going to push the hardware further than it’s already been,” Bahr said. “It’s kind of like this leapfrog effect. You have good hardware, then you have good software. It’s going to definitely push the sport forward.”

articles.title: Samsung 9100 Pro SSDs are on sale at Amazon, 1TB drive is back near its launch price
articles.text:
In context: While memory price hikes across the board are widely documented and are affecting numerous tech products, SSDs have not been the exception: NAND prices have climbed dramatically over the past year, pushing retail prices up by almost 200% in some cases. Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days sale is offering temporary relief on select products, including big discounts on Samsung's flagship 9100 Pro SSD that bring the lower-capacity models back to roughly their launch prices.
The 9100 Pro comes in four capacities: 1TB, 2TB, 4TB, and 8TB. The 1TB model is currently $206, about 39% below its regular list price of $339. The 2TB model carries an even steeper 49% discount and is listed at $349, while the 4TB and 8TB variants are down to $750 and $2,280, respectively, roughly 45% and 16% off their list prices.
The 9100 Pro also sits at the top of our Prime Big Deal Days deals roundup, where we've filtered out recycled prices and weak discounts to highlight the offers actually worth your attention.
At launch, the 1TB model was priced at $200, while the 2TB and 4TB versions went for $300 and $550. The 8TB model arrived later at $1,000. That puts the 1TB and 2TB drives close enough to launch pricing that this is as good a time as any to upgrade your rig if you've been planning to, while the 4TB and 8TB versions remain well above theirs.
Consistently rated among the best consumer SSDs for gamers and power users, the 9100 Pro features 236-layer V8 NAND and Samsung's in-house 5nm Presto controller. The drives offer PCIe 5.0 connectivity in an M.2 2280 form factor, an endurance rating of up to 4,800 TBW, and random read/write speeds of up to 2,200K/2,600K IOPS.
The flagship 8TB model delivers sequential read speeds of up to 14,800 MB/s and write speeds of up to 13,400 MB/s, while the base 1TB model reaches up to 14,700 MB/s and 13,300 MB/s, respectively. The 2TB and 4TB models both hit 13,400 MB/s in sequential writes, with sequential reads rated at 14,700 and 14,800 MB/s, respectively.
The big flagship 8TB model delivers maximum sequential read speeds up to 14,800 MB/s and write speeds up to 13,400 MB/s, while the base 1TB model reaches up to 14,700 MB/s and 13,300 MB/s, respectively. The 2TB and 4TB models both hit 13,400 MB/s of sequential write, while the sequential read is listed at 14,700 and 14,800 MB/s, respectively.
Samsung announced the 9100 Pro series in early 2025 and began selling the 1TB, 2TB, and 4TB models the following month, with the 8TB version arriving later that year. The lineup delivers high-end performance across laptop and desktop PC use, or in game consoles like the PS5. Samsung claims the new controller makes the SSDs up to 49% more power efficient than their predecessor, the 990 Pro.
While PCIe 5.0 remains the industry standard for consumer SSDs, Samsung is already mass producing next-generation enterprise-class SSDs built on the PCIe 6.0 interface. Designed to meet the storage demands of AI data centers and high-performance computing environments, the PM1763 range will be offered in 4TB, 8TB, and 16TB configurations at launch.
The new enterprise-class SSDs promise more than double the performance of Samsung's PCIe 5.0 PM1753, with claimed sequential read and write speeds of up to 28.4 GB/s and 21.9 GB/s, respectively, on the 16TB model.
Samsung is also advertising random read and write speeds of up to 6,800K and 950K IOPS, respectively. At those speeds, the drives can transfer a 40GB LLM in just 1.4 seconds.

articles.title: WhatsApp deja sin acceso a algunos iPhone por su versión de iOS: qué hacer para volver a utilizarlo
articles.text:
WhatsApp comenzó a bloquear el acceso a algunos usuarios que intentan utilizar la aplicación desde dispositivos con versiones desactualizadas de iOS o Android. La medida no requiere instalar una nueva versión de WhatsApp, sino actualizar el sistema operativo del teléfono para cumplir con los requisitos de seguridad que exige actualmente el servicio de mensajería.
El cambio fue reportado por WABetaInfo, que detectó una nueva advertencia que puede aparecer cuando una persona intenta iniciar sesión desde un dispositivo cuyo sistema operativo ya no cuenta con una versión compatible. La misma situación puede presentarse tanto en iPhone como en teléfonos Android.
WhatsApp impedirá iniciar sesión en sistemas antiguos
La novedad funciona mediante una actualización realizada desde los servidores de WhatsApp. Esto significa que el usuario no necesariamente tendrá que descargar una actualización de la aplicación desde la App Store o Google Play para encontrarse con el cambio.
Cuando WhatsApp detecta que el dispositivo utiliza una versión de iOS o Android que quedó desactualizada, puede mostrar una pantalla con información sobre el problema y las instrucciones necesarias para solucionarlo.
La diferencia es importante: el requisito no consiste en actualizar WhatsApp, sino el sistema operativo del teléfono.
Por lo tanto, si aparece esta advertencia en un iPhone, el primer paso será comprobar si existe una actualización de iOS disponible. En Android, el procedimiento consiste en revisar si el fabricante ofrece una nueva versión del sistema para ese modelo.
Una vez instalada la actualización correspondiente, el usuario podrá volver a intentar iniciar sesión en WhatsApp, siempre que el dispositivo sea compatible con los requisitos mínimos actuales de la aplicación.
¿Qué hacer si WhatsApp no permite iniciar sesión?
Si WhatsApp muestra la advertencia relacionada con la versión del sistema operativo, el procedimiento es relativamente sencillo. En un iPhone, se debe ingresar a Configuración, seleccionar General y después Actualización de software. Allí aparecerá la versión instalada y, si existe una actualización compatible, la opción para descargarla e instalarla.
En un teléfono Android, los nombres de los menús pueden variar según el fabricante. Generalmente, la actualización se encuentra dentro de Ajustes, en el apartado Sistema o Actualización de software.
Es recomendable realizar una copia de seguridad de la información importante antes de instalar una actualización del sistema operativo. También es conveniente contar con suficiente batería y espacio de almacenamiento.
Si el teléfono ya no permite instalar una versión reciente de iOS o Android, la situación es diferente. En ese caso, el dispositivo podría haber quedado por debajo de los requisitos mínimos establecidos por WhatsApp y no existir una actualización que permita recuperar la compatibilidad.
Por qué WhatsApp exige sistemas operativos actualizados
La razón principal está relacionada con la seguridad. WhatsApp utiliza cifrado de extremo a extremo para proteger el contenido de las conversaciones, pero esta protección no elimina las vulnerabilidades que puedan existir en el propio sistema operativo del teléfono.
WABetaInfo explica que los ciberdelincuentes buscan vulnerabilidades conocidas en versiones antiguas de iOS y Android. Si consiguen comprometer el dispositivo mediante una de ellas, podrían acceder a información antes de que sea protegida por los mecanismos de seguridad de WhatsApp.
Por eso, mantener actualizado el sistema operativo es una medida de protección que va más allá de WhatsApp. Las actualizaciones suelen incorporar correcciones para vulnerabilidades detectadas por los fabricantes y desarrolladores.
Una medida que también afecta a Android
Aunque el cambio ha llamado especialmente la atención entre usuarios de iPhone, la advertencia no está limitada a Apple. WhatsApp también puede impedir el inicio de sesión desde dispositivos Android que utilicen versiones consideradas demasiado antiguas.
La medida funciona como una barrera adicional: en lugar de permitir que una persona continúe utilizando WhatsApp en un sistema que ya no recibe las actualizaciones necesarias, la aplicación le solicita primero solucionar el problema.
De esta manera, actualizar iOS o Android no solo permite recuperar el acceso a WhatsApp en los equipos compatibles, sino que también reduce la exposición a vulnerabilidades conocidas del sistema operativo.

articles.title: Pimax Unveils Crystal Pro Wireless PC VR Headset with Native Foveated Streaming
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 6th 2026
Pimax Unveils Crystal Pro Wireless PC VR Headset with Native Foveated Streaming
Pimax, a leading manufacturer of high-end PC virtual reality headsets, today unveiled Crystal Pro, a wireless PC VR headset built around a streaming technology it calls Native Foveated Streaming, at its "Frontier: Change To Stay The Same" launch event. Pimax also debuted Ringless VR Controllers, the Spation mini-PC, and a refreshed brand identity built around a new signature color, Stratosphere Blue.
Crystal Pro ships with built-in Wi-Fi streaming and a dedicated Wi-Fi 6E adapter. For the GPU's native image, Pimax offers an optional 60G AirLink kit, bundled or sold separately. Using eye-tracking, its 60 GHz connection sends the GPU's native image directly to the panels in the user's focus area, without the encoding Wi-Fi streaming requires. The kit's two Room Antennas run in a 2x2 MIMO configuration—a first for VR headsets, Pimax says—for up to 6 Gbps combined throughput and under 2 ms of added latency.The headset pairs aspheric glass lenses with QLED panels at 2880 x 2880 pixels per eye, a 110-degree field of view, and refresh rates up to 120 Hz. Tracking combines eye-tracking, SLAM 2.0 inside-out tracking, and a swappable faceplate for optional Lighthouse support or MR passthrough with LiDAR depth. No battery is built in; power comes from an included 16,000mAh external pack.
Ringless VR Controllers replace Pimax's earlier tracking ring with camera-based hand tracking plus infrared and motion-sensor tracking, under 15 ms latency, and clip into a gamepad for Windows and Steam.
Spation is a mini-PC with desktop-class components in a chassis smaller than a typical tower, pairing an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU with an AMD RX 9070 XT or NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti GPU. It supports Windows and SteamOS, with a DIY configuration also available.
Crystal Pro is priced at $1,399, or $1,899 bundled with the AirLink kit; the kit alone is $599. Shipping dates, and pricing for Ringless VR Controllers and Spation, will follow. Customers can reserve one for $1 today at pimax.com.
Pimax is a virtual reality hardware company known for high-resolution, wide-field-of-view PC VR headsets, including the Crystal and Dream Air series.

articles.title: Drones sink ships near NATO countries in “unacceptable” attacks, EU says
articles.text:
Drones sank two cargo ships and damaged a third in the exclusive economic zones of NATO member countries for the first time, killing at least two sailors. The attacks represent a notable escalation as Black Sea commercial shipping has increasingly come under attack during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, with Russia also being accused of carrying out “hybrid warfare” incidents across Europe.
The Togo-flagged cargo ship Alfa Watan sank, and the Palau-flagged cargo ship Able was set ablaze after being attacked by multiple sea and aerial drones about 80 miles (128 kilometers) off the coast of Bulgaria on October 6, according to the Associated Press. In an interview, Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev described the incidents as “an unacceptable attack in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone” and “a blatant violation of international law and maritime law.”
The fate of the Alfa Watan’s crew was not immediately known after the vessel sank. A Bulgarian ferry managed to evacuate the 18 crew members of the Able, with two severely injured mariners being flown to a hospital in the city of Varna.
This comes one day after drones struck the Turkish-owned cargo ship named Royad Mammadov within Romania’s exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea on October 5. That ship caught fire and eventually sank, with 11 crew members rescued by Romanian ships and helicopters while one crew member remains missing, according to Euronews. Two crew members were killed.
European Union president Ursula von der Leyen described the drone strikes on the three vessels in the Black Sea as “increasingly concerning” in a post on X. But she also cautioned that the circumstances of the attacks are “still being established” without naming a probable attacker.
“Attacks on civilian shipping are unacceptable,” Leyen wrote. “We stand in full solidarity with our Member States on the Eastern flank.”
By contrast, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described a joint investigation with Bulgaria’s navy as finding that the latest strikes represented a “Russian combined attack using both sea and aerial drones,” Reuters reported. Zelenskyy also said that Ukraine’s military was not conducting operations in that part of the Black Sea.

articles.title: Qualcomm will pay Huawei to license its patents for the first time in historic turnaround — reversal in a 5G and AI cross-licensing deal comes 25 years after Huawei first paid Qualcomm
articles.text:
Qualcomm will pay Huawei to license its patents for the first time in historic turnaround — reversal in a 5G and AI cross-licensing deal comes 25 years after Huawei first paid Qualcomm
Qualcomm is also buying some of Huawei’s US patents outright, pending regulatory approval.
Qualcomm will pay Huawei for patent rights under a multi-year cross-licensing agreement that highlights both 5G and AI technologies, and will buy some of Huawei’s U.S. patents outright, the firm announced. The joint announcement comes 25 years after Huawei began to pay Qualcomm for patents, a reversal that reportedly has Qualcomm paying for the first time. The agreement also covers compute and networking patents, and the patent purchase will close once it receives regulatory approval.
The two companies’ licensing ties date back to 2001, when Huawei, then a Chinese telecom-infrastructure supplier, took a royalty-bearing license to build CDMA network equipment. Qualcomm, which once supplied chips for some Huawei phones, stopped counting royalties from Huawei in its revenue in early 2025.
The “broad patent license agreement” allows “cross licenses” and reflects both companies’ commitment to intellectual property rights and to licensing consistent with “fair, reasonable and non-discriminatory (FRAND) principles.” The deal involves no other business cooperation, Huawei said, according to SCMP; this implies no chip sales are involved. The deal follows a settled back royalty dispute in 2020, the U.S. revoking Qualcomm’s license to sell some hardware to Huawei in 2024, and the expiration of Huawei’s license by early 2025.
Qualcomm’s patent purchase covers compute, AI, networking, and “other technologies,” according to the announcement, but the number of patents was not disclosed, nor was any value figure. Each company credits the other’s portfolio. This suggests that the two are trading official recognition of each other’s patents.
Huawei says that, with the Qualcomm deal, the total value of its patent-licensing contracts will top $6.9 billion, counting from its first licensing income from Motorola in 2011. Since 2021, it says, its licensing business has brought in more than the company pays for other firms’ patents. In August, the company signed a multi-year Wi-Fi patent cross-license with HP and, as of 2025, the company held 165,000 active granted patents worldwide.
Huawei has also gone to court to enforce its patents, as in a 2024 lawsuit against MediaTek. It halted royalty payments to Qualcomm in 2018, and its general counsel testified for the FTC about Qualcomm’s licensing terms in the agency’s 2019 antitrust trial against the chipmaker. Huawei can now take some satisfaction in leveling the playing field with Qualcomm.
No timetable has been given for closing the patent purchase. Qualcomm’s Q4 report is expected next month, but its fiscal year ended before the announcement, so the deal will not make it into those numbers. The company also renewed its Apple license last month, effective April 1, 2027, after the current extension ends. Qualcomm’s relationship with Huawei is now on the other side, as Qualcomm reportedly becomes the one that pays.

articles.title: Flipkart Big Billion Days sale begins on Oct 9, Myntra & Cleartrip announce similar sales
articles.text:
Flipkart Big Billion Days sale begins on Oct 9, Myntra & Cleartrip announce similar sales
The Big Billion Days sale will have 150 million products on offer and 60% increase in number of sellers.
The Big Billion Days (TBBD), the annual sale of Flipkart, will begin on October 9 and its affiliate companies Myntra and Cleartrip have made similar announcements.
The TBBD now in its 13th edition will have over 150 million products from brands across every category, from everyday essentials to flagship electronics, premium fashion, beauty, large appliances and festive gifting.
Flipkart said TBBD 2026 will see the highest-ever number of participating sellers, with over 60% more transacting sellers than last year and 2X new selection for customers. The introduction of 0% commission across all price points for fashion has brought 75% new sellers onto the platform ahead of this edition, it noted.
More than 2.5 crore units of MSME, small seller, artisan and weaver products have been pre-positioned in Ekart fulfilment centres for faster festive fulfilment, giving local businesses direct access to 500 million registered customers across India, Flipkart noted.
Flipkart Group CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy said, "Thirteen years ago, digital commerce in India was a novelty. Today, it is infrastructure. The Big Billion Days is perhaps the clearest annual proof of that shift: 500 million registered customers, 1.4 million sellers, a supply chain that this year reaches communities in Leh and Kargil for the first time, and nearly 75,000 people entering the formal workforce through Flipkart this festive season alone.”
The ecommerce company said its quick commerce segment - Flipkart Minutes has grown 4X year-on-year and now operates across 150-plus cities and 9,000-plus PIN codes through nearly 1,200 microfulfillment centres. This festive season, Minutes will offer 77,000-plus products across 1,400-plus categories, from daily essentials and farm-fresh produce to premium electronics, fashion and last-minute gifting.
Flipkart said more than 2.5 lakh direct and indirect employment opportunities have been created for the festive season, of which nearly 75,000 are for first-time workforce entrants. Women now represent over 20% of Flipkart's supply chain workforce.
Fashion marketplace Myntra has announced its flagship Big Fashion Festival (BFF), which will go live on October 8. According to Myntra, this year’s edition will feature 8 million+ styles, a 2X increase over the last edition, spanning international, domestic, emerging and D2C brands. Key categories expected to see strong festive demand during BFF include men’s and women’s ethnic wear, men’s casual wear, women’s western wear, beauty and personal care, watches and wearables, jewellery and accessories, sports footwear, and home and living.
Sharon Pais, Head of Myntra, said, “At Myntra, we are combining that festive spirit with cutting-edge technology, leveraging our AI tools and expanded delivery network to make fashion accessible, personalised, and seamless for over 80 million shoppers across the country.”
Cleartrip, a Flipkart group company, on Tuesday announced its travel festival with a range of travel offers as part of the Big Billion Days (BBD) 2026. The offers span flights, hotels, buses, trains and holiday packages, with limited inventory deals, select fares, bank discounts and loyalty benefits available during the sale.

articles.title: Microsoft dépouille encore Authenticator d'une de ses fonctions au profit de Google
articles.text:
Microsoft va encore alléger les fonctions d’Authenticator. Dès janvier prochain, l’application ne sauvegardera plus ses données Android dans le cloud de Microsoft. La relève sera assurée par Google.
Et à la fin, restera-t-il encore quelque chose d’Authenticator ? Après avoir renoncé à son gestionnaire de mots de passe et abandonné le remplissage automatique, Redmond entend sucrer sa propre solution de sauvegarde sur Android. À compter de janvier 2027, il ne sera en effet plus possible d’utiliser un compte Microsoft personnel pour stocker les données de l’application dans le cloud. À la place, il faudra se rabattre sur… Google One.
Une transition presque indolore
Pour rappel, sur Android, Authenticator permet aujourd’hui de sauvegarder les données de l’application dans le cloud de Microsoft. En cas de perte ou de changement de téléphone, cette copie permet de récupérer les codes à usage unique associés aux comptes compatibles, sans devoir tout reconfigurer.
Dans trois mois, Microsoft ne prendra plus en charge ces données via ses propres services. Authenticator s’appuiera à la place sur Google One, comme il dépend déjà d’iCloud sur iPhone. Les utilisateurs et utilisatrices Android qui souhaitent conserver une copie de leurs données devront donc vérifier que celles de l’application sont bien prises en compte par la sauvegarde Google. Si ce n’est pas le cas, il faudra activer l’option dans les paramètres de sauvegarde d’Android.
À noter que le changement devrait être relativement indolore pour la plupart des utilisateurs et utilisatrices Android, puisque le Play Store nécessite déjà un compte Google.
Seule petite contrepartie, les données d’Authenticator viendront grignoter une partie des 15 Go de stockage gratuits associés au compte Google. Cela devrait toutefois rester contenu, une sauvegarde de ce type ne contenant ni photos ni documents volumineux, mais les informations nécessaires à la restauration des comptes et des codes TOTP.

articles.title: Visuelle Anzeigen für ChatGPT
articles.text:
Mehr Werbung in ChatGPT: OpenAI platziert visuelle Anzeigen in seine Bild-KI
Seit Anfang Februar 2026 zeigt OpenAI manchen ChatGPT-Nutzer:innen Werbung an. Ende August startete das Werbeprogramm auch in Europa. Mit seinem Fokus auf Kontext statt auf Keywords könnte OpenAI Expert:innen zufolge Googles Werbeimperium ins Wanken bringen – und viel Geld verdienen.
ChatGPT bekommt visuelle Anzeigen
Jetzt erweitert OpenAI das ChatGPT-Werbeangebot um ein visuelles Anzeigenformat. Wie das Unternehmen mitteilt, soll die Display-Werbung Produkte und Dienstleistungen erlebbar machen. Nutzer:innen sollen demnach „neue Marken entdecken, verstehen, was ein Angebot besonders macht, und Kaufentscheidungen treffen“ können. Werbende Firmen sollen dadurch die Möglichkeit erhalten, „ihre Geschichte mit Bildern zu erzählen“.
ChatGPT erreicht laut OpenAI wöchentlich 1,2 Milliarden Menschen und hat damit ein riesiges Werbe- und Umsatzpotenzial. Derzeit wird die Werbung Personen angezeigt, die ChatGPT kostenlos oder in der günstigsten Abo-Variante Go nutzen. Eine Änderung dieser Praxis hat OpenAI bisher nicht angekündigt.
Neues Werbeformat: Tests beginnen im Oktober
Der Startschuss soll noch im Laufe des Monats Oktober erfolgen und das Angebot zunächst auf Nutzer:innen in den USA und eine erste Gruppe werbender Unternehmen begrenzt sein. Zunächst, so OpenAI, sollen die Display-Anzeigen ausschließlich während der Bildgenerierung in ChatGPT angezeigt werden.
Die Werbung ist „klar gekennzeichnet“ und „vom erzeugten Bild getrennt“, wie OpenAI beteuert. Inwieweit die Anzeigen nach den aktuellen Tests auch außerhalb der Bild-KI zu sehen sein sollen, hat das Unternehmen nicht erklärt. Das Wort „zunächst“ deutet aber darauf hin, dass entsprechende Überlegungen existieren.
Erste Testkunden melden positive Ergebnisse
Die ersten Tests sollen jedenfalls erfolgreich gewesen sein. So sollen sich etwa im Fall von Weightwatchers die Kosten pro Akquisition um rund 15 Prozent unter dem Vergleichswert für bezahlte Suchanzeigen belaufen haben. Das Unternehmen Workmagic soll eine „statistisch signifikante Steigerung für die Wellness-Marke Dose“ verzeichnet haben.
Dass die Nutzer:innen über die zusätzlichen Werbeeinschaltungen erfreut sein werden, darf bezweifelt werden. Techcrunch zufolge könnte das aber dazu führen, dass dadurch mehr Gelegenheitsnutzer:innen zu einem kostenpflichtigen Abonnement greifen.

articles.title: Instagram tendrá un modo “solo lectura” que permitirá ver perfiles sin dejar rastro
articles.text:
Instagram evalúa internamente una función que permitiría a determinados usuarios navegar por la plataforma sin dejar ningún rastro de su actividad. Se trata del llamado “modo de solo lectura”, una herramienta que, según las primeras filtraciones, bloquearía la posibilidad de interactuar con publicaciones y, a la vez, ocultaría por completo cualquier señal de que alguien visitó un perfil o vio una historia ajena.
Ante los rumores, un portavoz de Instagram confirmó que la función es real, pero todavía se encuentra en una etapa muy temprana de desarrollo.
Qué es el modo de solo lectura de Instagram
La función fue descubierta por el desarrollador e investigador de ingeniería inversa Alessandro Paluzzi, conocido por rastrear código no publicado dentro de las aplicaciones de Meta antes de que la compañía las lance oficialmente.
Según las capturas que compartió en la red social X, el sistema permitiría activar una sesión especial dentro de Instagram en la que el usuario queda habilitado únicamente para mirar contenido, sin posibilidad de dejar ningún tipo de huella de esa navegación.
El modo de solo lectura es una función en desarrollo interno de Instagram que impediría dar “me gusta”, comentar, seguir cuentas, enviar mensajes o dejar registro al ver historias ajenas, de modo que el usuario podría recorrer perfiles de otras personas sin que estas se enteraran.
Esa descripción surge directamente de las capturas filtradas, que detallan de forma explícita cada una de las acciones bloqueadas durante ese tipo de sesión.
Cómo funcionaría y para qué serviría
De acuerdo con la información difundida, al activar esta opción la plataforma deshabilita de forma automática la capacidad de interactuar con cualquier contenido.
Eso implica que, durante ese período, el usuario no podría dar “me gusta” a publicaciones, escribir comentarios, seguir cuentas nuevas ni enviar mensajes directos.
El punto que más atención concentró es el referido a las historias: hoy en día, Instagram avisa a quien publica una historia sobre qué cuentas la visualizaron. Con el modo de solo lectura activado, esa visualización dejaría de notificarse al autor del contenido.
En la práctica, el mecanismo se asemeja a la navegación de incógnito que ofrecen los navegadores de internet, aplicada en este caso al entorno de una red social, donde permitiría recorrer perfiles y contenidos sin que quede constancia de esa actividad para terceros.
Quiénes podrían acceder a la función
Las capturas compartidas por Paluzzi ubican esta opción como parte de Instagram Plus, la suscripción paga de la plataforma, lo que indicaría que el modo de solo lectura no estaría disponible para el conjunto general de usuarios sino únicamente para quienes abonen ese servicio.
Esto ubicaría al modo de solo lectura como un beneficio exclusivo dentro de un esquema de pago, en un movimiento que se enmarca en la búsqueda de Meta de diversificar sus ingresos más allá de la publicidad tradicional, su principal fuente de facturación hasta el momento.
La compañía de Mark Zuckerberg estaría, de este modo, evaluando si existe una base de usuarios dispuesta a pagar específicamente por una experiencia de navegación sin dejar rastro, algo que hasta ahora no formaba parte de los beneficios ofrecidos por las suscripciones de Instagram.
La respuesta oficial de Instagram
Ante la repercusión del hallazgo, un portavoz de Instagram confirmó la existencia de esta exploración a Engadget, aunque remarcó que se encuentra en una etapa muy preliminar.
“Se trata de una exploración exclusivamente interna y no se está probando de forma externa con usuarios en absoluto”, indicó el vocero de la compañía.
La formulación del comunicado, sin embargo, no descarta ni confirma una fecha de lanzamiento, y tampoco aclara si la función llegará a estar disponible para el público en algún momento.

articles.title: « Nous allons fabriquer des voitures moins chères » : Renault fait une promesse à 10 milliards d’euros
articles.text:
Face aux prix des carburants qui n’ont jamais été aussi élevés, la voiture électrique a le vent en poupe en raflant désormais plus de 42 % du marché des véhicules neufs sur le mois de septembre. Les constructeurs ont leur carte à jouer pour répondre à la demande et beaucoup souhaiteraient produire toujours moins cher. Dans le torrent d’annonces en tout genre, c’est Renault qui nous sort une promesse très concrète.
Dans un entretien accordé à France Inter, François Provost, le PDG du Losange, a justement réaffirmé l’engagement porté par sa marque sur les voitures électriques : « on constate aujourd’hui que le prix des carburants est absolument incontrôlable. Donc la solution, c’est l’électricité : elle est abondante en France, et son prix est fixe. Les clients qui passent à l’électrique ne retournent pas en arrière, et ce sont nos clients les plus satisfaits ».
10 milliards d’euros en 5 ans : le plan secret de Renault pour casser les prix
Provost ne s’en cache pas, sa marque poursuivra sur cette lancée : « ces cinq dernières années, on a investi 13 milliards d’euros en France pour transformer notre outil industriel et miser sur l’électrique. Dans les cinq prochaines années, si le contexte social et politique le permet, on réinvestira plus de 10 milliards pour pousser sur l’électrique et rendre les voitures plus abordables ». Un tel investissement sera forcément bénéfique sous tous rapports.
Déjà, la production locale n’en sera que renforcée, avec des effets immédiats : « aujourd’hui, nous produisons plus de véhicules en France, dans des usines françaises, qu’auparavant. En 2025, nous avons produit 500 000 voitures en France. En 2026, nous en produirons au moins 25 % de plus grâce à l’essor des véhicules électriques ». Rappelons que face au succès de la Renault 5, l’usine de Douai a dû mettre en place une troisième équipe de production.
750 km d’autonomie et recharge ultra-rapide : ce qui se prépare en coulisses
Il le faut bien, car la France demeure particulièrement importante pour Renault, en représentant 20 % de l’activité globale et 40 % de sa masse salariale dans le monde. L’Hexagone reste donc primordial, même si d’autres pays sont également concernés par ce plan d’envergure. Parmi eux se trouve l’Espagne, qui accueillera deux modèles extrêmement importants pour la firme dans l’usine de Palencia.
Si rien n’a encore été annoncé, les rumeurs convergent vers les nouvelles générations de Scénic et de Rafale électriques basés sur la plateforme RGEV Medium 2.0. Cette dernière devrait enfin ouvrir la technologie 800 V sur les voitures particulières chez Renault et garantir des temps de recharge autrement plus rapides. Les autonomies, elles, pourront pointer jusqu’à 750 km sur le cycle WLTP.
