articles.title: Albatross: Dieser Roboter segelt nach dem Flug auf dem Wasser
articles.text:
Albatross: Dieser Roboter segelt nach dem Flug auf dem Wasser
Um einen möglichst griffigen Namen für ihr Projekt zu finden, müssen Forscherinnen und Forscher bisweilen kreativ sein. Das jüngste Beispiel ist Albatross, das steht für „Airborne Lander with Buoyant AuToROtating Sailing Sensor“ und ist teilweise von Wasservögeln inspiriert.
Auch jenseits der Namensgebung ist das Projekt der Singapore University of Technology and Design innovativ: Das interdisziplinäre Team um Shane Kyi Hla Win hat nämlich einen Roboter entwickelt, der sich verschiedener Prinzipien aus dem Tier- und Pflanzenreich bedient und mit vergleichsweise wenig Hardware gleich mehrere Funktionen erfüllt. Die von unabhängigen Expertinnen und Experten begutachtete Studie ist im Fachmagazin Science Robotics erschienen.
Multimodale Robotik für Luft und Wasser
Konkret handelt es sich bei Albatross um ein multimodales Robotik-System (die Forschenden selbst nennen es eine „Sensor-Plattform“), das aus der Luft abgeworfen wird, sanft auf dem Wasser landet und sich anschließend in ein semi-autonomes Segelboot verwandelt. Die Besonderheit besteht darin, dass das System gerade mal ein Kilogramm wiegt und lediglich drei Stellmotoren und drei Sensoren enthält. Für sichere Landung und Fortbewegung sorgen allein physikalische Effekte.
Albatross ist so konzipiert, dass er von einem Flugzeug oder auch einer Drohne über offenem Gewässer abgeworfen werden kann. Um den Aufprall zu bremsen, benötigt er weder Fallschirm noch Rotoren. Stattdessen nutzt das System das Prinzip der Autorotation: Wie der geflügelte Samen eines Ahorns, beginnt das System, aufgrund von Schwerkraft und Aerodynamik um die eigene Achse zu rotieren, was wiederum Auftrieb erzeugt und gleichzeitig den Fall um ein Vielfaches abbremst.
Im Wasser angekommen, richtet sich das System aufgrund seines tiefen Schwerpunkts augenblicklich selbstständig auf. Die starren Flügel, die zuvor noch für die Rotation und Landung genutzt wurden, dienen nun als Segel. Das Hauptsegel in der Mitte rotiert frei und sowohl ein Vordersegel als auch die sogenannte Windfahne am „Heck“ sorgen für die passende Ausrichtung im Wind – wie bei einer Segelyacht. Da diese Bauteile doppelt genutzt werden, musste das Team keine zusätzlichen Teile hinzufügen.
Mit einem Kompass und GPS ausgestattet, ist Albatross anschließend in der Lage, autonom zu einem vorgegebenen Ziel zu navigieren. Ergänzt wird das System von einer von Fischen inspirierten Heckflosse, die zum Lenken dient und bei Bedarf hin- und herschwingt, um bei wenig Wind zusätzliche Schubeffekte zu erzeugen, immerhin einen knappen halben Meter pro Sekunde.
In Tests hat Albatross einen Fall aus 150 Metern über einem See überstanden und im Windkanal verschiedene Windszenarien gemeistert. In einem Wassertank hat das Team untersucht, welches Material sich am besten für das fischähnliche Ruder eignet. Zuletzt absolvierte das System dreistündige Testfahrten auf einem Stausee in Singapur und fuhr dabei eigenständig vorgegebene Navigationspunkte ab und zeichnete Umweltparameter wie Luftfeuchtigkeit und Wassertemperaturen auf.
Technische Hürden bei multimodalen Robotersystemen
Multimodale Roboter, die verschiedene Fortbewegungsmethoden nutzen, die etwa gleichzeitig fliegen und schwimmen, stellen die Forschung vor große Herausforderungen, schreiben die beiden Robotik-Forscher Raphael Zufferey und Andre Farinha in einem Begleittext zur Studie. Roboter seien deshalb immer noch in den meisten Fällen eingeschränkt: Entweder sie fliegen, oder sie laufen, oder sie schwimmen. Um die Modalitäten zu kombinieren, sucht die Wissenschaft nach Inspiration in der Natur: Denn viele Lebewesen kommen mit verschiedenen Lebensräumen gut klar. „Albatross veranschaulicht ein allgemeineres Prinzip der multimodalen Robotik: Die Natur liefert zwar keine Komplettlösung, stellt jedoch nützliche Komponenten zur Verfügung“, schreiben Zufferey und Farinha.
Dem Team aus Singapur ging es nicht zuletzt darum, zu demonstrieren, wie sich vergleichsweise günstige und simple Lösungen entwickeln lassen, die nicht mit Elektronik, Sensoren und Motoren vollgestopft sind, sondern sich physikalischer Effekte bedienen. Das spart nicht nur Geld, sondern öffnet auch zusätzliche Möglichkeiten: So soll Albatross deutlich mehr Nutzlast in Form zusätzlicher Sensoren transportieren können als andere Flug-Schwimm-Drohnen.
Als mögliches Einsatzgebiet sehen die Forschenden Umweltkatastrophen wie Ölverschmutzungen oder Algenblüten. Roboter wie Albatross könnten hier abgeworfen werden, um Daten schnell und direkt von der Wasseroberfläche zu liefern. Einen Nachteil aber hat das System: Wieder aus dem Wasser abheben kann es nicht. Dieses Feature fehlt dann doch noch, um ein echter Albatros zu sein.
Dieser Artikel wurde ursprünglich am 02.10.2026 veröffentlicht, interessiert jedoch immer noch sehr viele unserer Leser:innen. Deshalb haben wir ihn aktualisiert und hier nochmals zur Verfügung gestellt.

articles.title: Sony prepara una nueva portátil, pero no te emociones todavía
articles.text:
Sony podría lanzar una nueva portátil en 2026. Una filtración dejó al descubierto dos dispositivos con características similares a las de la PlayStation Portal. Aunque algunos rumores han apuntado a que Sony volverá a los tiempos de la Vita o PSP, uno de estos dispositivos podría ser la versión OLED de la portátil más reciente que lanzó PlayStation hace unos años.
De acuerdo con The Verge, una certificación de la Wi-Fi Alliance muestra dos dispositivos basados en Android 15 que podrían ser el relevo de la PlayStation Portal. La compañía lleva casi tres años vendiendo la portátil enfocada al streaming de PS5 sin ofrecer mejoras, por lo que esta filtración estaría relacionada con una actualización necesaria.
Los dos productos de Sony, catalogados como "Consola de juegos/periféricos", se identifican con los números de modelo CFI-Y2000 y CFI-Y2105. Como referencia, la PlayStation Portal actual tiene el número de modelo CFI-Y1001, lo que ubicaría a los dispositivos misteriosos en esta categoría. A esto se suma que los dos funcionan con Android, al igual que la Portal, ya que la PS5 tiene un sistema operativo propio que le permite ejecutar juegos de forma nativa.
Debido a que se trata de una certificación de la Wi-Fi Alliance, los documentos ofrecen información sobre conectividad. Ambos modelos están certificados para Wi-Fi 1x1 en las bandas de 2,4 GHz y 5 GHz. No hay soporte para 6 GHz ni antenas adicionales, algo que no suena muy atractivo si consideramos que la PlayStation Portal está pensada para jugar por streaming. Otras portátiles como la ROG Ally X o la misma Steam Deck OLED admiten Wi-Fi 6E.
Sony apuesta por la PlayStation Portal en lugar de una PS Vita 2
Con la explosión en popularidad de la Steam Deck y otras portátiles para juegos, muchos usuarios esperaban que Sony diera el paso y lanzara una nueva versión de la PS Vita o PSP. La compañía se aventuró por un camino más modesto con la PlayStation Portal, un dispositivo para streaming que parecía no tener brillo, pero que poco a poco fue ganando adeptos.
Los tiempos cambiaron y la crisis de memoria está haciendo estragos en toda la industria, por lo que los planes de una posible PS Vita 2 quedaron enterrados. En su lugar, Sony lanzará una actualización para la PlayStation Portal, posiblemente con pantalla OLED. La compañía dijo hace unos meses que el streaming necesita poca memoria, lo que la convierte en una opción asequible mientras la RAM siga por los cielos.
Una filtración de inicios de 2026 señalaba que la próxima PlayStation Portal llegaría con la arquitectura RDNA 5 de AMD y un panel OLED. Otros rumores apuntaban a un procesador Medusa Halo Mini de AMD con 12 núcleos, pero estas características estaban centradas en un dispositivo de tope de gama que pudiera competir con otras portátiles del mercado. Es difícil que esto ocurra en plena escasez de componentes, por lo que es más probable que veamos una actualización modesta de la Portal.

articles.title: British Business Bank backs multi-fund VC Fuel Ventures with €11 million investment | EU-Startups
articles.text:
The British Business Bank (the Bank) announced €11 million (£10 million) to the Fuel Ventures funds, made through the Bank’s Regional Angels Programme. This programme launched in 2019 to address imbalances in access to early-stage equity finance.
Fuel Ventures was set up to back the next wave of ambitious Tech founders and has since evolved into a multi-stage VC, with funds designed to support companies beyond initial investment, from pre-Seed through to Series A.
“The Regional Angels Programme exists to close gaps in early-stage access to capital across the UK, and this commitment is a good example of that in practice. Fuel Ventures brings founder-operator experience and its offering structure means the capital we’re providing does not stop at the first round—it keeps working for founders as they grow.” said Mark Barry, Senior Investment Director at the British Business Bank.
The Fuel Ventures commitment follows a wider series of investments by the British Business Bank in UK venture and growth-capital managers during 2026. Most directly, the Bank has already committed up to €11.5 million (£10 million) to Ascension Ventures and a further €11 million to SFC Capital through the same Regional Angels Programme, which is intended to reduce geographic imbalances in access to early-stage equity.
Elsewhere this year, EU-Startups has reported British Business Bank commitments of up to €104 million to ten emerging VC managers through Investor Pathways Capital, €46 million to FPE Capital, €35 million to Tapestry VC and €58 million to Soho Square Capital.
More recently, the Bank committed up to €53.6 million to Zinc Capital Management and €87 million to Molten Ventures. Together with the new Fuel Ventures allocation, these disclosed commitments amount to approximately €417 million, spanning funding strategies from pre-Seed and Seed through to later-stage growth.
The Bank has also been deploying capital directly into UK technology companies. In June, EU-Startups reported that its direct investment portfolio had passed 50 companies after more than €695 million had been invested in UK science and technology scale-ups.
Founded by Mark Pearson following the sale of his business MyVoucherCode, Fuel Ventures looks to help secure investment for some of the UK’s most promising early-stage companies who struggle to secure follow-on funding from their existing investors.
This commitment will allow Fuel Ventures to widen its capacity across the fund structure, supporting new early-stage investments and continued follow-on rounds for existing portfolio companies as they scale towards Series A.
Since inception, the Fuel Ventures says its funds have deployed over €330 million (£280 million) across more than 230 early-stage UK companies, including being one of the first investors in companies such as Volt valued at £256m (one of the fastest growing FinTech in Europe), ContentCal who were acquired for €129 million (£110 million) by Adobe, and Capdesk who were acquired for €78 million ($88 million) by Carta.
“We’re built by entrepreneurs for entrepreneurs, wherever they’re building. This backing from the British Business Bank is a strong vote of confidence in the model we’ve built at Fuel, it means we can keep standing behind the founders in our portfolio for longer and support them further as they grow.” added Mark Pearson, founder and Managing Partner of Fuel Ventures.

articles.title: QCon London 2027 Announces 15 Tracks on Production AI, Architecture, and Engineering at Scale
articles.text:
AI is changing decisions across architecture, security, software delivery, and team design. But senior engineers cannot adopt every emerging practice or copy an approach without understanding the system and organizational conditions behind it. The useful questions are why an approach worked, which compromises it required, and whether the same reasoning applies to another team’s systems.
The 15 tracks at QCon London 2027, taking place April 13–16, are organized around those questions. More than 75 practitioner speakers will share production systems they have built, the trade-offs behind them, and what they learned when designs encountered real workloads and organizational constraints.
The program connects emerging AI practices with established concerns in architecture, distributed systems, data platforms, observability, performance, and technical leadership.
Evaluating and controlling agentic systems
Moving an agent from a prototype into production requires teams to define acceptable behavior, test changing outputs, enforce boundaries, and respond when an autonomous system acts unpredictably.
The "Eval Platforms & Guardrails for Agentic AI Systems" track will examine the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and safety mechanisms teams are building around AI-powered software. "Protecting Systems from Humans and Agents" will explore how security changes when failures can originate from human error as well as autonomous agents.
Engineers responsible for production AI can compare how teams test failure modes and divide controls across models, applications, platforms, and operational processes. The aim is not to find one universal guardrail architecture, but to understand which controls address which risks and where gaps can remain.
Deciding what architecture and delivery practices need to change
Adding AI to an existing system introduces new dependencies, probabilistic outputs, data flows, and scaling characteristics. The architectural challenge is not simply deciding where to call a model. Teams must integrate intelligent components without weakening reliability, operability, security, or the ability to change the system later.
The "Architecture in the Age of AI" track will examine patterns for integrating AI while maintaining scalable and reliable systems. "Architectures You’ve Always Wondered About" will look beyond simplified diagrams to the compromises involved when emerging architectural ideas meet production constraints.
AI is also changing how software is planned, written, reviewed, and released. "Designing the SDLC for the Next Era of Software Engineering" will consider how workflows and responsibilities need to evolve. "Using AI for Engineering" will address what it takes to build, scale, and maintain AI-driven systems after the prototype stage.
Together, these tracks address a practical question: which parts of architecture and delivery genuinely need to change for AI, and which established engineering principles remain essential?
Finding the trade-offs across production systems
Teams adopting AI still need to diagnose distributed failures, maintain dependable data flows, understand system behavior, and scale without losing control.
The "Debugging Distributed Systems" track will cover techniques for diagnosing problems across microservices and distributed architectures. "Connecting Systems: APIs, Protocols, Observability" will examine the work required to keep interconnected systems reliable and understandable as they evolve.
The "Modern Data Architectures and Platforms" track will focus on scalable, real-time platforms supporting analytics and AI. "Engineering for High Performance" will examine how teams reduce latency and scale under high load.
These concerns cannot be evaluated independently. A throughput improvement may make debugging harder. A data platform designed for AI workloads may create new operational dependencies. A flexible integration layer may make failure behavior harder to reason about. Production accounts help engineers see these second-order effects before making similar investments.
Extending technical judgment across teams
Architecture and AI decisions increasingly cross team boundaries. Senior engineers must establish direction, challenge assumptions, and create alignment without always having organizational authority.
The "Staff+ Engineering Skills" track will examine influencing across teams and contributing to technical strategy. "Managing Teams in an AI-Driven World" will explore how roles, skills, workflows, and organizational structures are changing as companies adopt AI.
For Staff+ engineers and architects, the relevant question is not only whether a technical decision is sound. It is whether its reasoning can be communicated, challenged, and applied consistently across an organization.
Testing ideas against your own context
The conversations continue outside the scheduled presentations. Unconference sessions allow attendees to bring a current problem and compare possible approaches with other practitioners. Longer breaks provide time to continue technical discussions, and most session recordings remain available for 12 months.
The goal is not to collect practices to copy unchanged. It is to understand the conditions under which an approach worked, the compromises involved, and whether the same reasoning applies to the systems and teams you are responsible for.
Attendees who want to apply the program to a specific architecture challenge can join the InfoQ Certified Software Architect in Emerging Technologies program. It combines the three conference days with a dedicated peer cohort and a half-day workshop on April 16 led by Luca Mezzalira, an O’Reilly author and former AWS and DAZN architect. Participants work through real architecture challenges and earn the ICSAET credential after completing the program.
QCon London 2027 takes place at the QEII Centre in London. The conference runs April 13–15, followed by the certification workshop on April 16. Early-bird conference tickets are £2,290 through October 13. Conference and certification tickets are £2,800 through October 13.

articles.title: Utah will become first state to let AI examine patients and prescribe medication without direct human oversight
articles.text:
A hot potato: Being a doctor is one of the jobs expected to be least at risk from AI replacement. But a new program launched in Utah is raising questions over that assumption. A healthcare startup will begin offering AI examinations and prescriptions to patients without direct human oversight, making Utah the first state to replace a doctor with an AI.
The good news is that the program is currently very limited in its scope. It's just one year long and only for patients with mild-to-moderate acne.
The process works when a person signs up for Nolla Health's $4.99-per-month app and uses it to scan their face. After completing a medical history and personal information form, the AI analyzes their skin, identifies the acne problem, rates the skin's oiliness, and then generates a numerical acne severity score that ranges between clear skin and severe acne, reports Bloomberg.
The AI then combines that score with the provided medical information to recommend medication from a list of eight approved treatments.
While the program will eventually become fully automated, the first 100 prescriptions will have to be reviewed by actual doctors before they are submitted to the pharmacy.
In the second phase, the next 400 patients will have their prescriptions submitted to pharmacies by the AI and reviewed retrospectively by a physician weekly.
The final phase will involve a doctor reviewing at least 10% of the total prescriptions issued once a month.
We've repeatedly seen the dangers of putting your trust in AI when it comes to medical/healthcare advice. One of the more famous cases came last year when a 60-year-old man took ChatGPT's advice and replaced the salt in his diet with sodium bromide, causing bromism, a psychiatric disorder not commonly seen since the 19th century.
In March, Google quietly dropped an AI-powered search feature called What People Suggest, which offered crowdsourced health advice from people who share similar medical conditions or experiences. The move came just a couple of months after the company removed several of its AI Overviews following a report that found inaccurate information was being shown to users, potentially putting their health at risk.
In the case of Nolla Health, CEO Luis Wenus said the adverse effects of the eight approved medications are limited to localized skin irritation or dryness. The prescriptions are also limited to topical medications rather than pills.
While this is a small program, it could be the very first step toward AI taking the place of doctors, or at least being used to treat less serious conditions in patients.

articles.title: Globo coloca propaganda até na tela de login do Globoplay • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Globo coloca propaganda até na tela de login do Globoplay
Novo formato de publicidade se chama Welcome Ads.
O Globoplay vai começar a exibir anúncios na tela de login e seleção de perfil. Batizado de Welcome Ad, o novo formato permite que marcas apareçam antes mesmo de o usuário escolher o que assistir no serviço de streaming.
A Globo declarou ao Tecnoblog que o formato foi desenvolvido para “combinar alcance, atenção e experiência de navegação“, de modo a criar “uma nova oportunidade de conexão entre marcas e consumidores em um dos momentos mais qualificados da jornada dentro da plataforma”.
A proposta do Welcome Ads é colocar as propagandas antes da reprodução de filmes, séries, novelas ou transmissões ao vivo. O anúncio ocupa a tela de acesso ou seleção de perfil, e a marca pode aparecer logo no primeiro contato com a plataforma. O primeiro projeto foi feito com a Magazine Luiza e a agência Ogilvy.
De acordo com o Portal Publicitário, os anúncios seriam destinados às TVs de usuários gratuitos logados e aos assinantes do plano com publicidade. Até o momento, não há indicação de que clientes dos planos sem anúncios também serão impactados.
A novidade amplia a estratégia publicitária do streaming, que já inclui outros formatos próprios. Há dois anos, o Globoplay lançou o plano Padrão com Anúncios. Atualmente, a mensalidade custa R$ 22,90 no plano com anúncios e R$ 39,90 no plano Premium.
A emissora ainda não forneceu informações como frequência de exibição, duração das campanhas ou critérios utilizados para escolher quais anúncios aparecem para cada usuário. Mais detalhes devem ser apresentados durante o evento Upfront, marcado para 14 de outubro. Ele se destina aos anunciantes e agências do setor.
O movimento acompanha uma tendência observada em plataformas rivais. Serviços de streaming vêm aumentando a importância da publicidade como fonte de receita e criando formatos que vão além dos intervalos tradicionais.
A Netflix, por exemplo, planeja ampliar a quantidade e os formatos de anúncios em sua modalidade mais barata. Em 2026, a empresa afirmou que o plano com publicidade já reunia 250 milhões de usuários globalmente.
O Amazon Prime Video seguiu uma estratégia diferente e passou a incluir propagandas nos planos existentes, cobrando um valor adicional para quem prefere assistir sem interrupções.

articles.title: Razer Unveils Wolverine V4 Line of Wireless Xbox Controllers
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 6th 2026
Razer Unveils Wolverine V4 Line of Wireless Xbox Controllers
Razer, the leading global lifestyle brand for gamers, today announced the new Razer Wolverine V4 line, including the wireless Razer Wolverine V4 Pro and wired Razer Wolverine V4 Tournament Edition, the next generation of esports controllers officially designed for XBOX and PC.
Packed with new features, the Wolverine V4 Pro wireless XBOX and PC controller is equipped with high-resolution capacitive thumbstick sensors, the next evolution of contactless sensor design, as well as four newly designed magnetic swappable back buttons, a removable faceplate, and up to a blistering 8,000 Hz polling rate, giving competitive gamers the edge they need in FPS titles, racing sims, and more.
LastShot, 2025 Halo World Champion, Shopify Rebellion"This controller is damn near perfect - It's everything I loved about the Wolverine V3 taken to the next level. The new back button design is incredibly convenient for creating my perfect layout, the buttons feel as fast and responsive as ever before, and the improved polling rate is exactly what I need to stay ahead of the competition."
The Pinnacle of Precision
Powering the Wolverine V4 line's asymmetrical thumbstick layout are two new capacitive sensors, the next step in contactless sensor design, offering superior resolution, power efficiency and resistance to magnetic interference over TMR and Hall Effect counterparts, while maintaining the drift-resistant performance of both. Paired with a 16-bit ADC chip, the sensors register approximately 3,000 steps of movement for smoother tracking, reduced jitter, and overall higher accuracy for dominant FPS play.For multi-platform gamers, the Wolverine V4 line is a versatile gaming controller, providing fast and reliable connectivity on the XBOX Series X|S consoles at up to 250 Hz. On PC, performance climbs up to 8,000 Hz HyperPolling, wired or wireless, for up to 32 times more frequent positional reporting than standard controllers and up to 8x faster than entry-level esports controllers, delivering tighter aim and more precise movement.
With faster polling rate comes lower latency. The Wolverine V4 line features Razer's fastest response times ever, achieving sub-1 ms response times, ensuring every trigger pull, button press, and thumbstick movement is registered as intended.
Always in Control
A new magnetic design lets the Razer Wolverine V4 Pro swap its four removable back buttons and two claw-grip bumpers in or out in seconds, so gamers can reload, use gadgets, slide, and more, all without lifting a thumb off the sticks. Gamers can mix and match a nearly limitless number of combinations from one, two, three, or four back buttons to build their perfect loadout.Razer Pro HyperTriggers delivers two distinct trigger feels in a single controller. Using the back-mounted trigger lock, gamers can toggle between near-instant actuation for rapid-fire FPS gameplay or a full-range analog pull for precise control in racing sims. Through Razer Synapse, gamers can dial in their exact trigger actuation point anywhere in the range from 1.3 mm to 8.2 mm, tailoring feel to their playstyle.
Reinforced PBT mecha-tactile face buttons provide fast and concise feedback, while the 8-way floating D-pad delivers smooth travel and fast actuation for both clean cardinal inputs and fast diagonal movement - built to hold up through long-term competitive play.
Textured TPU side grips give players a secure, comfortable hold through the longest sessions, keeping the controller planted during high-pressure clutch moments and marathon sessions of competitive gaming.
Customization Without Compromise
Multi-title gamers can create four unique profiles to swap easily between custom bindings and sensitivity settings, delivering the best loadout on the fly, from competitive FPS to action-adventure to racing sim.Within those profiles, players can create unique bindings across any of the six mappable multi-function buttons, adjust dead zones from as low as 0% to as high as 15%, and fine-tune trigger actuation to set their ideal range of motion.
For those who want their style to match their play, the Wolverine V4 Pro features a removable magnetic faceplate that can be personalized, swapped for other designs, or left off entirely - no tools required.
The controller also gives players a total of six interchangeable thumbstick caps to choose from: Pre-loaded short concave caps for a well-balanced experience, short convex caps with a smooth texture for fast rolling movements, or tall concave micro-textured caps for more granular, precision aiming.One Controller. Every Advantage.
- Precision That Wins - new contactless capacitive thumbstick sensors deliver drift-free accuracy, while up to 8,000 Hz HyperPolling and button latency as low as sub-1 ms keep every input instant.
- Six Mappable Action Buttons for Total Control - four magnetic swappable back buttons and two claw-grip bumpers, Razer Pro HyperTriggers tunable from near-instant 1.3 mm actuation to a full 8.2 mm pull, plus PBT mecha-tactile face buttons and an 8-way floating D-pad.
- Yours to Tune - four onboard Synapse profiles with remappable inputs and dead-zone control, a swappable magnetic faceplate, replaceable thumbstick caps, and textured TPU grips.
Jeffrey Chau, Head of Global Esports at Razer"At Razer, we build for the pros, which means listening to what competitive players actually need to win. The Wolverine V4 line is the result: high-resolution precision, ultra-fast response, and the customization to make it their own, engineered to meet the demands of the world's best."
Built for FPS, racing, and competitive sports rather than a one-size-fits-all pad, the Wolverine V4 line brings drift-free precision, ultra-fast response, and deep customization together in one platform, purpose-built to win.

articles.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy | TechCrunch
articles.text:
From Muse to Instinct to Dots, tech firms are hunting for the user experience that will make an AI personal assistant a must-have product.
Hark, a startup founded less than a year ago by serial founder Brett Adcock, is throwing its hat in the ring today with the wide release of Hark Pro. Users can access the service for free, with a subscription tier for heavy users.
The company sees its mission as building a user interface for AI, not creating AGI or curing cancer. The foundation is a model trained specifically for computer use, and that’s what Hark Pro does — it uses your computer for you.
That’s perhaps a less ambitious claim than some frontier labs are making, but a little humility goes a long way in winning over users. And rather than an app, Hark’s goal is to create an operating system for the AI computers of our future.
Hark Pro is a full-screen experience with a kind of homepage, featuring a central chat dialog and a feed populated by prompts for actions you might need it to take and visualizations the company calls “panels” that offer mini-dashboards for things you’re interested in. The background is a piece of custom imagery tailored to the weather and time where you are.
Like other AI assistants, users configure it to access their digital life — email, calendar, hard drive, credit cards, etc. Then, it can take on digital tasks as well as fielding classic chatbot questions.
Abidur Chowdhury, a former Apple staffer who leads design at Hark, demoed the product for me. It proactively asked him about expenses he needed to approve, emails he needed to respond to, a meeting with this reporter, and, of course, pointed out that he needed to book a flight for a trip and offered to take care of it. (“I know the flight thing is put to death,” he admits, grinning.)
That does get at the challenge with these apps: One of the harder things for users is actually coming up with useful tasks they are capable of accomplishing. Chowdhury says he was impressed when the AI assistant recently recognized that one of his colleagues needed to renew their car registration at the California DMV, and handled it through the agency’s website.
One notable UX choice that Hark makes is showing the user how the agent navigates the web in a small window, an action most AI assistants perform without it surfacing in the app, which Chowdhury says is intended to build trust with users that the agent is doing the right thing.
That matters because part of Hark’s pitch is that they are not Meta or OpenAI — “we’re not here to like sell you ads and steal your data,” Chowdhury says. To truly leverage these models, users will need to share their entire digital lives. Beyond very real cybersecurity concerns, will users be comfortable with a company like Meta having its products create detailed profiles of their friends and family?
Asked about that kind of profiling, Chowdhury says that “we are doing work to understand you, and be helpful for what you need, but it’s really like task-related — it’s really about how Hark can help take something off your plate and be useful.”
What sets Hark Pro apart from its competitors, Chowdhury says, is its effort to fully subsitute for your computer, but also his belief that it just works better.
“Please compare it to the others, be critical,” he says. “It might not be faster than Muse, but it will give you a better result, and it will work end-to-end instead of asking you to take over at a point.”
One open question is what kind of model best suits the AI personal assistant. Hark’s is explicitly trained for computer use, which makes it faster and cheaper at those tasks, but it’s not clear how much it is trading away the broader knowledge and capability of a frontier LLM.
This software is only half the promise of Hark; Chowdhury made his name designing devices at Apple and Hark promises to release an AI-native device to support its software in 2027.
They’re still cagey about the form it will take, with Chowdhury bemoaning the “creep factor” of wearable cameras. “I will give you this: The first product that we’re building is a product that’s never ever existed before,” he says. We’ll have to wait and see if this is mere hype and Hark puts out some retread tech instead of a truly novel product.
“It’s so hilarious to me that you have AI now, you have a chatbot, and you type stuff in with a keyboard,” Chowdhury says. “Fifty years later and the future of computing is still a terminal.”

articles.title: Support Ars and get a better reading experience in return
articles.text:
When Ars launched in 1998, there was one way to read it: in a web browser on a PC (or Mac). Your screen of choice was either some massive CRT or a very expensive LCD monitor (or, in my case, the less-expensive grayscale, passive-matrix LCD on a PowerBook). Either way, it was butt in chair, chair at desk.
One of the first perks we offered subscribers way back at the turn of the millennium allowed them to read Ars without a browser. Articles were available as formatted PDF files, so you could print out John Siracusa’s Mac OS X Public Beta review and read it on the subway or build your own searchable archive of your curated Ars content. Another option was full-text RSS feeds—instead of getting a two-paragraph summary, subscribers could browse Ars in their favorite RSS reader.
It’s 2026, and while screens have proliferated in size and portability, ArsPro subscribers still get PDFs of every article and full-text RSS feeds, because sometimes the web isn’t always the ideal place to read the web.

articles.title: Xbox Elite Series 3 Controller Leaked by Microsoft
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 6th 2026
Xbox Elite Series 3 Controller Leaked by Microsoft
The next-generation Xbox Elite Series 3 controller has been revealed by none other than Microsoft. Within the Design Lab service, where gamers can customize their Xbox controllers and order them directly, Microsoft recorded a controller named "Edessa," which is linked to an accessory or customization product called "Beatrice." Today, we learn that Microsoft is preparing a more customizable controller than the current Elite Series 2. Thumbstick options reportedly include Hall effect modules with standard, loose, and tight tensions, along with a TMR-based option. This could allow users to choose both the sensing technology and the feel of the sticks. There is also a low-friction "silent" stick option, available in standard and longer neck designs.
Haptic feedback may also receive an upgrade. One listed motor configuration combines impulse trigger motors with voice-coil haptics, potentially delivering more advanced feedback than the existing Elite controller. Another feature mentioned is an "Audio Scroll Wheel," which seems to indicate a dedicated physical dial for controlling audio. Faceplates include metal finishes, predefined designs, multiple colors, and engraving options. Paddle configurations are similarly extensive, covering standard, classic, and doublewide shapes, with different lengths and layouts, including a Butterfly arrangement or no upper paddles. Several D-pad designs are also listed, with separate cosmetic and performance variants. The Beatrice platform alone reportedly contains 27 topper and paddle combinations.Four SKUs appear in the data, including Elite Complete and Base versions, each available with or without motors. The Elite Complete package reportedly includes a carrying case, charging dock, and additional paddle configurations, while the Base model comes with a cable and a simpler setup. Although Microsoft and Spectrum, the configurator provider used by Xbox Design Lab, have since removed the data from public records, some information has remained, thanks to a cautious Redditor, u/esketitethan.

articles.title: FirstCry-backed Swara Baby Products gets Sebi nod for Rs 1,000 Cr IPO
articles.text:
FirstCry-backed Swara Baby Products gets Sebi nod for Rs 1,000 Cr IPO
The IPO will be a combination of fresh issue of shares and offer for sale.
Swara Baby Products, a contract manufacturer of baby diapers, adult diapers and feminine hygiene products backed by FirstCry, received Sebi's approval on Tuesday to proceed with its proposed Rs 1,000 crore Initial Public Offering (IPO), an update with the regulator showed.
The proposed IPO comprises a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to Rs 500 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) valued at Rs 500 crore by promoters, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP).
The OFS includes the sale of shares worth up to Rs 300 crore by Brainbees Solutions Ltd and up to Rs 200 crore by Anadya Bon Merchari LLP.
The company filed its preliminary IPO papers on July 2 with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) and obtained the regulator's final observation on October 6.
The Sebi observations mark an important step in the IPO process, allowing companies to proceed with preparations for their public issues, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.
As per the draft papers, the company proposes to utilise the net proceeds from the fresh issue to set up a new manufacturing facility in Madhya Pradesh with an allocation of Rs 198.2 crore, repay or prepay borrowings amounting to Rs 100 crore, and invest Rs 27.5 crore in subsidiaries Solis Hygiene, Swara Hygiene and K.A. Enterprises Hygiene Pvt Ltd (KAEHPL) for repayment of their outstanding borrowing.
Additionally, funds will be used to pursue inorganic growth through acquisitions and for general corporate purposes.
Swara Baby may also undertake a pre-IPO placement of up to Rs 100 crore.
Founded in 2018, Swara Baby manufactures disposable hygiene products across baby care, adult incontinence and feminine hygiene segments. Its portfolio includes baby diapers, adult diapers, sanitary napkins and panty liners, primarily manufactured under contract for consumer brands.

articles.title: « Ne payez jamais » : un moteur de données volées tend un nouveau piège à ses victimes
articles.text:
Il passe de main en main à toute vitesse. Depuis l’enquête de RTL adaptée en vidéo par M6 Info le 29 septembre, de nombreux lookups circulent parmi des milliers de Français.
Parmi ces sites alimentés par des données issues de fuites, l’un d’eux semble avoir tiré la couverture à lui plus que les autres, et attire chaque jour davantage de visiteurs grâce à de nombreuses possibilités de recherche, sans même avoir à créer un compte. Qu’il s’agisse de personnes malveillantes ou de simples curieux, l’effet boule de neige est bien réel, et les administrateurs du site l’ont bien compris.
Depuis quelques jours, ils proposent un nouveau service qui n’est rien d’autre qu’une immense arnaque : faire disparaître ses propres données du moteur contre de l’argent.
La pratique a pris une telle ampleur qu’elle a fait réagir Anne Le Hénanff, ministre déléguée chargée de l’Intelligence artificielle et du Numérique, qui a annoncé le 5 octobre avoir effectué un signalement auprès du procureur de Paris et a mis en garde les personnes concernées : « ne payez jamais pour faire retirer vos données ».
Payer pour effacer des données volées
Présenté sous la bannière « Suppression RGPD », avec un badge « Droit à l’effacement » censé lui donner une apparence officielle, le service promet à l’internaute qui découvre son nom, son adresse ou son téléphone dans le moteur de retirer ses fiches en un clic.
Chaque suppression coûte un crédit, vendu par lots de 30 à 1 000. Le pack de 100 crédits est affiché à 25 euros au lieu de 50, soit 25 centimes la fiche, avec une réduction de 50 % mise en avant pour pousser à l’achat.
Le montage est d’abord une arnaque parce que le droit à l’effacement prévu par le RGPD est gratuit. Aucun responsable de traitement ne peut, en principe, facturer une demande de suppression, et encore moins un site qui exploite illégalement des données issues de piratages.
La promesse d’une suppression définitive ne vaut rien non plus. En effet, rien ne permet de vérifier que les fiches sont réellement effacées des serveurs du site, ni qu’elles ne seront pas réinjectées plus tard. Surtout, les données ne disparaissent pas des fuites d’origine, qui continuent de circuler sur les forums et dans les autres lookups.
Les données fuitées ne s’effacent pas
Car c’est bien là le problème, il est impossible de retirer des données personnelles une fois qu’elles ont fuité.
Comme le rappelle Seblatombe, fondateur du site FrenchBreaches, la meilleure chose à faire pour améliorer son hygiène numérique reste de limiter ce qui pourra fuiter demain, en supprimant ses données des sites et services que l’on n’utilise plus.
FrenchBreaches rapporte d’ailleurs ce 6 octobre qu’un autre lookup, qui revendique plus de 740 milliards d’enregistrements indexés, est la cible d’une revendication de piratage. Une preuve de plus qu’il ne faut jamais confier ses données à ce type de site, même pour tenter de les faire effacer.

articles.title: ChatGPT va bientôt marquer ses textes avec un filigrane invisible dans l’UE
articles.text:
À son tour, ChatGPT s’apprête à déployer un système de marquage invisible pour les textes générés par IA. La nouveauté devrait débarquer dans l’Union européenne dans les prochaines semaines pour répondre aux nouvelles exigences de l’AI Act.
Il y a d’abord eu Gemini, avec SynthID, puis Claude, avec une version modifiée du système de Google. Dans les prochaines semaines, ChatGPT leur emboîtera le pas avec textGrain. Déjà éprouvé en interne, le dispositif d’OpenAI intégrera aux textes produits par le chatbot et Codex un signal invisible, sorte de signature statistique censée faciliter leur identification a posteriori. Impossible à repérer à la lecture, ce filigrane doit pouvoir répondre aux obligations européennes de traçabilité des contenus générés par IA.
Un filigrane caché dans le choix des mots
Dans le détail, textGrain ne reposera ni sur l’ajout de caractères cachés ni sur des métadonnées glissées dans les réponses de ChatGPT, mais orientera légèrement le choix des mots du modèle au fil de la génération afin de faire émerger un motif statistique détectable. Forcément, plus le passage sera long, plus le détecteur aura de matière pour en établir la présence avec fiabilité.
D’après les tests d’OpenAI, un texte de 200 tokens consacré à la psychologie est ainsi attribué à ses modèles dans environ 80 % des cas, contre près de 95 % pour un texte de 400 tokens, pour un seuil fixé à 1 % de faux positifs. Les performances chutent en revanche sur les contenus soumis à un vocabulaire plus contraint, comme ce peut être le cas en mathématiques.
En théorie, le procédé ne devrait pas trop peser sur la qualité rédactionnelle des réponses, dixit OpenAI. TextGrain devrait commencer son déploiement dans les prochaines semaines sur ChatGPT et Codex dans l’Union européenne, quel que soit le forfait souscrit. Les clients de l’API peuvent déjà l’activer dans le monde entier sur les modèles compatibles.
Quelques retouches peuvent déjà brouiller la piste
Sans grande surprise, parce qu’il repose sur le choix des mots, textGrain résiste assez mal à la réécriture. Toujours d’après OpenAI, remplacer 10 % du vocabulaire par des synonymes dans un texte de 400 tokens fait chuter le taux de détection à 66 %. Un pourcentage qui s’effondre à 17 % si l’on modifie un quart des mots.
Une reformulation plus poussée ou une traduction peuvent donc considérablement dégrader le signal, voire le rendre caduc, ce qui exclut d’emblée le recours à textGrain comme détecteur universel des textes produits par l’IA. Un résultat négatif pourrait en effet aussi bien trahir un filigrane perdu en cours de route qu’un texte antérieur au dispositif ou résultant d’un modèle qui ne l’utilise pas.
À noter enfin que, même lorsqu’il repère le filigrane, le détecteur ne permet ni d’identifier l’utilisateur à l’origine du texte, ni de déterminer le prompt employé, ni de savoir quelle part du contenu relève d’un travail humain. Dans un premier temps, OpenAI préfère donc en réserver l’accès aux chercheurs agréés et aux organismes spécialisés, afin d’en éprouver la fiabilité et les usages.

articles.title: India among top 10 emerging markets in AI readiness; private AI investment triples: World Bank
articles.text:
India among top 10 emerging markets in AI readiness; private AI investment triples: World Bank
The presence of large technical workforce, strong IT industry, and digital public infrastructure has put India in the top 10 bracket for AI readiness.
India is among the top 10 leading emerging-market performers in artificial intelligence (AI) readiness and is well positioned to harness the technology, helped by its large technical workforce, globally integrated IT sector and digital public infrastructure, the World Bank said on Tuesday.
In its latest report titled 'India and Artificial Intelligence: Seizing the Development Opportunity', the World Bank said private investment in AI in India more than tripled to $ 4.1 billion in 2025 from $1.2 billion in 2024.
At the same time, the number of professionals employed by Global Capability Centres (GCCs) rose to 2.36 million in 2025 from 1.9 million a year ago, it said.
The report, however, noted that the long-term economic and labour market impact of AI remains uncertain.
It called for cross-cutting policy measures to deepen AI-enabling infrastructure, improve the business environment, broaden access to AI and enhance labour capacity so that the benefits of the technology are widely shared.
"India is one of the top 10 leading emerging-market performers on AI readiness," said Paul Procee, World Bank Acting Country Director for India.
"Harnessing AI as a development tool – not just a technology – could be one of the most powerful levers India has to boost productivity and improve public services," he said.
The World Bank Group is also investing through AgriConnect in 'small AI' targeted and locally adapted tools aimed at ensuring that the benefits of AI reach a wider section of the population while supporting workers through the transition, he said.
The India Development Update is a companion to the World Bank Group's South Asia Economic Update, which examines economic developments and prospects in the region.
The latest South Asia Economic Update projects that South Asia will grow 6.9 per cent in 2026, retaining its position as the world's fastest-growing region, the report said.
For most of South Asia, the biggest gains from AI are likely to come from adopting and adapting the technology to local conditions, including through small AI applications suited to low-resource settings, it said.

articles.title: Cette éolienne française de 12 mètres ressemble à une antenne 5G, et c'est fait exprès — Frandroid
articles.text:
À Plouisy, dans les Côtes-d’Armor, vient de « pousser » une éolienne pas comme les autres. Installée par Collaborative Energy sur le site de l’entreprise Titan Préfa, cette éolienne au design singulier a la particularité d’avoir un rotor à axe vertical, contrairement à la quasi-totalité des éoliennes aujourd’hui installées dans le monde.
Née en 2016 en Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Collaborative Energy a d’abord installé un parc pilote dans le Var, avant de s’implanter en Bretagne, où sont fabriqués une bonne partie des éléments de Quinoa : les pales chez SMM Composites, à Lorient, et l’électronique chez Ovalt, à Rennes et Lamballe-Armor.
L’éolienne de Plouisy, de seulement 12 mètres de haut, est destinée à produire de l’électricité pour Titan Préfa, pour lui permettre de réduire leur facture d’électricité en privilégiant l’autoconsommation.
Côté caractéristiques, Quinoa affiche une puissance nominale de 10 kW, avec trois pales en composite de 6 mètres. Collaborative Energy annonce une production comprise entre 5 et 52 MWh par an selon le vent : une fourchette qui va du simple au décuple, et qui dépend entièrement du site d’installation.
Pour l’heure, ce modèle est un prototype destiné à mieux caractériser le comportement de l’éolienne en situation réelle et d’en savoir plus sur son rendement effectif. Un parc pilote d’une dizaine d’éoliennes est également prévu du côté de Paimpol, pour alimenter des exploitations agricoles et agroalimentaires.
D’après Christophe Lévêque, le patron de Collaborative Energy, interrogé par Le Journal des Entreprises, ce parc associera dans un premier temps dix éoliennes à un hectare de panneaux solaires, pour couvrir environ 20 % de la consommation d’acteurs agricoles et agroalimentaires qui pèsent, au total, l’équivalent de 2 000 foyers. Le projet coûte un peu moins d’un million d’euros, et 40 éoliennes supplémentaires pourraient suivre pour monter à 50 % de leurs besoins.
Une bataille perdue contre les éoliennes horizontales
Si les éoliennes à axe vertical sont vraisemblablement les premières éoliennes de l’histoire, elles ont perdu la bataille face aux modèles horizontaux. Plusieurs modèles, comme le rotor Darrieus, ont pourtant suscité de vrais espoirs. De nombreux prototypes ont été construits à travers le monde, comme le projet Éole, à Cap-Chat, au Québec. Néanmoins, ce format d’éolienne a plusieurs inconvénients. D’abord, du fait de leur architecture, les pales des éoliennes verticales génèrent de nombreuses perturbations du flux d’air qui finissent par faire baisser la production moyenne d’électricité par rapport à une turbine horizontale.
Surtout, du fait de la rotation verticale, les contraintes du vent sur les éléments mécaniques changent constamment, ce qui accélère l’usure des différents composants de l’éolienne. Le projet canadien Éole en est l’exemple parfait. Mise en service en 1987, l’éolienne devait atteindre 4 mégawatts (MW), mais elle a très vite été bridée à environ 2,5 MW, son exploitant ayant choisi de la faire tourner moins vite que prévu. Elle a été définitivement arrêtée en 1993, après la casse de son roulement principal, jugée trop coûteuse à réparer.
Des avantages en zone urbaine
Malgré ces contraintes pour les modèles de grande taille, les éoliennes verticales de plus petite taille ont des avantages. Outre un encombrement souvent plus contenu, elles s’adaptent mieux aux vents irréguliers et turbulents que l’on retrouve sur des sites urbains, et plus généralement près du sol. Collaborative Energy n’a pas encore publié de chiffres de production mesurés sur le prototype de Plouisy : ce sont eux qui diront si Quinoa peut vraiment aider des sites industriels à produire leur propre électricité.

articles.title: Agentes rebeldes de OpenAI intentaron hackear Wikipedia: "No debemos permitir que esta sea la nueva normalidad"
articles.text:
El hackeo a Hugging Face fue solo la punta del iceberg de la polémica por el accionar de los "agentes rebeldes" de OpenAI. Los bots impulsados por la inteligencia artificial de dicha empresa también atacaron portales del gobierno de Australia y a un centenar de organizaciones. Una de las últimas en dar a conocer este tipo de situaciones fue la Fundación Wikimedia, la responsable de Wikipedia.
A través de su blog oficial, la Fundación Wikimedia reveló la detección de actividad de agentes de OpenAI. La naturaleza de los eventos en cuestión todavía se desconoce, pero se han observado diferentes instancias de acciones automatizadas por parte de la IA desarrollada por la firma californiana.
"No encontramos pruebas de que nuestros sistemas se utilizaran para la coordinación entre agentes. Tampoco hay indicios de que nuestros sistemas o datos se vieran comprometidos. Sin embargo, nos preocupa lo que podría haber ocurrido [...]. La web abierta es un bien público. No debemos permitir que este comportamiento se convierta en la «nueva normalidad» para las personas u organizaciones que la mantienen", indican los desarrolladores de Wikipedia.
Puntualmente, se mencionan múltiples intentos de edición en entradas de Wikipedia. La investigación determinó que las modificaciones no se publicaron en páginas visibles para el público general, por lo que hay indicios de una posible finalidad maliciosa detrás de este comportamiento. Esto se debe a que se han registrado aparentes intentos de utilizar una herramienta de citado de la enciclopedia para descargar datos de servicios remotos.
Por otra parte, se registró un volumen excesivo de descarga de datos a través de las API públicas de la Fundación Wikimedia. La organización cree que el tráfico desmedido provocó la caída parcial de lo que se conoce como Wikidate Query Services en mayo pasado.
Por último, los agentes de OpenAI intentaron hackear Etherpad, una aplicación de código abierto para tomar notas que cuenta con funciones colaborativas y que es muy utilizada por los desarrolladores de Wikipedia. Vale mencionar que las IA rebeldes no habrían logrado su cometido a pesar de múltiples intentos.
Wikipedia reclama que OpenAI se responsabilice por el accionar de sus agentes
La Fundación Wikipedia no se opone al funcionamiento de los agentes de IA. No obstante, sí reclama que las empresas a las que pertenecen se hagan responsables de sus acciones. En tal sentido, la organización explica que los intentos reiterados de acceso sin autorización a características o infraestructuras son de tal magnitud que terminan generando costes muy grandes, pero también llevan al colapso de servidores y a que los voluntarios tengan que perder el tiempo para arreglar el caos que los bots dejan en la plataforma.
"Wikipedia fue diseñada para seres humanos, y el comportamiento de los agentes plantea claramente desafíos para los que nadie tiene solución. Debido a nuestro modelo único y exitoso de creación de conocimiento, los voluntarios de Wikimedia son quienes entran en contacto directo con los agentes de IA y se encargan de limpiar el desorden que estos dejan a su paso", indican desde la Fundación.
Los creadores de Wikipedia reclaman que OpenAI y otras compañías de inteligencia artificial se hagan cargo de las acciones de sus agentes y que tomen medidas para mitigar los riesgos asociados. "Las empresas de IA no están haciendo lo suficiente para asegurar sus sistemas y proteger al público de los daños que estos causan. Esa carga está recayendo sobre todos los demás, incluidas las organizaciones más pequeñas", explicaron.
No es la primera vez que Wikipedia padece los efectos de la inteligencia artificial generativa. En octubre del año pasado, la Enciclopedia Libre reveló que estaba sufriendo una drástica reducción en el tráfico humano. Esto, debido a la cada vez mayor inclinación de los usuarios a depender de forma directa de las respuestas generadas por los resúmenes de IA de Google y otros buscadores.

articles.title: Un pueblo gallego está empezando a convivir con los lobos como si fueran perros callejeros
articles.text:
El 15 de septiembre, en Grille, una parroquia de Mazaricos (A Coruña), una loba lactante y un macho devoraron un potro mientras pastaba en un terreno dentro del propio núcleo del pueblo. No fue en el monte ni en una cabaña aislada. Y los vecinos, según recogió La Voz de Galicia, están atemorizados. Porque lo que inquieta no es tanto el potro como la distancia: aseguran que el lobo se arrima cada vez más a las casas, a la gente, mostrándose cada vez más confiado. Y esto no es ‘La princesa Mononoke’.
Qué está pasando en Mazaricos. El potro ha sido la última víctima. En los últimos meses ha habido ataques en granjas de Grille, Agris y Alborés. En Alborés, un lobo entró en una corte y mató una xata, y en otra granja el ganado se salvó gracias a un mastín. Muchos vecinos usan perros y pastores, pero el medio G24 recuerda que son medidas que no siempre funcionan. Creen que los lobos buscan en las granjas la comida que les falta en el monte. Según el censo oficial, la presencia del lobo se sitúa principalmente el norte de Lugo y A Coruña, el sur de Ourense y la Costa da Morte.
Demasiado cerca. Los cazadores y expertos coinciden en que no hay ataques registrados a personas y en que el lobo es “huidizo”. El problema es otro: el veterinario Chisco Lema, experto en el lobo de la Costa da Morte, explica que en zonas por las que pasan perros con frecuencia, los lobos se habitúan y se especializan en cazarlos. Los cazadores de la zona de Santiago aseguran que mataron perros a unos 50 metros de viviendas y que las manadas siguen al corzo y al jabalí hasta el pueblo.
La Federación Gallega de Caza admite que el lobo ha aprendido a cazar perros, aunque en cifras lo considera un problema menor. Y esto envenena el ambiente. En la Serra da Capelada, una de las zonas más castigadas, aparecieron jabalinas envenenadas en pleno conflicto por los ataques (porque hay quien toma medidas por su cuenta en vez de informar).
Los números del conflicto. En 2025, la Xunta registró 1.911 avisos por supuestos ataques, con 3.112 reses afectadas, casi la mitad en Lugo. En 2024 fueron unas 3.300, frente a 2.800 el año anterior. El Gobierno gallego habla de nueve reses atacadas al día. Las ayudas por daños de octubre de 2024 a septiembre de 2025 sumaron 1.272 concesiones y más de 850.000 euros, y entre 2016 y 2025 la Xunta ha destinado cerca de 13,8 millones a prevención y compensaciones.
Por otro lado, los ganaderos denuncian que las indemnizaciones tardan hasta nueve meses o un año, y la Xunta dice que el Estado le debe dinero: 12 millones. Eso sí, algunos expertos advierten de que más avisos no equivalen a más lobos: a veces las mordeduras son de perros asilvestrados o animales encontrados en mitad del campo. Y tampoco se pueden descartar casos de fraude.
UN VISTAZO A...
Cuántos lobos hay. Aún no hay censo nuevo. Lo último es el nacional de 2021-2024, que cifra 333 manadas en España, un 12% más que en el recuento anterior. Galicia tiene 93 (83 exclusivas), frente a las 84 del censo previo, y es la segunda comunidad por detrás de Castilla y León. En total serían entre 1.600 y 1.700 ejemplares. En Galicia, con entre 8-10 lobos por manada, habría entre 750 y 1.000, presentes en el 91% del territorio. Investigadores del Ibader sostienen que el censo oficial subestimó entre un 27,7% y un 43,4% las manadas del norte de Galicia.
Guerra de informes. El lobo entró en el LESPRE en 2021, pero en 2025 el Congreso lo excluyó al norte del Duero, con lo que esas comunidades recuperaron parte de las competencias. Ahora mismo, los controles letales siguen frenados por los tribunales: Galicia no puede autorizarlos por orden del TSXG, y el propio TSXG ha elevado una cuestión de inconstitucionalidad sobre aquella reforma.
El 22 de junio, casi todas las comunidades respaldaron un informe de la Xunta que concluía que el lobo está en estado de conservación favorable. Solo se opusieron el Ministerio y Cataluña, y se abstuvieron Castilla-La Mancha y el País Vasco. Las comunidades consideran que 333 manadas bastan para permitir su caza. El Gobierno defiende su informe y remite a las 500 que fija la Comisión Europea como referencia.
El resultado es un mapa a trozos. Cantabria permite controles letales con cupos de hasta el 20%, Asturias tiene su caza paralizada por la justicia y La Rioja es la única comunidad que lo ha catalogado como especie cinegética, con batidas autorizadas entre octubre y febrero. Para WWF, la clave no es cuándo alcanzar el estado favorable, sino cómo garantizar la coexistencia con el medio rural, como pasó con los zorros de Doñana.
¿Entonces? Lo de siempre: mientras en despachos en Santiago hay debates y discusiones en juzgados, lo que pasa en el campo se decide entre perros mastines, vallados electrificados, cuidadores preocupados y llamadas al 012.
Decía Ursula K. Le Guin en los ciclos de Terramar que "Sólo los hombres hacen el mal. Los animales son inocentes; matan porque tienen que hacerlo". Así que conviene no cargar de moral estos hechos. Porque sea cual sea la postura sobre la caza, cuando una loba lactante se zampa un potro en el pueblo, hay que entender si se trata de una singularidad y una tendencia. El animal hace lo que tiene que hacer y nadie en Mazaricos tiene una respuesta clara. Pero sí sería capital estimar cuántos lobos hay para entender si su población ha crecido o solo se ha "envalentonado".

articles.title: Anaconda expands beyond Python with agent swarms and AI security testing - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Anaconda expands beyond Python with agent swarms and AI security testing
Artificial intelligence development firm Anaconda Inc. is enhancing its enterprise AI platform with tools to coordinate groups of AI agents, test their security and move applications into production.
Today’s introductions continue the company’s expansion beyond its roots in Python software distribution into broader AI development and management. The announcement draws on three recent acquisitions: AI coding company Kilo Code Inc., security specialist Enkrypt AI Inc. and orchestration provider Outerbounds, the business name of Step Computing Inc.
“We are moving Anaconda from being known as a Python package company into being known as an AI-native development platform, essentially helping people build their own enterprise AI applications,” said Chief Executive David DeSanto.
DeSanto said the expansion addresses enterprise concerns about coordinating autonomous work, controlling costs and understanding what agents do when they access software and data. Those concerns were amplified by this summer’s much-publicized incident in which OpenAI agents escaped the company’s test environment and hacked into systems at AI model repository Hugging Face Inc. without informing their human supervisors.
Such “agent swarms” are central to Anaconda’s new release. In a swarm, a task agent delegates parts of a project to subagents that can work simultaneously, exchange information and select different models for different jobs. It enables agents to tackle more complex problems and make decisions without requiring human oversight. Anaconda provides a secure message board through which agents can communicate and users can observe their interactions.
For example, DeSanto said a swarm working on a Jupyter notebook inside Anaconda recently identified an incorrect configuration, corrected it and notified the other agents that their original plan needed to change.
The company is bringing swarms into Microsoft Corp.’s Visual Studio Code through technology acquired with Kilo. The new Kilo Desktop combines software development, data science and Python environment management, including notebook sessions where people and agents can edit and execute cells together. The workspace provides access to more than 500 models, supports local model execution and includes automatic model routing to optimize spending.
Anaconda said its own research found that 63% of respondents are moving toward swarms in some form. Some have already deployed hundreds of agents, including groups focused on development and security testing, DeSanto said.
Managing groups of agents working on complex, multifaceted tasks requires more visibility than individual agents typically provide, DeSanto said. Logs and the shared message board in the Anaconda platform let customers reconstruct interactions and inspect activities such as file access or configuration changes. Logs can run into thousands of pages, and Anaconda is working to make large volumes of activity easier to digest.
Agentic red teams
Security capabilities acquired with Enkrypt include autonomous red-teaming agents that challenge models, agents and Model Context Protocol connections across more than 300 attack categories. MCP allows agents to connect to outside tools and information.
The tests inform guardrail development and are checked in production as applications change. Runtime controls can approve, modify or block risky behavior across agents, tools and retrieval-augmented generation systems.
“You can use the red teaming data in development to write better guardrails for what you’re trying to do,” DeSanto said. “And then you can revalidate that in production with the same red teaming.”
To minimize the risk of security breaches, Anaconda provisions agents initially with no access, a technique called least privilege. The platform also features a public Agent Incident Registry with source-backed records of reported agent incidents.
Agentic security is a growing concern. The company said recent Enkrypt research found vulnerabilities in 73% of the agent tools examined across more than 25,000 MCP servers. That doesn’t mean every gap was a lurking disaster; DeSanto said findings include potential data leakage and other exposures.
Simplified workflows
Outerbounds supplies orchestration technology for repeatable workflows and reproducible environments. The platform carries governed packages, models and security and licensing policies from development into production. Its FastBakery technology builds container images incorporating the open-source conda manager and dependencies documented in the PyPI package repository, including native libraries.
Anaconda’s curated catalog now contains 77 models, many of which are freely modified open-weight models. DeSanto said demand for such models is growing, particularly among regulated companies that need control over where inference runs and how data is handled. Models undergo performance and security testing before entering the catalog.
Anaconda says 95% of the Fortune 500 use its software. While that figure includes both free open-source and paid use, DeSanto said he believes most large firms have at least some paid components. Adoption typically begins with a developer or team, then expands as companies seek standardized environments, governance and supply chain visibility, he said.
Integration of the acquired companies’ technologies is ongoing. Outerbounds is fully integrated into the Anaconda platform, and Enkrypt security scores appear on model cards, but additional guardrails, combined model catalogs and enterprise controls remain on the roadmap.
“Early next year, you should have a fully integrated package you can purchase from Anaconda,” DeSanto said.
The enhanced platform carries a separate license from Anaconda’s legacy tools, with a platform fee plus consumption charges. Kilo and Enkrypt pricing will remain unchanged until integration is complete. Anaconda publishes many of the pricing details on its website. The company is retiring its legacy workbench and package security products and migrating cloud package security customers to the new platform.

articles.title: « Je ne sais pas ce que c'est » : Trump autorise le diesel rouge des tracteurs dans les voitures — Frandroid
articles.text:
Aux États-Unis, le gazole teinté en rouge, que les Américains appellent « red-dyed diesel », n’avait jusqu’ici pas le droit d’entrer dans le réservoir d’une voiture ou d’un camion qui roule sur la route.
Ce lundi 5 octobre, Donald Trump a levé temporairement cette interdiction en signant un décret pendant un meeting à Grand Island, dans le Nebraska, d’après une dépêche de l’AFP. Devant la foule, le président américain a d’ailleurs reconnu qu’il ne connaissait pas bien ce carburant : « Je ne sais pas ce que c’est, mais peu importe, c’est censé être très bon ».
Le décret permet surtout à Donald Trump de se passer du Congrès. Selon Bloomberg, ouvrir à tous un carburant déjà exonéré revient en pratique à lever la taxe fédérale de 24 cents par gallon sans passer par la Chambre des représentants ni le Sénat, partis en vacances avant le scrutin.
La Maison Blanche veut surtout alléger la facture des automobilistes, des agriculteurs et des transporteurs avant les élections de mi-mandat de novembre. Pendant la semaine du 21 septembre, le gazole routier a en effet atteint en moyenne 6,529 dollars le gallon (3,8 litres), soit un peu plus de 1,50 euro le litre, selon l’Energy Information Administration (l’agence américaine des statistiques sur l’énergie). L’administration attribue ce record récent à la guerre en Iran.
Les agriculteurs, eux, ne verront pas de différence sur leurs tracteurs, qui roulent déjà au diesel rouge détaxé. Patrick De Haan, analyste chez GasBuddy (un service américain de suivi des prix à la pompe), le soulignait la semaine dernière. Selon lui, la mesure peut faire baisser la facture des véhicules routiers, mais pas celle des exploitations, et le vrai problème vient du manque de gazole disponible, pas des taxes.
Un gazole ordinaire marqué d’un colorant fiscal
Qu’est-ce qui distingue le diesel rouge du gazole vendu à la pompe ? Chimiquement, presque rien. On ajoute simplement au même carburant, au dépôt, un colorant rouge appelé Solvent Red 164. La teinte signale un statut fiscal : ce gazole est vendu sans les taxes routières, parce qu’il fait tourner des machines qui ne roulent pas sur la voie publique, comme les tracteurs, les engins de chantier ou certains groupes électrogènes.
Le colorant sert d’abord aux contrôles. Le département du Revenu du Colorado rappelle que l’État fédéral l’impose pour deux raisons. La première consiste à repérer le carburant sur lequel les taxes n’ont pas été payées. La seconde, moins connue, est de signaler un carburant qui n’est pas prévu pour les véhicules routiers, dans le cadre de la lutte contre la pollution de l’air.
Jusqu’à ce décret, un agent qui trouvait la moindre trace de rouge dans le réservoir d’un véhicule routier tenait donc sa fraude. L’amende fédérale démarre à 1 000 dollars (environ 890 euros), et passe à 10 dollars par gallon quand la quantité en jeu est plus importante.
En France, le principe est le même avec le gazole non routier, le GNR, lui aussi coloré en rouge et surnommé « le rouge ». La douane précise qu’il est désormais taxé au tarif normal dans la plupart des cas, sauf pour les usages agricoles et forestiers, qui gardent un tarif réduit. Le fioul domestique, utilisé pour le chauffage, porte la même teinte.
Une économie bien plus faible qu’en France
Combien économise-t-on avec du diesel rouge ? Aux États-Unis, la taxe fédérale sur le gazole routier s’élève à 24,4 cents par gallon. Les États ajoutent en moyenne 35,86 cents, selon les chiffres de janvier 2026 de l’Energy Information Administration. Au total, on arrive à environ 60 cents par gallon, soit 14 centimes d’euro par litre, ou un peu moins de 10 % du prix moyen de 6,382 dollars le gallon (environ 1,50 euro le litre) relevé fin septembre 2026.
Pour autant, le décret ne touche qu’à la part fédérale, dont il reporte le paiement à la fin de l’année, sans intérêts ni pénalités. Le Trésor est par ailleurs chargé d’étudier une annulation pure et simple de cette somme. Sans geste des États, l’économie tourne donc autour de 6 centimes d’euro par litre, moins de 4 % du prix à la pompe, et elle ne sera acquise que si la taxe reportée est effacée. Les taxes des États relèvent de leur compétence, et la Maison Blanche dit seulement vouloir les encourager à adapter leurs règles.
Donald Trump a pourtant promis sur scène qu’un routier économiserait plus de 100 dollars (environ 89 euros) à chaque plein. La Maison Blanche chiffre elle-même la part fédérale à environ 60 dollars (environ 53 euros) pour un plein de 250 gallons, soit près de 950 litres. Le cap des 100 dollars n’est dépassé que là où l’État renonce aussi à sa taxe.
En France, l’écart entre gazole routier et GNR est bien plus large. L’accise sur le gazole routier atteint 60,75 euros par hectolitre en 2026 selon le Comité national routier, soit environ 61 centimes par litre. Le GNR agricole, lui, est taxé à 3,86 euros par hectolitre, soit à peine 4 centimes par litre. Un agriculteur français paie environ 57 centimes de taxe en moins par litre, à peu près quatre fois l’écart américain, avant TVA.
Côté américain, le Trésor doit encore dire si la taxe fédérale reportée sera un jour réclamée, et chaque État décidera s’il renonce aussi à la sienne, en moyenne plus lourde que la part fédérale. En France, rien ne bouge : le GNR reste réservé aux engins qui ne circulent pas sur le réseau routier.

articles.title: Reni Onafeko named Glovo Nigeria’s new managing director
articles.text:
Glovo, the global on-demand delivery platform, has appointed Reni Onafeko as its new Country Managing Director for Nigeria, replacing Lamide Akinola, who stepped down after more than three years in the role.
Onafeko, who has steered Glovo’s Nigerian operations since the beginning of 2026, will now lead its next phase and growth strategy, including expansion across Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and Ibadan, the company said in a statement.
Her appointment comes as Glovo continues to expand in Nigeria, which it says closed 2025 as its fastest-growing market globally. At its Future of Commerce summit in April, the company disclosed that it delivered 38 million items in the country over the past year.
“My experience across strategy, finance and growth has given me a strong understanding of our business and opportunities within the market,” Onafeko said. “I look forward to working with our teams, partners and wider ecosystem to build on what we have achieved and deliver sustainable growth in the years ahead.”
Akinola announced her departure in a LinkedIn post on Tuesday after more than five years with Glovo. She joined the company in 2021 as Head of Q-commerce for Sub-Saharan Africa, where she built its marketplace business for groceries, health and retail and launched and scaled dark stores across the region. She became General Manager of Glovo Nigeria in 2023.
“Building this business into an $80 million operation and Glovo’s fastest-growing market has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career,” Akinola wrote in her post. “This chapter has deepened my conviction in the opportunity across Africa, and in the talent capable of turning that opportunity into extraordinary businesses.”
Onafeko joined Glovo in 2023 after an eight-year consulting career that included time at Boston Consulting Group in London, where she advised executives and investors on investment decisions and growth strategy. Since joining Glovo, Onafeko has held several leadership positions, including Head of Strategy & Finance and Head of Growth.
She now takes charge of the business that Glovo says has invested more than ₦37 billion ($27 million) since entering Nigeria. The company said it also doubled its network of partner restaurants and shops, as well as the economic value delivered to those businesses, in 2025.

articles.title: Nubank ativa bloqueio de ligações indesejadas no NuCel • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Nubank ativa bloqueio de ligações indesejadas no NuCel
NuCel Anti-Spam identifica e bloqueia chamadas de telemarketing abusivas de forma automática. Novidade é gratuita.
Clientes do NuCel, o serviço de telefonia móvel do Nubank, agora contam com a proteção antispam. A novidade bloqueia chamadas de telemarketing e outras variações de ligações indesejadas automaticamente, antes de elas chegarem ao celular. O recurso está sendo ativado em todas as linhas e não tem custo adicional.
Os usuários do NuCel estão sendo avisados sobre a ativação do Anti-Spam por notificação e e-mail. Na mensagem, o Nubank explica que o serviço é “uma proteção que identifica e bloqueia ligações com comportamento abusivo”.
O Tecnoblog apurou que o NuCel usa a mesma tecnologia do antispam da Claro, até porque se trata de uma operadora móvel virtual (MVNO) que atua em parceria com a própria Claro.
Você sabe como são essas chamadas. Elas têm origem em números desconhecidos, muitas vezes reproduzem uma gravação ou encerram a ligação imediatamente quando você as atende, e podem surgir em vários momentos do dia.
Para quem se preocupa em perder chamadas legítimas, o Nubank esclarece, no mesmo comunicado, que somente números que seguem um padrão de uso abusivo são bloqueados, de modo que ligações realizadas por parentes, amigos, colegas de trabalho e afins não sejam afetadas.
De todo modo, o cliente NuCel que não quiser contar com o Anti-Spam, independentemente do motivo, pode entrar em contato com o suporte do Nubank para solicitar o cancelamento do serviço.
Já quem quiser contar com a proteção não precisa fazer nada: a ativação está sendo feita automaticamente para todos os clientes.
A proteção antispam do NuCel não chega a surpreender. Isso porque as principais operadoras móveis do país já tinham ativado um recurso do tipo. Começou com a Vivo, cujo serviço Anti Spam chegou a 105 milhões de clientes da empresa no início de setembro.
Na sequência, a Claro anunciou o serviço Chamada Segura, que tem mesmo propósito. Ao mesmo tempo, a TIM começou a preparar a sua proteção contra o telemarketing abusivo, embora o tenha feito depois de ter entrado em um embate com o antispam da Vivo.
Voltando ao Nubank, vale destacar também que, nesta semana, a companhia melhorou os planos do NuCel com incrementos de franquia de dados que chegam a 40%, conforme antecipado ontem (06/10), em primeira mão pelo Tecnoblog.

Richtige Kracher-Deals sind bei den Amazon Prime Deal Days vor allem im Smartphone-Bereich eher selten. Bei Samsung kann längst nicht jedes Angebot überzeugen, ein iPhone ist gar nicht dabei.
